Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

With a strong presence across India, IIFL emphasizes trust, transparency, and customer-centric financial planning. Its career opportunities highlight roles in advisory, sales, technology, and operations, reflecting its commitment to growth and innovation in the financial sector.

Description:
Location: Madhepura
Company: Alstom
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Material Planner in Madhepura were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your material planning and supply chain expertise in a cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and detail-oriented teammates.
Youll play a critical role in ensuring seamless material planning and supply chain processes, directly impacting production efficiency and supplier delivery performance. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business, including Manufacturing and Testing, Industrial Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and Logistics, as well as collaborate with external vendors and business partners. Youll also proactively resolve supply issues, update material planning documents, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in supplier delivery performance.
Youll specifically take care of creating and updating Material Planning documents, such as Call-offs and Schedule Agreements, but also ensure the accuracy of material planning master data and resolve goods receipt issues.
Well look to you for:
Managing purchase requisitions until Material Planning document creation for internal suppliers
Following up with Procurement on purchase requisition maturity for external suppliers
Ensuring and updating the accuracy of material planning master data in compliance with stock and logistic constraints
Communicating delivery plans and purchase orders to suppliers and following up on their confirmations
Analyzing supplier confirmations versus Alstom needs and evaluating risks/impacts on production/projects
Identifying priorities, setting up recovery actions, and organizing regular reviews with suppliers to monitor delivery performance
Resolving supply chain issues, including managing MRP exception messages and goods receipt issues
Driving supplier OTIF (On-Time In-Full) improvement initiatives
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
B. Tech in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering
6+ years of experience in scheduling and inventory management within a manufacturing environment
Proficiency in SAP (PP/MM) modules
Knowledge of industrial planning, logistics, inventory management, material planning, and supplier relationship management
Familiarity with tools such as ASCOT, ARIBA, CELONIS, and QlikSense
Strong data analysis and reporting skills
Cross-functional team management and collaboration skills
Agility and adaptability in a dynamic environment
Entrepreneurial mindset and problem-solving abilities
Proficiency in English and Hindi
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sit at the PMJAY help desk and welcome patients and attendants, explaining the scheme, its benefits, and the cashless treatment process in simple Hindi and the local language.
2. Verify beneficiary eligibility through the Beneficiary Identification System (BIS) using Aadhaar, ration card, PMJAY e-card, or other approved documents.
3. Help eligible patients obtain or generate their Ayushman card through the approved process, or guide them to the nearest enrolment centre.
4. Register patients on the Transaction Management System (TMS) and carry out pre-authorization requests for packages that need it.
5. Coordinate with treating doctors and clinical staff to select the correct package and collect required documents, investigation reports, and clinical notes.
6. Upload treatment records, photographs, and discharge summaries, and follow up on claim submission, queries, and approvals within the stipulated timelines.
7. Make sure eligible patients receive cashless treatment, and report any case of illegal charging or denial of service to the hospital management.
8. Counsel patients and families on treatment coverage, the documents they need, expected stay, and what to do at discharge.
9. Support the hospital's PMJAY nodal officer and billing team in tracking claim status, rejections, and recovery of pending claims.
10. Keep daily records of patients counselled, registered, and discharged under the scheme, and submit MIS reports as required.
11. Take part in health awareness and enrolment drives, and refer patients to other government schemes where relevant.
12. Handle patient grievances politely and escalate them to the hospital management or the State Health Agency (SHA), Bihar helpline when needed.
13. Protect patient confidentiality and follow all National Health Authority (NHA) guidelines, SOPs, and data security rules.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Social Work, Public Health, Hospital Administration, Nursing, or Health Sciences is preferred.
Experience of at least 2-5 years in a hospital help desk, insurance desk, TPA, or health scheme setting (freshers with training may be considered).
Preferably certified or trained as a Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM) / Ayushman Mitra by the NHA or State Health Agency.

Perks and benefits

Description:
Role & responsibilities
The role is mainly in the field: visiting our corporate and government tie-up clients, keeping their beneficiaries informed, and resolving issues at the hospital end throughout all the Districts of Bihar.
Corporate and government client relations
Make regular, scheduled field visits to tie-up clients across Bihar, including CGHS, ECHS, FCI, SSB, CAPF, PSUs, banks, insurers/TPAs and other empanelled organizations.
Act as the single point of contact between these organizations and the hospital for beneficiary queries, referrals and feedback.
Hold awareness sessions and camps for employees, ex-servicemen and their dependents on the hospital's services, empanelment benefits and cashless procedures.
Maintain good working relations with the officers who handle medical claims and referrals (welfare officers, medical officers, HR and admin heads).
Empanelment and compliance
Coordinate empanelment, renewal and rate-list updates with CGHS, ECHS, PMJAY and other schemes, and keep the hospital's documents current.
Follow up on pending bills, claim queries and payment delays with the client and the hospital's billing and TPA desk.
Make sure scheme rules, package rates and referral requirements are followed at the time of admission.
Business development and marketing
Find and pursue new corporate tie-ups, MoUs and health-check-up contracts across Bihar.
Plan and run health camps, CMEs, community outreach and corporate wellness programmes.
Manage the hospital's brand, print and digital material, local media relations, and social media in coordination with the management.
Build referral relationships with doctors, clinics and nursing homes in the districts.
Public relations and patient experience
Represent the hospital at official meetings, events, and press interactions.
Handle complaints and escalations from tie-up clients and patients quickly and courteously.
Collect patient and client feedback, and report service gaps to management

Preferred candidate profile
Skills
Strong communication in Hindi and English; working knowledge of local dialects such as Hindi is useful.
Professional, confident and presentable with senior government and corporate officers.
Good negotiation, follow-up and problem-solving skills.
Working knowledge of MS Office, email and WhatsApp for reporting; basic social media skills.

Perks and benefits
Salary: as per experience and hospital norms, plus travel allowance and incentives linked to performance.

Description:
Job Purpose
Responsible for doing village surveys, getting new customers, do CGT, house verification and income assessment, do quality sourcing, ensure collections and recoveries are done as per the group/centre meeting schedule. Maintain Healthy Customer Relationships on ground in the location
Duties and Responsibilities
Conduct village surveys and do prospecting in selected villages, explain BFL MFI JLG product offerings to all who attend prospecting briefing.
Source New Customers in the locations allocated, form JLG groups and promote financial literacy amongst potential borrowers
Collect all information needed for sourcing, data entry / upload and/or validate documents on LOS, follow entire sourcing process as defined in SOP
Coordinate with BM for required approvals and Credit Ops officer at branch for disbursements as per process
Plan Center Meetings of customers and notify customers in advance of the schedule, ensure 100% participation of borrowers in the center meetings. Resolve customer queries and promote top ups / cross sell as defined for the branch. Manage a portfolio of 450 500 customers
Ensure collections are done from Customers as per scheduled center meeting days, ensure 100% deposition of recovery done in defined points of disposition as per SOP.
Carry out end use monitoring of loans as per the process
Maintain Healthy and cordial relationship with all potential and existing borrowers, ensure 100% compliance and good conduct on all SOPs and practices as defined in the branch operating model.
Create a daily report of tasks planned and executed and submit to Branch Manager.
Ensure recovery disposition reconciliation is done with Credit and Ops Officer as per schedule.
Ensuring critical parameters like lead to login are executed as per matrix .
Maintain centre meeting discipline, follow SOPs and code of conduct

Major Challenges
Quality sourcing and achieving targets as defined
Regular collections and maintaining customers in current bucket, regularizing and normalizing delinquent customers
Compliance on all business parameters, zero audit findings on his / her sourced customer segment / portfolio

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role: The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.   

Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role 
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us : We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Senior Manager- Customer Service/Care Manager (Passenger Vehicles)

Purpose of the Role :
The role will be responsible for organizing, deploying and monitoring the service processes & customer care Initiatives; providing technical support and handling customer complaints at workshop in order to enhance customer satisfaction and dealer engagement within organizational policies and government/statutory norms.

Job Responsibility
Contribution to planning:
Prepare and recommend action plans on vehicle retention and inflow growth Audit, analyze and implement action plan on process improvement.
Design & Plan SLAs between channel partners and fleet customers.
Inflow increases and Channel Partner satisfaction Monitor status of pending claims of CP and seek approvals as required on payment release.
Implement/ monitor and increase body shop conversions, productivity and new initiations.
Execute and monitor of customer connect initiatives with CP Service Process & Marketing Oversight.
Monitor, analyze and act on improvement of service parameters.
Follow up with CP to ensure service marketing products targets achievement and distribution of dealer manpower incentive.
Service Support Activities Management (Technical Service Support, Spares & Training).
Contribute for JIR (Joint Investigation Report) for proper feedback to plant and complaint resolution.
Coordinate with RPM for parts availability and monitor VOR% at Channel Partners.
Check and authorize part failure claims.
Service Activity - Corporate & Fleet customers.
Coordinate with various stakeholders on closure of escalated corporate and fleet customer complaints.
Monitor availability of SPOCs, exclusive bays, at workshops related to fleet customers.
Monitor Key service parameters of 12 fleet cities and suggest action plan with the field team.

Nature of problems faced/ Scope of improvement opportunities:

Resolve all customer complaints in co-ordination with CP.
Escalate product concerns through DIR/CCIR. and communicate back to CP
Identify training gaps, nominate CP manpower for all courses and monitor certification status.

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions Internal

Service Process Auditing service process progress Review and updating critical customer complaint.
Service Marketing Track service marketing figures.
Productivity Updating report on workshop productivity Body shop - updating body shop progress Spare Parts - Support for parts requirement on urgent basis.
SE&TS - Customer feedback on product performance and support for field on customer complaints. Warranty support, plant visit.
ATC - Training requirement and conducting and assessment/ Certification support.
Customer Experience - Customer Complaints update/ execution process and CUP 52 parameters and deployment.
Legal - Communications on legal cases details & follow up.

External
Customer Service Experience & product performance feedback from customers and responses from us.
Vendors Support in field and specific cases Dealers Performance Progress and concern areas
Suppliers supplies / support in field for camps and schemes & support
Corporate and Fleet Customers Regular connection with the customers to ensure customized service solutions.

Desired Candidate Profile

Minimum education qualification -Only Full time B.E /B. Tech/No Part Time qualification
Minimum experience requirement 3-15 years
Must have working knowledge of the passenger vehicle/car segment. Should possess experience in the automobile industry with a strong customer-centric approach, including providing technical support, handling customer complaints, and ensuring effective complaint resolution.

Skills & Competencies

Passion for customer - sustainably implements practices that meet customers needs and build productive alliances with customers / stakeholder

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Description:
Role : Counterparty Onboarding Relationship Manager - Supply Chain Finance

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Hyderabad.


Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.
Drive activation: ensure counterparties utilize limits and monitor your portfolio growth and quality.
Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Key KPIs

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Candidate Profile

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.
AboutCompany:
About Vivriti Group

Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience

Description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Total Exp - 6yrs to 20yrs
Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar
Mandatory Skill set - SAP CAR , UDF,Implementation


Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Change Manager
Coordinate Windows Server and VMware patch management activities, including engagement with Windows and VMaaS engineering teams, Operations teams (including vendors), application owners, and server owners to support a smooth end-to-end patching pipeline.
Providing governance and oversight of timely operating system patch delivery.
Creation and management of patching schedules / slots.
Creation and management of change tickets and following up on required approvals.
Coordinating the remediation of gaps or shortcomings in Windows and VMaaS patch compliance reporting.
Supporting central patch management teams with governance of the patch ageing estate by coordinating with ITAOs, application owners and server owners to resolve scheduling issues and improve overall patch compliance.
Managing weekly DB/vendor interlock meetings for Windows & VMaaS patching, supporting approvals for patching-related change requests and progressing Windows & VMaaS escalations.
Perform a support role for patch management tooling, including ServiceNow.
Act as a key contact for internal audit, external audit, and regulators on Windows & VMaaS patching queries, and respond to ITAO, business area and audit queries relating to patch status, scheduling, and technology-specific matters.
Maintain the key operating procedure documentation for Windows and VMaaS patch management in collaboration with key process delivery stakeholders.
Interfacing with Major Incident Management teams for critical, out of band, patch deployments.

Practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
DevSecOps pipeline integration
Monitoring/observability experience
Git and modern branching/deployment strategies
Strong troubleshooting skills across application delivery and cloud environments

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Description:
SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Capable of organizing and managing day to day activities/initiatives for self & team independently
Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team
Ability to multi-task on activities within & outside of the immediate functional area/team
Demonstrate capability to learn and improve self & team's performance on an on-going basis
Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence
Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

What additional skills will be good to have?
Knowledge of FTP Chart of Account, GRCA and FTP Global mappings

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

Synopsis:

The incumbent would be a member of the Organisation Development & Effectiveness team, which oversees the organization's learning and development efforts. Experience: 5 - 10 yrs.

Job Description:
Program Management and Delivery of Behavioural/ Soft Skills Training Programs for Middle & Senior Management.
Location Operations Manage all operations related to the training programs from the stage of planning to vendor management to post-training effectiveness.

Manage all internal / external / surveillance / client audit and ensure all the processes are adhered to without any Non-Conformity

Building relationships with stakeholders: You will need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, including senior leaders, department heads, and employees, to ensure that training programs meet their needs.

Must have skills:
Fluent and assertive in Communicating.
Effective consultation& Facilitation (Training Delivery) skills.
Content Development skills.
Basic Knowledge of assessments.
Stakeholder Management & Strong Networking capability Internal & External
Branding & Driving Organization-wide Learning communication.
Process compliance, Data management and Analysis

Preferrable Points:
Exposure or experience with organizations of similar nature, scale, and size to LTTS.
Facilitation skills (not as a freelancer)
Hands-on Experience with LMS (SuccessFactors)
Experience in instructional design and content design is preferred

Job Description
As a Full Stack QA Engineer supporting our Media Planning tools, you will act as a key quality enabler across the software development lifecycle.
You will focus on early risk identification, establish test strategies, identify testing gaps, advise on best practices and testing tools, and perform manual and automated testing.
You will join our office in Bangalore, working as part of a team distributed across India and Europe Qualifications
Main responsibilities:
Ensure the quality and usability of our Media Planning products by collaborating with Product and Engineering.
Collaborate with Product Owners and Developers to understand business requirements and translate them into risk based test plans, acceptance criteria and test cases.
Highlight quality risks, edge cases, and cross-feature scenarios early during backlog grooming sessions.
Assess required testing scopes, identify gaps in coverage, and advise Engineering on test design of automated tests, manual testing, and validation.
Act as an expert and advisor on testing tools, methodologies, and testing framework architecture for the team.
Execute testing, providing continuous feedback to Product and Engineering to inform release decisions.
Continuously update test coverage and test suites based on QA findings and customer feedback.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and automation frameworks.

Job Title: Inside Sales Specialist B2C (Individual Contributor)
Location: HSR, Bangalore
Department: B2C Sales
Experience: 15 years
Employment Type: Full-time
Conatct (HR): 8050290656

About Simplilearn
Simplilearn is the world’s #1 online bootcamp for digital economy skills training, helping professionals and enterprises stay ahead in the fast-changing digital world. We offer world-class programs in Data Science, AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Digital Marketing, and more.

Role Summary
We are looking for a highly motivated Inside Sales Specialist to join our B2C Sales team. This is an individual contributor role focused on engaging with prospective learners, understanding their career goals, and recommending appropriate Simplilearn programs to help them succeed.

Key Responsibilities
Proactively connect with potential learners via Outbound calls
Understand individual customer needs and provide customized course recommendations.
Convert leads into paying customers by driving consultative and need-based selling.
Achieve monthly revenue targets through high conversion rates and proactive follow-ups.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions using CRM tools.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to provide market feedback.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
1–5 years of experience in B2C inside sales, preferably in EdTech or service-based industries.
Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and persuasion skills.
Self-driven, goal-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
Familiarity with CRM tool - Salesforce is an added advantage.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts/weekends (as required for B2C audiences).

What We Offer
Competitive fixed pay plus interesting performance incentives.
Rapid career growth in a global EdTech leader.
Learning & development support with access to all Simplilearn programs.
Dynamic, high-energy work culture with strong peer support.

Description:
We are looking for enthusiastic and proactive Field Market Research Interns to conduct primary market research for our newly launched pregnancy test kit in Bangalore.
The intern will be responsible for visiting relevant markets, retail outlets, pharmacies, and other identified locations to gather firsthand insights on product awareness, customer preferences, purchasing behavior, pricing, competition, and market opportunities.
This is a hands-on field role ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with people, collecting information, and understanding consumer and market trends.

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka
Duration: 15 Days
Engagement: Paid Internship
Joining: Immediate Joiners Only

Please fill this form if you are interested in applying:  https://forms.gle/mH4vESCBRWkmfb9y9

Key Responsibilities
Conduct primary market research across assigned areas of Bangalore.
Visit pharmacies, medical stores, retail outlets, and other relevant points of sale.
Interact professionally with retailers, customers, and other relevant respondents.
Record research findings accurately using prescribed questionnaires/forms.
Share daily field updates and observations with the research/team lead.
Maintain confidentiality of collected information and follow the assigned research methodology.
Prepare a summary of key findings and field observations at the end of the internship.

Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Comfortable working on the field and travelling within Bangalore.
Confident and comfortable speaking with different people.
Good at asking questions, listening, and recording information accurately.
Available to join immediately and commit to the complete 15-day internship.

Eligibility
Age: 18 years and above.
Candidates comfortable conducting field-based consumer/retail research are encouraged to apply.
Female candidates are particularly encouraged to apply.
Freshers and students with good communication and interpersonal skills are welcome.

Compensation & Benefits
Paid 15-day internship
Travel allowance
Food allowance
Internship completion certificate

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Description:
Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. frog partners with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth, by building and orchestrating experiences at scale, while harnessing the power of data and technology. We're inventing the future of customer experiences by delivering market-defining business models, products, services, brand engagements and communications.
Joining frog means you'll be joining the "pond," a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience across our areas of expertise, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table. We draw on our global reach and local knowledge to solve complex problems and create innovative, sustainable solutions that touch hearts and move markets. frogs prize humour, positivity, and community just as highly as performance and outcomes. Our culture is open, flexible, inclusive, and engaging. Working at frog means being empowered to meet the moment, and Make Your Mark on every project, in your studio, your community - and the world at large.
Your Role
The ideal candidate will combine expertise in social listening, consumer and market intelligence, and AI-driven analytics to generate actionable insights from online conversations and digital data. The candidate should understand how AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform social listening workflows, enabling faster, more scalable, and insight-led delivery. Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to translate complex data into strategic business recommendations.
The candidate will be expected (but not limited) to:
Lead social listening and digital intelligence engagements, translating business objectives into research frameworks, listening strategies, and actionable insights.
Leverage AI, LLMs, and automation to streamline social data collection, analysis, sentiment assessment, topic clustering, trend identification, and insight generation.
Explore and implement AI-first approaches to improve the speed, accuracy, scalability, and quality of social listening and consumer intelligence deliverables.
Work with AI platforms, social listening tools, APIs, and data connectors to integrate information from social media, online news, forums, reviews, and other digital sources.

Your Profile
7 - 10 years of proven experience in social listening, consumer insights, digital intelligence, market research, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in AI-led solutions.
Strong understanding of social listening methodologies, digital data sources, sentiment analysis, taxonomy development, trend analysis, and competitive intelligence.
Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to automate or enhance research, analytics, insight generation, or reporting workflows.
Familiarity with social listening platforms such as Meltwater, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, or equivalent tools.
Experience in prompt engineering, workflow automation, and evaluating the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect qualitative and quantitative findings to business outcomes.

What you will love about working here
We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
Equal Opportunities at frog

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Description:
Job Description: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant (6 to 10 Years)
Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.

Define promotion strategies (dev staging prod) with automated quality gates.

Manage AI Gateway configurations, API endpoints, and multi-model routing.
3. Automated LLM Evaluation Pipelines
Build automated evaluation frameworks for LLM and RAG applications using MLflow LLM Evaluate, Mosaic AI Agent Evaluation, RAGAS, DeepEval, or similar tools.
Implement LLM-as-a-judge, golden datasets, regression testing, and human-in-the-loop feedback loops.
Track metrics such as groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, toxicity, hallucination rate, latency, and cost per query.
Integrate evaluation as a mandatory gate in CI/CD before production releases.
4. Observability & Drift Detection
Implement monitoring for model performance, data drift, concept drift, and prediction quality using Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring and inference tables.
Build LLM observability: tracing, token usage, latency, error rates, and prompt/response logging (MLflow Tracing, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or OpenTelemetry).
Set up dashboards and alerts (Grafana, Prometheus, Databricks SQL dashboards) with defined SLAs/SLOs.
Drive root-cause analysis and automated retraining or rollback triggers.
5. Model & Prompt Governance (Unity Catalog)
Govern models, prompts, features, vector indexes, and datasets using Unity Catalog.
Implement prompt versioning, prompt registries, and model lineage tracking.
Enforce access control, audit logging, PII handling, and responsible AI guardrails.
Ensure compliance with internal security policies and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, EU AI Act where applicable).
6. Databricks Workflows & Airflow
Orchestrate ML and LLM pipelines using Databricks Workflows (Jobs) and Apache Airflow.
Design robust DAGs with dependency management, retries, alerting, and SLA monitoring.
Integrate orchestration with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
7. RAG Pipeline Operations
Operationalize Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and generation.
Manage vector databases (Databricks Vector Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.) including index sync, refresh, and scaling.
Monitor and improve retrieval quality (recall@k, MRR, context precision) and embedding freshness.

Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
