Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

We will provide: -
An inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
A challenging and unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online Axtria Institute, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
Possibility to relocate to any Axtria office for short and long-term projects
Benefit package:
-Health Insurance benefits
-Retirement benefits
-Paid time off
-Flexible Benefits
-Hybrid working

About Axtria:

Axtria is a global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. Axtria enables life sciences organizations to transform the product commercialization journey and deliver much-improved healthcare outcomes for patients worldwide. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of people and are incredibly passionate about the improvement we can bring to patients lives. Our focus is on delivering solutions that help pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostics companies complete the journey from data to insights to action and get superior returns from their investments. As a participant of the United Nations Global Compact, Axtria is committed to aligning strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption and taking actions that advance societal goals. Our people are our core strength, and they make us proud of our work; this has helped us grow exponentially and make tremendous strides toward developing great products. It is for the grit, thinking of an entrepreneur, and a family-like environment where each member is valued and treasured that we are growing rapidly. For more information.

Visit www.axtria.com

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI.

Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Description:
Role: Generative AI Engineer Databricks
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Databricks and a strong background in Data Engineering. The ideal candidate should have expertise in building AI-driven applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and scalable data pipelines. Experience working with Databricks, PySpark, cloud platforms, and modern AI frameworks is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using Databricks and cloud platforms.
Build and optimize RAG-based solutions leveraging vector databases and enterprise data sources.
Develop scalable data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, and Python.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate LLMs into business applications.
Work with structured and unstructured datasets to support AI/ML use cases.
Implement prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI governance best practices.
Develop APIs and microservices for AI model integration.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, latency, and scalability in production environments.
Follow MLOps best practices for model deployment, experimentation, and monitoring.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

To be responsible for all aspects of specification jobs which includes writing specification packages/ ensuring that the specifications written are given impetus and thrust especially with technical community including opinion makers for all products (excluding cement Grinding aids) and help the sales team in running projects for getting specified new products with consultants/clients & and also to break the competitor specifications.
Key Areas of Responsibility
ESSENTIAL
To write down specifications incorporating our products and ensure that the same cannot be easily broken by competitors
To ensure that specifications written covers complete range of products along with drawings if required
To sell specification packages to consultants and customers so as to ensure that our products are incorporated in the tender stage it-self
Develop CRM with the Specifiers/ new consultants and create awareness about the new range of products and generate specifications
Breaking the competitors specifications for projects on ground and get the approvals or our products for business conversion
Crete Standard specification submittals and generate specification data bank
SECONDARY
Keep watch on competition and up-date time to time for strategic move to counter competition
Conduct In house presentations for Key specifiers and consultants for product up-date to the group
Keep updating the consultants data bank
Participate in technical events like ACCE, REDECON, ICI, IE meetings

Preferred candidate profile
BE or Dip in Civil

If interested, please share your updated cv to renuka.thimmanaik@fosroc.com mentioning your current ctc , expected ctc and notice period along with your preferred location in the subject line.
AboutCompany:
Fosroc, a Saint-Gobain business, is a leading global provider of high-performance construction chemical solutions, serving the building and infrastructure industry for decades.
With a strong presence across markets, Fosroc provides innovative solutions in concrete repair, waterproofing, grouting, sealants, flooring, jointing, admixtures and structural strengthening.
Fosroc partners closely with architects, consultants, engineers, contractors and project owners to provide technically advanced solutions for complex construction challenges.
The company focuses on innovation, quality, sustainability and technical excellence, helping customers improve the durability, safety, performance and life of structures.
As part of Saint-Gobain, Fosroc benefits from global expertise, technology and R&D capabilities while maintaining a strong local understanding of customer and market needs.

Role: Client Advisor | NoBroker
About the Company:
NoBroker is World's Largest NoBrokerage Property site offering end to end services in the real estate
space. We are also Indias First Prop-Teah unicorn with a billion dollar valuation.
At NoBroker Builder Channel, we provide seamless experience to future homeowners. We cater to 6
major geographies now - Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai.
About the Role:
The role of a Client Advisor is crucial as it is an intermediary between potential clients and developers,
offering valuable guidance and support during the entire buying journey of the customer
Key Responsibilities:

Contact potential customers via telephone, virtual meet or onsite to explain our new builder
projects and persuade them to schedule an appointment on site or persuade them to make a
purchase.







Attend qualified leads by meeting clients virtually, where you will present tailored made
options and convince customers to come on site.
Facilitate negotiations between clients and builders, ensuring that both parties are satisfied with
the terms of the deal.
The Client Advisor must maintain relationships with clients, ensuring that they are satisfied with
the services provided and are likely to recommend NoBroker to others.
Promote and offer additional NoBroker services to customers, aiming to cross-sell and provide
them with a comprehensive range of offerings that meet their needs.
Ensure all leads are nurtured and create a good quality strong sales pipeline/funnel for achieving
daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Generate referrals and actively encourage customers to recommend our services to their friends,
family, and acquaintances.
The Client Advisor must stay informed about changes and trends in the real estate market,
including pricing, inventory, and demand.
Pre-Requisites:









Minimum qualification required is a bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Proven track record of sales experience or a similar role in a sales environment.
Real estate experience is an added advantage.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to convince, persuade, and handle objections effectively.
Knowledge of sales principles and techniques.
Good locality understanding.
Ability to work under a target driven role.
Should have a vehicle of his or her own.





Fluency in the local language and English.
Working Days: 6 days (Saturday and Sunday working).
Competencies to check while interviewing for the Role :







Real Estate Knowledge
Communication skills including questioning and listening skills.
Networking and Relationship Building
Problem-Solving and Negotiation
Rapport Building skills
Convincing skills
Customer-oriented mindset

in India to reach $1 billion valuation.

Description:
Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

We will provide: -
An inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
A challenging and unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online Axtria Institute, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
Possibility to relocate to any Axtria office for short and long-term projects
Benefit package:
-Health Insurance benefits
-Retirement benefits
-Paid time off
-Flexible Benefits
-Hybrid working

About Axtria:

Axtria is a global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. Axtria enables life sciences organizations to transform the product commercialization journey and deliver much-improved healthcare outcomes for patients worldwide. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of people and are incredibly passionate about the improvement we can bring to patients lives. Our focus is on delivering solutions that help pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostics companies complete the journey from data to insights to action and get superior returns from their investments. As a participant of the United Nations Global Compact, Axtria is committed to aligning strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption and taking actions that advance societal goals. Our people are our core strength, and they make us proud of our work; this has helped us grow exponentially and make tremendous strides toward developing great products. It is for the grit, thinking of an entrepreneur, and a family-like environment where each member is valued and treasured that we are growing rapidly. For more information.

Job Title: Tech S and T-Salesforce Application Architect-

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Job Description: Salesforce Application Architect Provider Network Management (PNM / Vlocity)

Role Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Application Architect with deep expertise in Provider Network Management (PNM) within Salesforce Health Cloud, including hands on experience with Vlocity/OmniStudio. The architect will design and implement provider enrollment, credentialing, network management, and contract automation solutions using Salesforce’s PNM capabilities, which streamline provider onboarding, automate guided workflows, and leverage specialized Health Cloud PNM objects and data models.
Responsibilities
Architect end to end PNM solutions (provider enrollment, credentialing, contracts, network setup) aligned with Health Cloud PNM capabilities.
Design and extend the PNM data model using custom objects
Lead solutioning using Vlocity/OmniStudio (OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors).
Provide architectural guidance, ensure scalability, and adhere to Salesforce platform best practices.
Collaborate with business, provider operations, and engineering teams to deliver compliant, industry grade solutions.
Required Skills
Strong hands on experience with Salesforce Health Cloud PNM and healthcare provider lifecycle processes.
Advanced Vlocity/OmniStudio expertise.
Strong Salesforce platform architecture, data modeling, and integration skills.
Preferred certifications: Application Architect, OmniStudio, Health Cloud.
Solid understanding of healthcare payer/provider operational models.
Deep understanding of Salesforce recommended architectural practices, scalability considerations, and cross-cloud solutioning
Proficiency in API design, security, data modeling, system integrations, and event-driven architectures.
General Requirements
8-15 years IT experience with 5+ years in Salesforce.
Salesforce certifications preferred (Application Architect, OmniStudio Consultant/Developer, Health Cloud).
Strong communication skills for stakeholder management, discovery workshops, and solution presentation.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with payer systems, provider credentialing systems, or healthcare interoperability (HL7/FHIR) is a plus.
Experience implementing Provider Search, Network Adequacy, or Provider Directory solutions within Health Cloud ecosystems.
Prior work in regulated healthcare environments with compliance requirements.

Position: IICS / Informatica Developer
Experience: 5-11 YRS
Location: Pan India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled IICS (Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services) / Informatica Developer with 2-5 years of experience in developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data integration solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in IICS, Informatica PowerCenter, ETL development, SQL, and Data Warehousing concepts.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT workflows using IICS and/or Informatica PowerCenter.
Develop data integration solutions for cloud and on-premises applications.
Build and optimize mappings, mapplets, tasks, task flows, and workflows.
Extract, transform, and load data from multiple source systems into target data warehouses.
Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, and stakeholders to understand business requirements.
Perform unit testing, system testing, and deployment of ETL solutions.
Monitor production jobs and troubleshoot performance and data quality issues.
Implement data validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms.
Create and maintain technical design documents and operational procedures.
Follow data governance, security, and best development practices.

Description:
Job Description: MS Power Platform Developer

Experience: 4-6 years || Preferred Domain: BFSI / Banking

Primary Skills:
Power Apps, Power Automate (Desktop/Cloud), Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Connectors, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 Integration, AI Builder, Generative Answers, Solution Packaging, ALM, Security Roles, DLP Policies and Deployment Support
We are looking for an MS Power Platform Developer at B2 level with hands-on experience in building low-code business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio. The resource should be able to translate business requirements into scalable apps, automated workflows, chatbot experiences, and Microsoft 365 integrated solutions.
The role will involve working with solution architects, business SMEs and project teams to design, configure, test, and deploy Power Platform solutions. BFSI / Banking experience is preferred, while exposure to shared services, operations, HR, IT support, finance, procurement, or enterprise support functions will also be relevant.

Required Expertise
Hands-on experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 integrations.
Ability to build canvas/model-driven apps, cloud flows, approval workflows, notifications, data lookups, and system integrations.
Experience configuring Copilot Studio topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, and fallback handling.
Working knowledge of SharePoint, standard/custom connectors, environments, solutions, security roles, and deployment practices.
Good understanding of data privacy, access control, DLP policies, responsible AI, and enterprise governance expectations.

Key Responsibilities
Understand business requirements and convert them into Power Platform solution designs.
Develop Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows and Dataverse-based solution components.
Configure Copilot Studio bots using approved knowledge sources, topics, and workflow actions.
Integrate solutions with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, APIs, and business systems using connectors.
Perform testing, defect fixes, deployment support, UAT assistance and post-go-live stabilization.
Prepare concise configuration notes, test evidence, handover inputs, and support documentation.

Required Experience & Skills
46 years of IT experience with Power Platform delivery.
Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 services.
Exposure to Copilot Studio, virtual agents, generative answers, or conversational AI use cases.
Ability to troubleshoot flow failures, connector issues, access restrictions, and deployment challenges.
Good communication skills to work with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.

Good to Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-900, PL-100, PL-200, PL-400, or AI-900.
Exposure to AI Builder, Azure OpenAI, chatbot analytics, Power BI or enterprise reporting use cases.
Understanding of ALM, solution packaging, audit requirements, and Power Platform governance.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects

Description:
The Role
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.
 Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role- Individual Contributor
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity :
The Automated Operations Engineer PS Core is responsible for 24 7 monitoring, fault detection, incident management, and service assurance of network infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance as per defined SLAs.
What you will do:

- Monitor network, servers, and applications using NMS/EMS tools
- Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve network alarms and incidents
- Perform L1/L2 troubleshooting for network, transmission, and service issues
- Raise, update, and manage trouble tickets with internal teams and vendors
- Escalate incidents as per defined escalation matrix
- Coordinate with field teams, OEMs, and service providers
- Track SLA/KPI compliance and ensure timely resolution
- Perform routine health checks and preventive maintenance
- Prepare incident reports, RCA inputs, and shift handover notes
- Support change activities and maintenance windows
The skills you bring:

- Bachelor s degree in Engineering / IT / Computer Science
- Knowledge of telecom networks (2G/3G/4G/5G preferred)
- Familiarity with RAN, RNC, BSC, SNMP, GTP, SIP, GPRS, SGSN, GGSN, Packet Core
- Monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Zabbix, Netcool, Nagios)
- Ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, JIRA)
- Basic Linux/Unix knowledge
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, thats why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Description:
At Crowne Plaza, we believe in delivering exceptional hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences. We re looking for a passionate and service-oriented F&B Associate who takes pride in providing excellent food and beverage service. You ll work closely with the Food & Beverage team to ensure every guest enjoys a welcoming, professional, and seamless dining experience.
What Your Day Will Look Like:
Every day is different at IHG, but you ll mostly be:
Delivering exceptional service - welcoming guests warmly, understanding their needs, and providing attentive and professional service throughout their dining experience.
Creating memorable experiences - taking food and beverage orders accurately, serving dishes and beverages according to hotel standards, and ensuring guest satisfaction.
Working as one team - coordinating with the kitchen, bar, banquet, and other hotel departments to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
Maintaining high standards - ensuring the restaurant, banquet areas, and service stations are clean, organised, and ready for service.
Following food safety and hygiene standards - adhering to hotel procedures, maintaining personal hygiene, and ensuring safe food and beverage handling practices.
Supporting daily operations - assisting with table setup, mise-en-place, buffet arrangements, event service, and billing procedures as required.
Handling guest feedback - responding to guest requests courteously and informing the supervisor or
What Your Day Will Look Like:
A diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Food & Beverage, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in food and beverage service is an advantage; freshers with a positive attitude and willingness to learn are welcome.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
A customer-focused attitude with a passion for hospitality and guest satisfaction.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service standards, hygiene, and safety procedures.
Ability to work effectively in a team and maintain attention to detail during busy service periods.
Good command of English and the local language.
Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
What You Can Expect From Us:
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From competitive compensation to a wide range of benefits, including a full uniform, impressive room discounts, and some of the best training in the business, we re committed to helping you grow your hospitality career.
Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate differences and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities and promotes a culture of trust, support, and acceptance.
IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow, and make a difference. Through our my Wellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting your health, lifestyle, and workplace wellbeing.
So, join us and become part of our ever-growing global family.
Dont quite meet every single requirement, but still believe youd be a great fit for the job Well never know unless you hit the Apply button. Start your journey with us today.

Network Implementation Engineer
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Noida
Immediate joiners preferred

Experience: 3+ Years

Skills:
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically
within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or
equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field
experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize
operational disruption.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst
(9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series
routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500
Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for
automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution
cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE /
NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP
neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error
monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming
parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.

Job Title: - Associate Manager/Project Leader Model Building
Requisition ID:
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: -
Data Scientist with good hands-on experience of 3+ years in developing state of the art and scalable Machine Learning models and their operationalization, leveraging off-the-shelf workbench production.
Job Responsibilities: -
1. Hands on experience in Python data-science and math packages such as NumPy, Pandas, Sklearn, Seaborn, PyCaret, Matplotlib
2. Proficiency in Python and common Machine Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, NLTK, Stanford NLP, PyTorch, Ling Pipe, Caffe, Keras, SparkML and OpenAI etc.)
3. Experience of working in large teams and using collaboration tools like GIT, Jira and Confluence
4. Good understanding of any of the cloud platform – AWS, Azure or GCP
5. Understanding of Commercial Pharma landscape and Patient Data / Analytics would be a huge plus
6. Should have an attitude of willingness to learn, accepting the challenging environment and confidence in delivering the results within timelines. Should be inclined towards self motivation and self-driven to find solutions for problems.
7. Should be able to mentor and guide mid to large sized teams under him/her

1. Strong experience on Spark with Scala/Python/Java
2. Strong proficiency in building/training/evaluating state of the art machine learning models and its deployment
3. Proficiency in Statistical and Probabilistic methods such as SVM, Decision-Trees, Bagging and Boosting Techniques, Clustering
4. Proficiency in Core NLP techniques like Text Classification, Named Entity Recognition (NER), Topic Modeling, Sentiment Analysis, etc. Understanding of Generative AI / Large Language Models / Transformers would be a plus
Qualification: -
- B-Tech or BE in Computer Science / Computer Applications from Tier 1-2 college with 3+ years of proven experience in the field of Advanced Analytics or Machine Learning
OR
- Master’s degree in Machine Learning / Statistics / Econometrics, or related discipline from Tier 1-2 college with 3+ years of experience

Experience in application of machine learning algorithms (classification, regression, deep learning, NLP, etc.)
Experience with a ML/data-centric programming language (such as Python, Scala, or R) and ML libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, etc.)
Experience with Apache Hadoop / Spark (or equivalent cloud-computing/map-reduce framework)
Skills that give you an edge: -
Strong analytical skills to solve and model complex business requirements are a plus. With life sciences or pharma background.

Role: Java Full Stack Developer
Experience: 6+ Years
Location: Bangalore (Onsite) Need Local Candidate
Notice period: Immediate to 20 days
Position- Full Time
Shift- General
Mandatory Skills:
Java, Spring boot React JS, Rest API - 4+ years of experience in developing enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and SOLID design patterns.
Proficient in Java (Core and Advanced) and Spring Boot framework.
Proficiency in building reusable components and front-end libraries using React.js.
Strong understanding of React lifecycle methods and functional components with hooks (e.g., useState, useEffect, useContext) and react json forms
Experience with state management libraries such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, or Context API.

Familiarity with testing React components using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, or Enzyme.
Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.
Experience with RDBMS preferably PostgreSql and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
Good knowledge on bigdata (eg: Hive DB) and query engine tool like Trino
Good understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., JWT, OAuth, sessions).
Experience with version control systems like Git.
Good understanding of Docker and Kubernetes concepts.
Basic knowledge of Unix/Linux commands.
Understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience with tools like GitHub Actions.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS and AWS S3 object storage
Familiarity with message brokers like RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Apache MQ.
Experience using code quality tools such as SonarQube.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Job Title: .NET Developer
Experience: 6+ Years
Contract Duration: 12 Months
Location: Noida, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai
Employment Type: Contract
Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced .NET Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable applications using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL Server, and application development.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core.
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and web services.
Work with SQL Server, including database design, queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance applications.
Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and provide technical support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and application deployment.
Follow coding standards, best practices, and Agile development methodologies.
Required Skills:
6+ years of experience in .NET development.
Strong hands-on experience in C# and .NET / .NET Core.
Good knowledge of ASP.NET Core and Web API.
Experience with SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, and database optimization.
Knowledge of REST APIs, Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core, and LINQ.
Experience with Git or other version control tools.
Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), design patterns, and SOLID principles.
Good problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with Azure or AWS cloud services.
Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or Angular/React.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and microservices.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and preferred location.

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Customer Support Executive Inbound Voice Process
Job Description
We are hiring Customer Support Executives for an Inbound Voice Process. The role involves handling customer queries over calls and providing quick, professional, and effective resolutions.
Roles & Responsibilities
Handle customer queries through inbound calls.
Understand customer concerns and provide appropriate resolutions.
Assist customers with order-related queries, delivery concerns, refunds, replacements, and other service-related issues.
Maintain professionalism and ensure a positive customer experience.
Accurately update customer information and call-related details in the system.
Follow company guidelines, quality standards, and productivity targets.
Coordinate with internal teams whenever required to resolve customer issues.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Undergraduate / Graduate – Any Stream.
Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Good communication skills in Hindi and English.
Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone.
Basic computer knowledge is required.
Must have a laptop/desktop with minimum 8 GB RAM and Windows 10 or above.
Wi-Fi connection is mandatory.
Comfortable working in 24/7 rotational shifts.
Comfortable with 6 days working and 1 rotational week off.
Candidates should be comfortable working on camera during training and interview.
Candidates must be willing to complete the on-the-job training and certification process.
Salary & Benefits
Salary: 13,500 – 14,000 In-Hand per Month
No PF deduction
No ESIC deduction
Inbound Voice Process
On-the-job training provided
Freshers can apply
Shift & Working Details
Working Days: 6 days a week
Week Off: 1 rotational week off
Shift: 24/7 rotational shifts
Working Hours: 9 hours including 1-hour break
Productive Hours: 8 hours
Interview Process
HR Evaluation
Operations Round – L1
Operations Round – L2
Assessment / Ambition Test
Client Evaluation
Important Note
No charges are applicable for the interview or joining process.
Candidates must have their own laptop/desktop and Wi-Fi connection to be eligible for the role.

Description:
We are seeking highly skilled Cloud Data Platform Engineers (45 resources) with deep hands-on expertise across Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Unity Catalog to strengthen our cloud data operations. These roles demand technical execution, not coordination—requiring strong engineering capabilities in infrastructure automation, FinOps, CI/CD, platform governance, environment management, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
The ideal candidates will have proven experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and well-governed cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cloud Platform Operations
Manage and optimize Azure workloads—ADLS, VNets, Key Vault, ADF, Synapse, Fabric, Databricks.
Configure and maintain Databricks clusters, jobs, DLT pipelines, Delta Lake storage, and Unity Catalog policies.
It was pleasure speaking to you as discussed invite has been shared with you for Monday 11 AM and sent in a sperate email and below is JD.
Job Description: Cloud Data Platform Engineer / SRE (Azure | Databricks | Fabric | Unity Catalog)
Role Overview
Operationalize Fabric Lakehouses, Pipelines, Warehouses, and Semantic Models for production workloads.
Ensure robust platform governance across environments (DEV–QA–UAT–PROD).
2. InfrastructureasCode & CI/CD
Build and maintain Terraform/Bicep templates for environment provisioning and configuration.
Develop end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for Databricks, Fabric, and Azure components (ADO/GitHub).
Automate deployment of notebooks, workflows, access policies, networking components, and Fabric artifacts.
Enforce version control, release governance, and quality gates.
3. FinOps, Cost Management & Capacity Planning
Implement FinOps dashboards, alerts, budgets, and spend governance practices.
Perform Databricks and Fabric cost optimization—cluster sizing, autoscaling, idle management, job tuning.
Conduct capacity planning for compute, storage, Fabric engines, and Databricks workloads.
Develop cost-saving recommendations and automated consumption monitoring.
4. Environment Management, Security & Governance
Provision and manage Azure data environments with consistent policies and naming standards.
Configure RBAC, ACLs, Unity Catalog grants, service principals, network security, Managed Identities.
Implement governance standards for data access, lineage, audit logging, compliance, and risk mitigation.
Ensure secure connectivity using Private Endpoints, VNET integration, and enterprise IAM controls.
5. Monitoring, Observability & Platform Reliability (SRE)
Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Databricks Metrics, Fabric Admin APIs.
Build runbooks, dashboards, and automated remediation workflows for platform reliability.
Conduct performance tuning of data workloads, Fabric pipelines, Databricks jobs, and storage layers.
Lead incident management, rootcause analysis, and environment stabilization efforts.
Required Skills & Experience
6–12 years in cloud data engineering, SRE, or platform engineering roles.
Strong hands-on expertise with:
Azure Data Services (ADLS, ADF, Synapse, Key Vault, VNets)
Azure Databricks (clusters, jobs, Delta Lake, DLT, Unity Catalog)
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Pipelines, Warehouse, Dataflows)
Unity Catalog governance (catalogs, schemas, access policies, lineage)
Strong scripting and automation experience: Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, PySpark.
Experience with Terraform/Bicep for IaC.
Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
Proven FinOps experience with cost governance and optimization across cloud workloads.
Experience in SRE practices—SLIs, SLOs, operational readiness, automated recovery.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications in Azure Data Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, Databricks Data Engineer, FinOps Practitioner.
Experience in highly regulated environments (BFSI, Healthcare, Retail).
Understanding of zero-trust security models.
Suitable Job Titles
Cloud Data Platform Engineer
Databricks Platform Engineer
Azure/Fabric DevOps Engineer
Cloud DataOps / SRE Engineer
Platform Reliability Engineer (Data Platforms)

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.

Job Description: SAP BTP Security Administrator
Position Overview:
We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Security Administrator with 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in SAP BTP administration and security management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing administration, custom authentication, authorization, connectivity, and overall BTP administration while ensuring seamless integration with customer IDPs and SAP ID Service.
Key Responsibilities:
1. SAP BTP Security [Mandatory]
Manage authentication and authorization for SAP ID Service and custom IDPs.
Administer SAP BTP Identity Access Governance (IAG) for role and policy management.
Configure trust and federation between UAA and SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS).
Hands-on experience & knowledge with Corporate Identity Provider (IDP) integration, authentication, user provisioning, and Single Sign-On (SSO) configurations.
Establish trust manually between UAA and any SAML-based IDP.
Configure custom identity provider login for Cloud Foundry environments.
Manage user provisioning from SAP ID Service for multi-environment subaccounts.
Shadow user management.
Hands-on experience in provisioning SAP S/4HANA roles to SAP BTP, ensuring secure user access, authorization mapping, and role synchronization.
Knowledge of integrating SAP BTP applications with IAS through application mapping, trust configuration, corporate IDP integration, and SAML/OIDC-based authentication.
2. SAP BTP Administration [Mandatory]
Perform BTP Basic Setup and manage global account/subaccounts.
Handle BTP service provisioning and administration.
Configure and manage BTP connectivity (Destinations, SAP Cloud Connector, and Authentication Mechanisms).
Perform BTP transport management and oversee application administration.
3. BTP Cloud Connector Administration [Good to have]
Manage SAP Cloud Connector configurations for secure on-premises connectivity.
Manager SCC certificates
5. Ticket Handling & Shift Support
Handle incident and service request tickets related to SAP BTP security and administration.
Should be ready to work in 24/7 shift support and on need basis.
Required Qualifications & Skills:
Education & Experience
Graduate in Information Technology / Computer Science or a related field.
5 to 7 years of relevant experience as an SAP BTP Administrator with a strong focus on security.
Technical Skills:
SAP BTP Security (Authentication, Authorization, Trust & Federation).
SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS) & Identity Provisioning Service (IPS).
SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect for authentication.
SAP BTP IAG (Identity Access Governance) administration.
SAP Cloud Connector setup and management.
Cloud Foundry CLI (CF CLI) for identity and access management.
Soft Skills:
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a 24/7 environment.
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Additional Information:
Location: Karadi, Pune / Remote.
Shift Timing: 24/7 Shift Support (also ready to stretch on need basis)
Employment Type: Full-time

Description:
SAP FICO - Senior Consultant

Experience: 3-8 Years
Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Kolkata, Bangalore, Trivandrum, Kochi, Coimbatore

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled SAP FICO Senior Consultant with strong experience in SAP Finance and Controlling modules. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP implementations, client interactions, solution design, testing, and support activities across ECC and/or S/4HANA environments.

Mandatory Skills
3-8 years of hands-on experience in SAP FICO.
Minimum 1 end-to-end SAP implementation experience is mandatory.
Experience in Greenfield and/or Brownfield implementation projects.
Strong expertise in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience in core FICO areas:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Bank Accounting
Cost Centre Accounting
Profit Centre Accounting
Experience in business requirement gathering, configuration, and solution design.
Hands-on experience in preparing Functional Specification Documents (FSDs).
Experience in UAT planning, execution, defect management, and user support.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
Experience supporting Go-Live, Hypercare, and post-production activities.

Responsibilities
Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
Configure and support SAP FICO processes as per business needs.
Conduct Fit-Gap analysis and recommend best practices.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams.
Support integration with other SAP modules.
Lead and assist UAT activities and business user training.
Support deployment, cutover, and Go-Live activities.
Engage directly with customers and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Good to Have
SAP FICO Certification.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation or migration projects.
Exposure to data migration and cutover activities.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Note: Candidates must have experience across at least one full-cycle SAP implementation from requirement gathering/design through Go-Live and Hypercare support.
