Description:
Risk Consulting EY Comply: Position: Senior Regulatory Reporting

Hands-on experience in From any of this form FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .

NOTE = 0 Days Notice or 1 Month Notice period
The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
Your Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the clients operating model.
Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controlsincluding maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have
4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–6 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

Job Description

Work Mode : Hybrid/Any of the office location
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon.

Job Summary Consultant-Oracle with HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), and HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) experience, responsible for delivering functional solutions and support across Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and related workforce scheduling processes.
Candidate must have relevant experience of 5 to 9 Years.

Qualifications and Skills
Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Hands-on functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional).
Practical experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), including writing, testing, and troubleshooting formulas.- Functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) or similar workforce scheduling tools.
Familiarity with end-to-end HCM processes, including core HR, absence, and payroll interactions with Time and Labor.
Ability to document requirements, configurations, and test scenarios clearly and concisely.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate business requirements into Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations.

Key Responsibilities
Work as a functional Consultant-Oracle for HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), ensuring accurate time capture, approvals, and integrations with payroll and absence management.
Configure, validate, and optimize HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional) to support complex business rules, calculations, and eligibility criteria across HCM modules.
Implement and support HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) to manage workforce scheduling, shift planning, and resource allocation.- Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, map them to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud capabilities, and design functional solutions for Time and Labor and workforce scheduling.
Perform end-to-end functional testing for OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS configurations, including regression testing for new releases and patches.
Support production incidents and service requests related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor, Fast Formula, and workforce scheduling, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, and user guides for Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud modules in scope.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions for HR, payroll, and operations teams on OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS functionalities.
Coordinate with technical teams for integrations, reports, and extensions related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and scheduling solutions.
Ensure adherence to best practices, governance, and compliance requirements in all Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations and deployments.

Other Capabilities
Strong understanding of Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor processes, including time entry, approval workflows, and time valuation rules.
Ability to interpret and design complex Fast Formulas to support business-specific rules and calculations.
Experience working with workforce scheduling concepts such as shifts, rosters, rotation patterns, and resource optimization in Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler).- Good stakeholder management and communication skills to work with HR, payroll, operations, and IT teams.
Capability to work in a consulting environment, managing multiple assignments and priorities with minimal supervision.
Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail in configuration and testing activities.

Description:
Role: We are seeking a highly skilled Context Layer Lead / Developer with expertise in Snowflake and/or Databricks to design, develop, and govern the enterprise semantic/context layer that powers analytics, AI, reporting, and business consumption across the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in data warehousing, dimensional modeling, metadata management, business semantic layers, and modern cloud data platforms. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, analytics teams, and product owners to ensure business-ready, trusted, and reusable data assets.
Key Responsibilities
Context Layer Design & Development
Design and implement enterprise context/semantic layers on Snowflake and/or Databricks.
Develop business-friendly data models that abstract underlying data complexity.
Define and maintain standardized business entities, KPIs, metrics, dimensions, and hierarchies.
Create reusable data products and business consumption layers for reporting, AI, and analytics.
Data Modeling
Design logical and physical data models.
Develop dimensional models including facts, dimensions, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions.
Ensure consistency across commercial, customer, product, territory, and transactional subject areas.
Pharma Metadata & Data Governance
Define and manage metadata standards and business glossaries.
Maintain lineage and traceability between source systems, transformed datasets, and business consumption layers.
Partner with data governance teams on data cataloging and master data initiatives.
Business Collaboration
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements.
Translate business requirements into scalable semantic and contextual models.
Facilitate workshops to define KPIs, metrics, and business rules.
Platform Engineering
Develop data models and curated layers within Snowflake and Databricks environments.
Optimize performance of semantic views and analytical datasets.
Implement reusable frameworks for metric calculations and reporting consistency.
Quality & Governance
Establish standards for context layer development.
Conduct code reviews and design reviews.
Ensure adherence to data quality, security, and compliance requirements.
Support release planning, testing, and deployment activities.
Leadership Responsibilities (Lead Role)
Mentor junior developers and data engineers.
Drive solution design discussions.
Coordinate across data engineering, analytics, reporting, and business teams.
Ensure delivery aligns with architecture standards and governance frameworks.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Role Purpose
Provide on-site leadership for critical business-impacting incidents and act as the primary customer-facing Major Incident Manager.

• Own mission-critical incidents impacting business operations.

• 3-7 years in IT Operations.
• Minimum 2-4 years in Major Incident Management leadership roles.
• Experience working with North American enterprise customers.

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Area Incharge-Mechanical
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Pellet Plant department. This role demands a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for overseeing the maintenance, reliability, and performance of all mechanical equipment and systems in the pellet plant. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize plant productivity. This position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, mechanical engineering principles, and team leadership within a heavy industrial environment.
Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the mechanical maintenance team to ensure optimal performance and reliability of pellet plant machinery and equipment.
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.
Coordinate with production and quality teams to align mechanical operations with plant production goals and quality standards.
Monitor and analyze mechanical equipment performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols and regulatory compliance within the mechanical department.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and tools.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on mechanical efficiency, cost reduction, and process optimization.
Oversee root cause analysis of mechanical failures and lead troubleshooting efforts to prevent recurrence.
Mentor and develop mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence and teamwork.
Collaborate with engineering and project teams on equipment upgrades, installations, and modifications.
Skills:
Mechanical Equipment Maintenance
Predictive and Preventive Maintenance
Root Cause Analysis
Team Leadership and Development
Budgeting and Cost Control
Safety and Regulatory Compliance
Performance Monitoring and Data Analysis
Project Management
Process Optimization
Inventory and Spare Parts Management
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; a Masters degree is preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in mechanical maintenance and operations within the steel manufacturing or heavy industrial sector.

Description:
Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential.
Manages group/catering opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC).
Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity.
Achieves personal and team related revenue goals.
Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience.
Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities & Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (eg, , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Manufacturing Engineer to optimize production processes, improve manufacturing efficiency, and ensure high-quality product output. The ideal candidate will work closely with production, quality, maintenance, and design teams to implement process improvements, reduce costs, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes to improve productivity and quality.
Analyze production workflows and identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction.
Design and implement tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing methods.
Prepare and maintain process documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Troubleshoot production issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Coordinate with design, quality, procurement, and production teams to ensure smooth product manufacturing.
Conduct time studies and capacity planning to improve operational efficiency.
Support new product introduction (NPI) and process validation activities.
Monitor key manufacturing metrics and recommend improvements.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.
Participate in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
22 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, and quality systems.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar) is preferred.
Experience with ERP/MRP systems is an advantage.
Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Description:
About Us :
Paytm is Indias leading mobile payments and financial services platform. As the pioneer of mobile QR payments, we empower millions of merchants and consumers to transact digitally. Our mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy using innovative technology.

About the team :
EDC & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the Role :
Were looking for a dynamic Team Leader to drive EDC device sales under the Railway Transit. You will be responsible for managing a team of field executives, driving distribution, and ensuring consistent growth in merchant onboarding and transaction volumes.

Key Responsibilities :
1. Lead and manage a field sales team of 5 or more members
2. Drive EDC machine sales and deployment in the oil & gas sector (e.g., petrol pumps, distributors, etc.)
3. Build and maintain strong channel partner relationships
4. Ensure target achievement through proper team coordination and ground execution
5. Monitor daily productivity, quality of acquisitions, and incentive earnings
6. Train, guide, and motivate team to perform and scale
7. Analyze market trends and competitor activities
8. Regular reporting and MIS handling using Excel and sales tools

Requirements / Expectations :
1. Must have a smartphone, bike, and helmet
2. Minimum 3 years of experience in channel sales & distribution
3. Proven experience in leading field sales teams
4. Strong knowledge of merchant onboarding, incentives, and field sales operations
5. Experience in POS/EDC device sales will be preferred
6. Familiar with metrics-based sales tracking and incentive planning

Education :
Graduate (mandatory); Post-Graduation preferred

Job Description HR Recruiter
Experience: 1 Year
Location: Raipur, Chhattisgarh

Job Summary
We are looking for an HR Recruiter with 1 year of experience to manage end-to-end recruitment, candidate sourcing, interview coordination, and onboarding activities.

Key Responsibilities
Source candidates through Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other job portals.
Screen resumes and shortlist candidates as per job requirements.
Coordinate telephonic, virtual, and face-to-face interviews.
Communicate with candidates regarding interview schedules and feedback.
Manage recruitment for multiple positions across departments and locations.
Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.
Coordinate salary discussions, offer letters, and joining formalities.
Follow up with selected candidates to ensure timely joining.
Required Skills
Minimum 1 year of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic knowledge of recruitment processes and job portals.
Proficiency in MS Excel, email, and documentation.
Ability to manage multiple vacancies and meet hiring deadlines.
Qualification: Graduate in any discipline, preferably in HR or Business Administration.

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.
Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the F&B Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Position Overview
We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Sales Representative to develop sales and distribution in the assigned territory.
The candidate will be responsible for appointing and developing Stockists/Distributors, generating Primary & Secondary Sales, increasing retail coverage, opening new outlets, and achieving monthly sales targets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop potential Stockists / Distributors in the assigned territory.
Assist in appointment and activation of new Stockists/Distributors.
Generate Primary Sales from Stockists/Distributors as per assigned targets.
Drive Secondary Sales through regular retailer and market visits.
Visit retailers, wholesalers and dealers according to the assigned beat plan.
Generate regular orders from existing and new retail outlets.
Open new retail outlets and increase numerical distribution in the territory.
Ensure availability and visibility of company products at retail outlets.
Develop new markets, towns and sales opportunities within the assigned area.
Build strong relationships with Stockists, Distributors, Wholesalers and Retailers.
Ensure adequate stock availability with Stockists/Distributors.
Implement company schemes, promotions and new product launches in the market.
Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes and market activities.
Follow up with distributors for orders, supplies and payments where required.
Maintain daily market visit, order booking and sales reports.
Achieve monthly Primary Sales, Secondary Sales, Outlet Coverage and New Outlet Opening targets.
Candidate Profile
* Experience: fresh or 1-2 years in Field Sales / General Trade / Distribution Sales.
* Experience in FMCG / Food / Consumer Products / General Trade preferred.
* Good understanding of Primary and Secondary Sales.
* Experience in retailer/dealer development and stockist handling preferred.
* Good knowledge of the local market and surrounding areas.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Target-oriented and willing to travel extensively in the assigned territory.
* Candidate should be comfortable with daily field visits.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will primarily be measured on:
* Primary Sales Achievement
* Secondary Sales Achievement
* New Stockist / Distributor Development
* New Outlet Opening
* Productive Calls / Daily Market Coverage
* Retailer Order Generation
* Product Availability & Visibility
* Achievement of Monthly Sales Targets

Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Shift Incharge
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to oversee and manage the operations of the Blast Furnace department during assigned shifts. The role demands a strong leadership presence to ensure the efficient, safe, and continuous functioning of blast furnace processes, aligning with the companys commitment to operational excellence and safety standards. The ideal candidate will coordinate with cross-functional teams, monitor production parameters, troubleshoot operational issues, and implement process improvements to optimize output and maintain product quality in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
Responsibilities:
Lead and supervise all activities within the blast furnace department during the assigned shift, ensuring adherence to production schedules and quality standards.
Monitor and control blast furnace operations, including temperature, pressure, and raw material feed rates, to maintain optimal process conditions.
Ensure strict compliance with safety protocols and environmental regulations to maintain a safe working environment for all personnel.
Coordinate with maintenance teams to schedule and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities to minimize downtime.
Analyze operational data and generate shift reports highlighting performance metrics, deviations, and improvement opportunities.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality.
Train, mentor, and evaluate shift personnel to build a competent and motivated team capable of meeting production targets.
Respond promptly to operational emergencies and troubleshoot technical issues to restore normal operations swiftly.
Collaborate with quality control and engineering departments to resolve production challenges and implement best practices.
Ensure proper documentation and record-keeping of all shift activities, incidents, and maintenance work.
Skills:
Blast Furnace Operation Management
Process Optimization
Safety and Environmental Compliance
Team Leadership and Development
Preventive and Corrective Maintenance Coordination
Operational Data Analysis
Emergency Response and Troubleshooting
Production Planning and Scheduling
Quality Control Collaboration
Technical Documentation and Reporting
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized institution.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in blast furnace operations or heavy manufacturing environments, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or shift leadership role.

2. Provide on-the-job coaching, mentoring, and demonstrations of best practices.
3. Develop structured training modules to enhance knowledge of scaffold erection, modification, and dismantling

From the foundation to the frame.

Title: Logistics Executive
Education: B.C.A. in Any Specialization, B.Com in Any Specialization, B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization, B.A - Bachelor of Arts in Any Specialization, B.Sc in Any Specialization
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Logistics ManagerSupply Chain ManagementDispatch ManagementSteel IndustryTMT Steel., TransportationFreight ManagementSAPERPVendor Management, About company, We Are JK Lakshmi Steel
Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including dispatch planning, transportation, and delivery of finished steel products such as TMT bars.
Plan and monitor daily vehicle placement, loading, dispatch schedules, and timely delivery to dealers, distributors, and customers.
Coordinate with Sales, Production, Warehouse, and Finance teams to ensure smooth dispatch operations.
Manage transporters and logistics vendors, negotiate freight rates, and optimize transportation costs.
Monitor vehicle utilization, freight expenses, transit time, and delivery performance.
Ensure proper documentation for dispatches, including invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documents.
Track shipments and resolve delivery delays, transit issues, and customer complaints.
Ensure compliance with applicable transportation regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
Monitor logistics budgets, transport bills, freight reconciliation, and cost-control initiatives.
Maintain MIS reports on dispatches, freight costs, vehicle availability, and delivery performance.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce logistics costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Operations will be an added advantage.
Relevant experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, or supply chain management, preferably in the steel, cement, manufacturing, or infrastructure industry.
Experience in managing bulk material transportation, heavy vehicles, transporter networks, and dealer/customer deliveries.
Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, freight negotiation, vehicle utilization, and logistics cost optimization.
Working knowledge of GST-related transport documentation, e-way bills, invoicing, and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in MS Excel and experience with ERP/SAP systems will be preferred.
Strong vendor management, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple dispatches and operational priorities.
Willingness to travel and work at plant or logistics locations as per business requirements.
AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

Title: Accountant

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage daily accounting operations, GST compliance, ledger reconciliation, financial reporting, and documentation. Candidates with experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading industries will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day accounting entries, journal vouchers, and general ledger maintenance.
Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and vendor/customer reconciliations.
Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and monitor outstanding balances.
Assist in GST returns, TDS compliance, and input tax credit reconciliation.
Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment documents.
Maintain inventory and stock reconciliation records related to steel purchases and sales.
Monitor freight, transportation, and other operational expenses.
Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense statements, and account summaries.
Support internal audits, statutory audits, and month-end closing activities.
Work on accounting software/ERP such as SAP, Tally, and MS Excel.
Candidate Requirements
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com or MBA Finance preferred.
25 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
Good knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting principles, and reconciliations.
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software/ERP.
Experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading companies will be an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Key Skills:
Accounting | GST | TDS | Accounts Payable | Accounts Receivable | Bank Reconciliation | Ledger Reconciliation | MIS Reporting | MS Excel | SAP | Tally | Inventory Accounting.

Preferred Industry: Steel / Iron & Steel / Manufacturing / Trading.
AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Role & responsibilities :
Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments and develop individualized treatment and rehabilitation plans.
Provide physiotherapy interventions for orthopaedic, neurological, cardiopulmonary, sports, geriatric, paediatric, and post-operative conditions, as applicable.
Deliver bedside physiotherapy, early mobilization, respiratory care, mobility training, and functional rehabilitation for admitted patients.
Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans based on clinical requirements.
Manage inpatient and outpatient referrals, follow-ups, and continuity of rehabilitation care.
Educate patients and caregivers on exercises, posture, mobility, home rehabilitation, and preventive care.
Maintain accurate clinical records and comply with hospital protocols, infection control, and patient safety standards.
Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals for integrated patient care.
Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, NABH-related activities, and departmental development.
Contribute to health camps, awareness programs, research activities, and continuous professional development.
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.
JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
District Head Land Acquisition | Industrial Project
Project

Industrial Project
Function

Land Acquisition / Project Development
Experience

15-20 Years of Relevant Experience
Location

Assigned District / Project Location
Reporting

State Head - Land Acquisition
Role Focus

Land Acquisition, District Management & Stakeholder Management

LAND ACQUISITION • DISTRICT MANAGEMENT • GOVERNMENT LIAISON • STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
1. Role Overview
The District Head - Land Acquisition will be responsible for leading, managing and monitoring all land acquisition and land readiness activities within the assigned district for the Industrial Project. The role covers district level execution of land identification and sourcing, private and government land acquisition, title verification and due diligence, revenue documentation, statutory approvals, government liaisoning, stakeholder management, negotiations and timely possession/handover of required land parcels. The District Head will lead and coordinate the district land acquisition team, including Project Leads and Project Support personnel, and act as the key interface between the State Head, client/project teams, landowners, local stakeholders, legal teams, consultants and District/Revenue Authorities.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Land Identification, Sourcing & Acquisition
Lead and monitor end to end land identification, sourcing, aggregation and acquisition activities across the assigned district.
Prepare and monitor district wise and village wise land acquisition plans in line with project requirements and timelines.
Ensure identification of suitable land parcels, preparation of land schedules, identification of landowners and plotting of required land on village/revenue maps.
Manage acquisition of private and government land through applicable State policies, revenue/allotment processes, LARR, surface rights, industrial development authorities or other applicable mechanisms.
Monitor parcel wise land aggregation, including area, ownership, acquisition status, documentation, possession and pending requirements.
Monitor private, government and other project relevant land processes applicable within the district.
B. Title Verification, Due Diligence & Legal Coordination
Oversee title verification and land due diligence covering ownership records, revenue records, encumbrances, disputes, transferability and other title related matters.
Coordinate with Legal teams and consultants for Title Search Reports (TSRs), legal opinions, agreements and resolution of title related issues.
Ensure proper collection, maintenance and updating of land documents, approvals, correspondence, agreements, survey records and other project documentation.
Ensure acquisition activities comply with applicable legal requirements, approved commercial parameters and project timelines.
C. Government Liaisoning, Revenue & Statutory Approvals
Liaise and maintain effective working relationships with District Administration, Collectorate, Revenue Authorities, Tehsil offices and other relevant Government Departments.
Monitor statutory permissions, land-use requirements, revenue permissions and project related approvals.
Develop and maintain relationships with District Administration, Revenue Authorities, local bodies, landowners and key local stakeholders.
Coordinate with relevant authorities and internal teams on revenue documentation, record entries, permissions and other district level land matters.
D. Landowner Negotiations, Stakeholder Management & Handover
Lead and support negotiations with landowners and other stakeholders regarding land rates, transaction terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.
Handle landowner, stakeholder, documentation, revenue and coordination issues at district level, escalating material matters to the State Head.
Ensure post-allotment/acquisition activities, including measurement, demarcation, revenue record entries and possession/handover of land parcels, are completed.
Ensure required land parcels are handed over to the client/project team within agreed timelines and in accordance with project requirements.
Anticipate district level risks, local issues and stakeholder concerns that may affect acquisition timelines and initiate appropriate corrective action.
E. Project Coordination, Mapping & Progress Reporting
Coordinate with Survey, Project, Legal, Compliance, Documentation, Administration and other internal teams for timely execution.
Review land acquisition progress against project milestones and identify delays, bottlenecks and critical dependencies.
Monitor the use of Google Earth, maps, satellite imagery and revenue/village maps for land identification, access assessment and parcel tracking.
Coordinate land requirements relating to project infrastructure, access, utilities, connectivity and ancillary facilities.
Conduct regular field visits and review the progress of Project Leads and field teams.
Prepare and submit periodic MIS, district level land acquisition reports, risk reports and progress updates to the State Head/Management.
Ensure land acquisition and land readiness activities remain aligned with the project's development and implementation schedule.
F. District Level Management & Team Leadership
Take overall ownership of land acquisition activities within the assigned district.
Allocate villages, clusters and land parcels among Project Leads/field teams and monitor their performance.
Lead, guide and monitor Project Leads, Project Support personnel and other field resources deployed within the district.
Set clear acquisition targets and timelines for the district team.
Review team performance, field activities, pending cases and documentation status regularly.
Guide team members in resolving landowner, revenue, documentation and local stakeholder issues.
Ensure effective coordination and communication between field teams and State/Head Office functions.
Ensure discipline, accountability and accurate reporting within the district land acquisition team.
Conduct periodic reviews with Project Leads and Project Support teams to ensure targets, documentation and timelines are achieved.
Provide accurate district level information to the State Head for management/client reviews and decision-making.
G. Authority, Accountability & Risk Escalation
Act as the primary district level authority for day-to-day land acquisition and land readiness activities.
Represent the project for routine coordination with district level authorities, landowners and other stakeholders.
Take appropriate operational decisions within approved commercial, legal and organisational parameters.
Escalate significant legal, commercial, regulatory, political/local stakeholder and project risks to the State Head.
Remain accountable for district wise land acquisition targets, documentation completeness and timely possession/handover of land.
3. Required Experience & Qualifications
8-12 years of relevant experience in Land Acquisition, Land Aggregation, Industrial Projects, Infrastructure, Energy, Real Estate or a closely related field.
Graduate qualification in Law, Engineering, Management, Commerce or another relevant discipline.
Strong hands on experience in managing land acquisition at district/project level.
Experience dealing directly with District Administration, Revenue Authorities, landowners, consultants and project stakeholders.
Practical experience in private and government land acquisition, title verification, due diligence, revenue documentation and statutory processes.
Demonstrated experience in landowner negotiations and resolution of complex land related issues.
Experience in leading and managing field based land acquisition teams.
Working knowledge of applicable State land/revenue framework and local acquisition environment.
4. Core Skills & Competencies
Land Acquisition & Aggregation
District Level Land Acquisition Management
Private & Government Land Processes
Title Verification & Due Diligence
Revenue Records & Land Documentation
Government Liaisoning & Statutory Approvals
District Administration Coordination
Landowner & Stakeholder Management
Commercial & Landowner Negotiation
Team Leadership & Performance Management
Survey, Demarcation & Field Coordination
Google Earth / Map Based Site Assessment
Risk Identification & Problem Solving
MIS, Documentation & Progress Reporting
Strong Communication & Negotiation Skills
Working knowledge of the local language and local land/acquisition environment (preferred)
Languages: English, Hindi and Local Language (preferred)
5. Key Success Measures
The District Head - Land Acquisition will be expected to ensure that the required land parcels within the assigned district are identified, legally and commercially assessed, acquired through applicable processes, properly documented and handed over in accordance with agreed project timelines.
Success will be measured through achievement of district-wise land acquisition targets, timely resolution of land and stakeholder issues, effective government liaisoning, accuracy and completeness of land documentation, performance of the district land team and timely possession/handover of encumbrance free land required for uninterrupted project execution.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. *Accounting Operations*

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions.
* Maintain books of accounts, journals, vouchers, and supporting records.

2. *Accounts Payable & Receivable*

* Monitor vendor and customer accounts.
* Track outstanding payments and receivables and ensure timely follow-up.

3. *Bank & Ledger Reconciliation*

* Conduct regular bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies.

4. *Statutory Compliance*

* Maintain records related to *GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements*.
* Coordinate with the CA for timely compliance and documentation.

5. *MIS & Financial Reporting*

* Prepare accurate and timely MIS and financial reports.
* Provide required financial information to management for decision-making.

6. *Financial Documentation*

* Verify and maintain invoices, bills, receipts, payment vouchers, and other financial documents.
* Ensure systematic and confidential record maintenance.

7. *CA & Audit Coordination*

* Coordinate with the Chartered Accountant and auditors.
* Provide required financial data and supporting documents within timelines.

8. *Expense & Payment Management*

* Verify expense claims and supporting documents.
* Process payments in accordance with company policies and approvals.

9. *Accuracy & Internal Controls*

* Maintain high standards of accuracy in accounting and reporting.
* Ensure compliance with established financial procedures and internal controls.

10. *Process Improvement*

* Identify gaps in existing accounting processes.
* Recommend practical improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and reporting.


Preferred candidate profile

Candidates with practical experience in end-to-end accounting operations.
Experience coordinating with CAs and handling compliance-related documentation.
Ability to work inbajadependently while coordinating with management.
Preference may be given to candidates who can join at the earliest.
AboutCompany: Bajaj Real Estate is a Raipur-based real estate consultancy specializing in commercial real estate, retail leasing, property investments, and business expansion solutions. With a focus on helping businesses find the right locations and investors identify suitable opportunities, the company provides real estate advisory services across multiple sectors in India.

Sales Consultant Automobile
Company: Mahadeva Mahindra

Roles and Responsibilities

1. Customer Handling: Welcome customers to the showroom and understand their vehicle requirements, preferences, and budget.
2. Vehicle Demonstration: Explain vehicle features, specifications, performance, safety features, mileage, and benefits to customers.
3. Test Drives: Arrange and conduct test drives to help customers understand the vehicle's performance.
4. Sales Target Achievement: Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall dealership sales performance.
5. Lead Generation: Generate new leads through customer references, follow-up calls, walk-in customers, and digital enquiries.
6. Customer Follow-ups: Regularly follow up with prospective customers and convert enquiries into sales.
7. Booking and Documentation: Handle vehicle bookings, customer documentation, and coordinate with the finance and insurance teams.
8. Finance and Insurance: Assist customers with vehicle loans, insurance, and other related services.
9. Coordination with Departments: Coordinate with CRM, PDI, accessories, and delivery teams to ensure a smooth vehicle delivery process.
10. Customer Relationship Management: Maintain good relationships with existing and prospective customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.
11. Competitor Knowledge: Stay updated on competitor vehicles, market trends, pricing, and promotional offers.
12. Sales Reporting: Maintain daily sales reports, enquiry records, follow-up details, test-drive records, and booking updates in the dealership's CRM/DMS system.
13. Customer Satisfaction: Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the sales process, from the first enquiry to vehicle delivery.
Required Skills
13 years of experience in automobile sales.
Good communication and negotiation skills.
Strong customer-handling and convincing abilities.
Knowledge of vehicle features and specifications.
Target-oriented and customer-focused approach.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with CRM/DMS systems.
Key Objective: To generate leads, convert enquiries into vehicle sales, achieve monthly targets, and deliver excellent customer service.

JOB SUMMARY
Assists the Director of Security in managing security operations on a daily basis. Areas of responsibilities include the protection and safety of property assets, employees, guests and property, accident and fire prevention and response.   CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 1 year experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

Managing Security Operations
- Assists in the development and implementation of emergency procedures.
- Recommends follow-up action for security breaches.

Position Overview : Sales & Marketing Head

Department: Sales & Business Development
Location: Head Office, Raipur, Chhattisgarh
Experience: 5-10 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a results-driven Sales & Marketing Head to lead our pan-India sales operations from the Head Office in Raipur. The role will be responsible for developing sales strategies, driving revenue growth, managing the head office and regional sales teams, and expanding the company's market presence across India.

Key Responsibilities
Sales Strategy & Business Growth: Develop and execute pan-India sales strategies, annual business plans, and market expansion initiatives.
Revenue & Target Ownership: Drive national sales targets, revenue growth, profitability, and sales budget performance.
Team Leadership: Lead, monitor, and develop the head office and regional sales teams to maximise productivity and performance.
Performance Management: Establish sales KPIs, review individual and team performance, identify gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
Business Development: Identify new markets, customer segments, industrial clients, distributors, and strategic business opportunities.
Sales Planning & Reporting: Manage sales forecasting, pipeline reviews, MIS dashboards, CRM utilisation, and periodic performance reports.
Key Account Management: Build and strengthen relationships with major industrial customers, business partners, and key accounts.
Pricing & Negotiation: Develop pricing strategies, negotiate commercial terms, and support profitable business acquisition.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with plant operations, finance, and supply chain teams to align sales commitments with pricing, production capacity, inventory, and delivery.
Sales Team Development: Drive team training, territory planning, incentive structures, and performance improvement initiatives.

Candidate Requirements
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Management preferred.
5-10 years of experience in B2B or industrial sales, including sales leadership responsibilities.
Proven experience managing regional or pan-India sales teams and achieving business targets.
Strong expertise in sales strategy, revenue growth, business development, forecasting, and commercial negotiations.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder
management skills.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic NRI Banking Acquisition Relationship Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for acquiring and managing relationships with Non-Resident Indian (NRI) clients, providing them with tailored banking solutions, and ensuring exceptional customer service.

- Actively prospect and acquire new NRI clients through various channels, including referrals, networking, and outreach efforts.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with NRI clients, understanding their financial needs, goals, and preferences.

- Collaborate with internal teams to deliver comprehensive banking solutions to NRI clients, including wealth management, and banking services.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or related field.
- Proven track record of success in acquiring and managing NRI clients within the banking or financial services industry.
- Strong understanding of NRI banking products, services, and regulatory requirements.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with NRI clients.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficiency in relevant software and CRM systems

Description:
Maintains the transient rooms inventory for the hotel(s) and responsible for maximizing transient revenue.
The Revenue Manager releases group rooms back into general inventory and ensures clean booking windows for customers.
The position recommends pricing and positioning of cluster properties.
In addition, the position oversees the inventory management system to verify appropriateness of agreed upon selling strategies.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data
- Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Using computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Conducts sales strategy analysis and refines as appropriate to increase market share for all properties.
- Maintains accurate reservation system information.
- Analyzes period end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.
- Generates updates on transient segment each period.
- Assists with account diagnostics process and validates conclusions.
Executing Revenue Management Projects and Strategy
- Updates market knowledge and aligns strategies and approaches accordingly.
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Attends meetings to plan, organize, prioritize, coordinate and manage activities and solutions.
- Establishes long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them.
- Takes a predetermined strategy and drives the execution of that strategy.
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc).
- Explores opportunities that drive profit, create value for clients, and encourage innovation; challenges existing processes/systems/products to make improvements.
- Provides revenue management functional expertise to cluster general managers, leadership teams and market sales leaders.
- Ensures hotel strategies conform to brand philosophies and initiatives.
- Ensures that sales strategies and rate restrictions are communicated, implemented and modified as market conditions fluctuate.
- Prepares sales strategy meeting agenda, supporting documentation.
- Communicates proactively with properties regarding rate restrictions and strategy.
- Manages rooms inventory to maximize cluster rooms revenue.
- Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.
- Leads efforts to coordinate strategies between group sales offices.
- Supports cluster selling initiatives by working with all reservation centers.
- Uses reservations system and demand forecasting systems to determine, implement and control selling strategies.
- Checks distribution channels for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning.
- Ensures property diagnostic processes (PDP) are used to maximize revenue and profits.
- Initiates, implements and evaluates revenue tests.
- Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue management processes.
- Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.
- Understands and communicates the value of the brand name as it relates to franchise partnerships and revenue management opportunities.
- Promotes and protects brand equity.
Building Successful Relationships
- Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships in a proactive manner.
- Acts as a liaison, when necessary, between property and regional/corporate systems support.
Additional Responsibilities
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Attends staff/forecast/long range meetings as requested by properties.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales
