Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Description:
Role & responsibilities


Responsibilities
Client Service
Maintain and build internal and external client relationships by providing exceptional client service
Commit to  proactively connecting and building rapport with both internal and external clients 
Assist with resolving complex client issues and suggest favourable solutions
Invoicing
Maintain client codes in the firms proprietary accounting software based on information provided by the partner and/ormanager .
 Validate the job record billing details and add projects to the job, if required
Confirm invoicing arrangements with the client representative prior to issuing the first invoice to ensure high accuracy
Monitor WIPs, review engagement letters to determine fees to be charged, and liaise with practice managers to capture out of pocket expenses
Draft, finalize, and issue invoices to clients on a timely basis to support achievement of partners’ monthly billing targets 
Reconcile and relieve  related time and expense charges in the firm’s proprietary accounting software 
Liaise with practice managers to ensure internal revenue allocations are agreed in advance and billed as part of the progress billing cycle where applicable
Respond to client queries regarding invoices, including preparation of analyses and preparation of amended invoices when required (as directed by the partner/manager)
Prepare, finalize and issue credit notes 
Prepare bad debt request forms or cash transfer request forms with partner approval
Update and manage billing schedules 
WIP Management 
Prepare monthly detailed analysis of WIP (as required by the partner/manager) to ensure the WIP value reflects what is expected to be recovered in fees from the client. Prepare month-end WIP provisions for review with partner/manager to properly value WIP
Monitor the partner’s overall financial investment, including WIP, A/R and cash collection actuals to target and develop action items to achieve these
Track fees against budgetto confirm proper WIP valuation
Generate reports using the firm’s proprietary accounting software to help monitor a partner’s  engagement economics Advise on unusual WIP activities or budget rates that fall outside of the normal thresholds
Update and maintain billing schedules 
Respond to queries  in relation to engagement financial performance
Prepare and maintain Year-to-Date fee summaries as required
Accounts Receivables
Monitor partners’ monthly cash collection target and actual cash to support achievement of target
Respond to requests from National Finance with respect to cash allocations
Initiate reminders to clients and diligently follow up to ensure timely resolution, as directed by manager/partner
Pull monthly aged A/R reports and review with partner to determine actions required for aging accounts
Work with your manager to escalate outstanding collections with Third Party Collections, as directed bypartner
Maintain A/R notes against the bill record to describe any follow up activities performed 
Review the Electronic Funds Transfer database and post dated cheques log regularly, and action tickets as required


SHIFT:6.30pm-3.30am

Our global strategy The New Equation’ reflects how we solve important problems facing the world— today and tomorrow. In India, we operate as PwC India and PwC Acceleration Centers. PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), formerly Service Delivery Centers, include two entities in India – Acceleration Center Kolkata and Acceleration Center Bangalore. The Acceleration Centers in India are diverse, global talent hubs focused on delivering value to our clients – providing virtual client engagement support around the world and across all PwC’s services and capabilities. A role in PwC AC will provide you opportunities to apply skills beyond the workplace to create ground-breaking solutions for engagement teams, clients and our communities

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
• Design and implement microservice-based applications using Python and
frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and services with strong understanding of REST
principles and ORM.
• Build feature-rich full stack applications and chatbots using Generative AI APIs and
AI coding tools.
• Implement LLM-powered features using frameworks such as LangChain,
LangChain.js, LangChain4j, Spring AI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Autogen.
• Integrate Azure OpenAI Service and work with providers such as OpenAI, Gemini,
Amazon, and Claude.
• Build RAG pipelines, work with vector databases and embeddings, and utilize tools
like LangSmith for basic usage metrics.
• Develop event-driven systems using Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka for AIpowered workflows.
• Optimize application performance and ensure responsiveness, reliability, and
scalability.
• Implement automated testing, unit testing, and CI/CD pipelines; perform debugging
and code quality improvements.
• Containerize and orchestrate services using Docker and Kubernetes; deploy on
Azure/AWS/GCP (PaaS and IaaS).
• Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate
models.
• Follow best practices for security and documentation.
Requirements:
• 6+ years as a full stack or backend developer with proficiency in Python; fair to
strong experience with JavaScript frameworks/libraries (Angular, React).
• Strong software development skills across design, development, testing,
deployment, and maintenance of large-scale applications.
• Experience with RESTful APIs, asynchronous request handling, and ORM.
• Ability to build feature rich full stack AI integrated applications.
• Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data storage solutions; data
processing/manipulation and bulk data operations.
• Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD.
• Working experience deploying to Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Strong unit testing and debugging skills; strong experience with version control (Git).
• Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, multimodal
applications, agentic frameworks (fundamental level).
• Experience with data/ML frameworks and tools (PyTorch, LangChain, Autogen).
• Strong in data structures, architecture, and design; familiarity with Python threading
limitations and multi-process architecture.
• Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills; adherence to
security practices.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and cloud-native/serverless patterns (Azure
Functions, AWS Lambda).
• Experience exposing GenAI capabilities via APIs and embedding AI-driven UIs in
Angular/React.
• Experience with observability and basic telemetry for AI applications.
Good To have:
Certifications in AI/ML, Deep Learning and NLP from Learning platforms such as Coursera,
Udemy or equivalent.
Certifications on Cloud Architecture (GCP/Azure/AWS)
Experience building MCP servers or Agent to Agent applications.
Fine tuning LLMs and Hosting LLMs on Premises

Maximo JD:
Responsibilities
PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to
As a Senior Associate, youll work as part / lead a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution.
Lead by example for the team and provide evidence-based feedback in a timely and constructive manner.
Share knowledge and collaborate effectively within the team and among other project teams.
Work with existing processes/systems whilst making constructive suggestions for improvements.
Follow risk management and compliance procedures.
Keep up to date with technical developments for business area.
Communicate confidently in a clear, concise, and articulate manner - verbally and in written form.
Seek opportunities to learn about other cultures and other parts of the business across the Network of PwC firms.
Uphold the firm’s code of ethics and business conduct.
Maximo Job Description:
Analyzes customer business requirements and application objectives, develops configuration design, functional, and technical specifications to meet customer needs.
Knowledge on Maximo Architecture and at least one business add-on.
Customize/Configure, test, and deploy IBM Maximo through all phases of the implementation life cycle
Serve as the Maximo Application Administrator, providing technical advice to the team along with guidance to the client on complex system implementation.
Monitor and manage the quality of development within the team for deliverables.
Develop interfaces using Maximo Integration Framework (MIF)
Deploy solutions using various technologies, including XML, XLST, SQL, Java Message Service (JMS), Web Logic, WebSphere, SQL Server and/or Oracle databases
Program in Java and jython/python scripting languages to tailor IBM Maximo (including Maximo Integration Framework) for client requirements
Collaborate with consultants and other subject matter experts across the internal and external landscape
Provides technical advice on product implementation, integration, enhancement, or other projects as applicable.
Translate business and technical requirements into a project and architectural blueprint that achieves the desired business outcomes, including identifying solutions
Work with Product Owner/Business Analysts to understand functional requirements and interact with other cross-functional teams to architect, design, develop, test, and release features.
Design, develop and/or re-engineer application components, and integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms
Identify areas in the business process and convert them into Automation Ideas.
Skill set:
MAS 8 / Maximo 7.6/7.5/7.x, Maximo Java customization, PL/SQL, ETL and Data Conversion experience, Maximo Integration Framework (MIF), User Exit Classes, XLST/XML, TIBCO Middleware & SOAP/REST/JSON

Design, develop, and implement custom solutions in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP. Customize IFS modules to meet specific business needs by writing and modifying PL/SQL code, utilizing APIs, and creating custom fields, menus, and reports.

Collaborate with functional teams, business analysts, and project managers to gather requirements and create technical specifications. Document technical changes, configurations, and custom code to ensure knowledge transfer and system maintainability.
Provide technical support to resolve complex issues within the IFS system, identifying root causes and implementing timely fixes. Troubleshoot performance issues and recommend optimization techniques to enhance system efficiency.
Support the upgrade process for IFS Cloud, including testing, data migration, and user acceptance testing. Work closely with the IFS support team and internal IT to manage patches, upgrades, and enhancements.

Ability to manage development tasks within project timelines and adapt to changing priorities.

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Minimum 2 years of experience working with IFS Cloud and experience in Integration Experience.

Experience in at least 2 end to end implementation of any IFS Cloud Projects
Implementation and configuration knowledge across IFS Cloud ERP, EAM,
Demonstrated configuration expertise in core EAM processes (PM programs, work orders, resources, failure codes, materials).
Working knowledge of Projections/REST APIs, IFS Connect, security/permission sets, and data migration tools.
Strong PLSQL (Oracle) for troubleshooting and Reports.
Understanding of discrete and/or process workflows and how they integrate with IFS Cloud module.
Exposure to integration between IFS Cloud and other systems.

We are seeking an experienced SAP BASIS Manager to lead SAP BASIS service delivery for big engagements, customer engagement, and technical operations across enterprise SAP landscapes.

Position: SAP BASIS SME
Experience: 8-12 Years
IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP BASIS SME to provide technical leadership, administration, and support for complex SAP landscapes. The role involves managing SAP BASIS operations, driving system performance, ensuring platform stability, supporting project deliveries, and mentoring team members while collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Leadership & SAP BASIS Expertise
Subject Matter Expert for BASIS technical activities.
Lead installation, configuration, administration, and maintenance of SAP.
Manage system upgrades, enhancement packages, kernel upgrades, support packs, system refreshes, client copies, and transport management.
Ensure landscape stability, availability, performance, and compliance with operational standards.
Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for performance issues, dumps, job failures, interface failures, and system outages.
Manage day-to-day BASIS operations and provide leadership during major incidents and planned maintenance activities.
Collaborate with functional, development, database, and infrastructure teams to resolve complex technical issues.
2. SAP HANA & Database Management
Manage SAP HANA databases, administration, monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
3. Cloud & Integration Management
Support hybrid SAP landscapes and cloud integrations utilizing SAP Cloud Connector and SAP BTP services.
Oversee integrations with external systems through RFCs, Web Services, APIs, and middleware technologies.
Ensure cloud architecture best practices, security compliance, and operational efficiency.
4. Team Leadership & Governance
Lead and mentor a team of 10+ SAP BASIS consultants, providing technical guidance and support.
Establish and enforce SAP BASIS operational standards, governance processes, and best practices.
Drive proactive service management, capacity planning, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.
Ensure effective resource utilization, workload balancing, and operational readiness.
Lead critical incident management and support teams during P1/P2 situations.
Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
5. Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Act as the primary technical liaison between SAP, customers, internal delivery teams, and infrastructure partners.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to drive action items to closure and ensure timely issue resolution.
Conduct governance meetings, service reviews, and operational health checks.
Build strong customer relationships through effective communication and stakeholder management.
Required Skills & Experience
8+ years of SAP BASIS experience with proven experience in a Technical Lead role.
Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP Cloud, and RISE with SAP environments.
Extensive experience managing large and complex SAP landscapes.
Strong knowledge of SAP architecture across ABAP and Java stacks.
Experience leading teams and managing technical delivery for multiple SAP engagements.
Expertise in upgrades, migrations, refreshes, transport management, and performance optimization.
Excellent troubleshooting capabilities across SAP application, database, and infrastructure layers.
Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to drive continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
Good to Have Skills
Experience managing support services for multiple customers simultaneously.
Exposure to ITIL-based service management processes.
Experience with SAP automation and monitoring tools.
SAP certifications in BASIS, S/4HANA, HANA, Cloud, or related technologies.
Experience in global delivery and 24x7 support environments.

Description:
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with 4-8 years of overall experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on expertise in Python, Generative AI and Agentic AI, backed by a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Transformer architectures. This is a hands-on role where you will be expected to operate as a strong individual contributor while also being able to work at a lead capacity, engaging directly stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
Own features end-to-end, from problem framing and model development to API design, deployment, and scaling on the cloud.
Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems.
Engage directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
Design and develop REST/APIs and integrate AI models into services.
Scale applications and optimize performance for high-volume workloads.
Deploy and operate models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
Operate as a strong individual contributor and lead at a stakeholder engagement capacity.
Guide and mentor junior engineers.
Skills and attributes for success
Bachelors or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
4-8 years of overall hands-on experience in software/AI engineering (not limited to Generative AI).
Proven track record of delivering production-grade AI/ML solutions.
Very strong proficiency in Python and its AI/ML ecosystem.
Solid hands-on experience with Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning).
Strong foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts and techniques.
Good working knowledge of NLP and Transformer-based architectures.
Production-grade experience designing and developing REST/APIs and integrating AI models into services.
Demonstrated experience in scaling applications and optimizing performance for high-volume workloads.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
Experience in deploying and operating models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
Ideally, you’ll also
Hands-on experience building Agentic AI systems (multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, autonomous workflows).
Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search).
Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.
Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
Exposure to Azure AI/OpenAI services, Azure ML, and serverless deployments.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 
What we look for
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer with experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in .NET Framework/.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and web application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using .NET technologies.
Develop and maintain web applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices.
Optimize application performance and troubleshoot production issues.
Develop database objects such as stored procedures, functions, and triggers.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD implementations.
Work in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Required Skills
Strong experience in C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core/.NET
Experience with ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework.
Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database design, and query optimization.
Experience in developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Understanding of OOP, Design Patterns, SOLID Principles.
Experience with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery.
Knowledge of Version Control Systems such as Git and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with Unit Testing Frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest).
Preferred Skills
Experience with Microservices Architecture.
Exposure to Azure Cloud Services (App Services, Functions, Storage, Service Bus).
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
Hands-on experience with React.js or Angular.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Banking, Healthcare, Retail, or Enterprise domains.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Certification in Microsoft Azure or .NET technologies.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Description:
Key responsibilities are assigned based on an evaluation of the candidates professional qualification, relevant SPA and Disputes experience, analytical skills, and a demonstrated working knowledge of transaction value drivers and post-deal issues. As a Senior Associate in the SPA & Disputes team, you will work on EV to Equity bridge analysis, post-deal mechanisms and disputes matters, while collaborating with PwC UK teams on project deliverables. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work in a team performing analytical procedures on accounting and financial data to support transaction value assessments, and visualising insights using Excel and AI tools (training will be provided on these tools); Interpret and critically review transaction legal documentation and evaluate completion accounts and locked box mechanisms, identifying areas of value leakage or risk; Identify areas which may warrant further investigation / give rise to potential adjustments to price; Proactively work with team leaders and team members to manage a workload of multiple projects with competing priorities based on relative importance and urgency; Communicating confidently with engagement teams to understand scope and expectations, and present project deliverables once they have been completed; Supporting engagement setup from initiation through to completion, understanding workflow management tools, relevant application of AI tools, and ensuring accurate documentation of work performed; Participate in a wide range of projects and collaborate across multiple workstreams or teams; consistently demonstrating creative thinking, individual initiative and timely completion of assigned work; and Consistently demonstrate teamwork dynamics by working as a team member: understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; and proactively seek guidance, clarification and feedback.
Preferred Qualifications Strong interest in mergers and acquisitions, with the ability to understand key value drivers in transactions; Good knowledge of accounting fundamentals, price adjustment mechanics (e.g. net debt, working capital), and valuation principles; Familiarity with valuation methods and transaction mechanisms such as completion accounts and locked box structures; Demonstrated ability to analyse complex financial data and legal documents with precision; Proven track record of independently managing deliverables and maintaining high quality under tight deadlines; Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Self-motivated, with a strong commitment to personal growth and continuous learning; and Adaptable and eager to develop new skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Basic Qualifications Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Certifications requirement: CA/MBA; Good accounting and financial concepts; High level of attention to detail; 2-5 years experience in analysing financial accounting information (for example in audit or FDD); and Awareness of business valuations concepts (Enterprise Value vs. Equity Value) and transaction mechanisms (completion accounts vs. locked box).

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AI Engineer – Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving software and product innovation within our Technology Consulting practice. You will focus on developing innovative software solutions that enhance business performance and drive digital transformation for our clients. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will leverage your growing business knowledge to identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm, leading with integrity and authenticity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and identifying the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system, effectively mentoring others, and addressing conflicts or issues with clients and team members. You will uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading software engineering projects to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance
- Designing, coding, and testing applications using Python, React Native, and Flutter to deliver exceptional user experiences
- Managing application development and lifecycle management to optimize software solutions
- Implementing microservices architecture to improve system scalability and reliability
- Developing solution architecture and system software to support innovative product development
- Overseeing software project management to confirm successful planning, budgeting, and execution
- Mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in difficult conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
- Validating professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct
- Encouraging the use of innovative technologies and methodologies to enhance delivery and inspire teams
-Proven delivery of production full-stack systems (React + Python) and AI/ML or GenAI solutions
-Strong architectural judgment across front-end, back-end, and LLM/agent orchestration
-Deep familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, ReAct) and LLM orchestration
-Experience with enterprise integrations, distributed systems, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and security best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Excelling in application development and software design
- Utilizing Python and scripting languages for innovative solutions
- Managing software project lifecycles with Agile methodologies
- Leading teams in microservices architecture and system development
- Developing solutions with React Native and Flutter frameworks
- Troubleshooting complex issues in software engineering environments

Job Description: Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer

Job Title: Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer to design, develop, and support scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, and cloud-native application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build scalable Microservices-based applications following industry best practices.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party systems.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Implement secure, reliable, and reusable services with proper exception handling and logging.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and deployment activities.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and availability.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and estimations.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Java 8/11/17.
Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.
Hands-on experience in Microservices Architecture.
Strong knowledge of RESTful Web Services and API development.
Experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM frameworks.
Strong understanding of SQL databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, and version control practices.
Knowledge of Design Patterns, OOP Concepts, and SOLID Principles.
Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Spring Cloud, Eureka, Config Server, Feign Client, API Gateway.
Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging systems.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization technologies.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.
Understanding of distributed systems, resilience patterns, and service monitoring.
Nice to Have
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cassandra.
Knowledge of ELK Stack, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, E-commerce, Healthcare, or Telecom domains.
Certification in Java, Spring, or Cloud Technologies.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Keywords
Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Cloud, REST API, Hibernate, JPA, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, Jenkins, Maven, Git, Oracle, PostgreSQL, JUnit, Mockito, CI/CD, Distributed Systems.

You will be accountable for delivering projects successfully, maintaining standards, and inspiring your team to achieve quality outcomes. - Developing and maintaining relationships with clients to identify and address business challenges
- Promoting the adoption of innovative SAP technologies and practices across client projects

- Coaching team members to foster professional growth and development

What You Must Have

- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori

- Excelling in strategic technology planning and process optimization
- Embracing change and fostering innovation in client engagements
- Building trusted relationships through effective communication and teamwork

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Hiring: Associate Agency Development Manager (AADM) | Axis Max Life Insurance

Location: Madanapalle

Axis Max Life Insurance is looking for energetic and goal-oriented professionals to join our Agency Sales team as Associate Agency Development Manager (AADM).

Eligibility:

Graduate in any discipline
6 Months - 1 Year of Field Sales Experience
Local candidates preferred

Key Responsibilities: • Recruit and build a team of Insurance Advisors
• Train, mentor, and develop advisors for business growth
• Drive sales through the Agency Channel
• Achieve monthly business targets
• Ensure strong customer engagement and service

What We Offer:

Fixed Salary + Incentives + Performance Rewards
Career Growth Opportunities
Training & Development Support
Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Life Insurance companies


Interested candidates can share their updated resume or apply

CONTACT : Akriti HR - 9599669839
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary:
We are seeking dynamic and customer-focused professionals to join our Greenlight Hub team in Gurgaon as Customer Support Specialists. This role is central to empowering new driver partners by delivering exceptional in-person support, guiding them through onboarding, and equipping them with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. As a key member of our operations team, you will play a vital role in shaping the driver experience, ensuring smooth onboarding, resolving issues efficiently, and fostering a positive brand presence. The ideal candidate is a self-driven communicator with a passion for helping others, strong problem-solving abilities, and a proactive mindset. This is a temporary, contract position with potential for extension, offering a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization.

Responsibilities:
Deliver high-quality, in-person support to driver partners during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Guide new drivers through the onboarding process and introduce them to essential tools and resources.
Troubleshoot and resolve driver-related issues promptly and effectively.
Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting the company’s values and building enthusiasm among drivers.
Stay updated on company processes, tools, and policies to ensure accurate and consistent support.
Collaborate with the Driver Operations team to identify and implement process improvements.


Requirements
Any graduation degree.
Freshers or up to 1 year of experience in voice-based customer support.
Proven ability to handle in-person interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a resourceful mindset when addressing challenges.
Highly organized, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for empowering others.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Strong verbal communication skills in both English and Nepali. 

Location: Gurgaon Sec 39, Pune baner, Mumbai Kurla West, Bangalore - electronic city


Benefits

NTH: 17k
+
Incentives- Upto 6k depending on performance.

Job Description:
Credit Analyst (3-6 Years Experience)

Perform credit underwriting and appraisal for corporate/wholesale banking clients, including detailed credit reports
Prepare end-to-end credit proposals (industry & peer analysis, risk assessment, internal rating, documentation, collateral evaluation)
Conduct financial analysis (cash flow, working capital, leverage, EV, ratio analysis)
Evaluate loan structures, including term loans, working capital facilities, and trade finance exposures
Assess financial & non-financial covenants and monitor compliance
Analyze collateral/security structures (fund-based & non-fund-based limits)
Build and review financial models and projections

Required Skills & Experience
3-6 years of mandatory experience in Corporate Banking / Wholesale Banking credit roles
Strong experience in credit appraisal for large corporates / mid-market clients
Solid understanding of banking products (CC/OD, term loans, BG/LC, etc.)
Expertise in financial statement analysis, credit risk assessment, and rating frameworks
Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting

Cross-Finance knowledge and experience.
Knowledge of MREL regulatory reporting an advantage.

Description:
Join our team in Technology Strategy for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology
Practice:Technology Strategy & Advisory, Capability Network IAreas of Work:Tech M&A, Digital, Cloud, IT Strategy I
Level:Manager | Location:Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata | Years of Exp:10 to 15 years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:
Transaction Advisory and Strategy (Tech): Lead and support M&A transactions (Carve Outs / Separation / Mergers/ Integrations) with a focus on the technology sector, including IT infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, cloud computing, SaaS, AI, and emerging tech trends. IT Due Diligence and Financial and Financial Analysis: Manage and lead IT due diligence processes, evaluating financial, operational, technological, and legal aspects of technology companies / organizations being considered for acquisition. Industry & Technology Infrastructure Assessment:Understanding of client technology operations to grasp the context of global, industry, economic, technology, and social trends Draw Roadmaps for IT implementations: Pinpoint the right data-driven Digital, IT or Cloud technology strategy solutions for practical implementation road maps Monitor Digital, IT & Cloud Strategy: Managing change, monitoring, and gauging processes, and taking remedial steps
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Leverage your deep experience across technology strategy areas such as tech M&A Advisory, IT Separation / Integration Planning / Execution, Digital & Technology Strategy, Operating Model Design, Agile Operating Model Design, Workforce Transformation, Sourcing Strategy, IT Shared Services Strategy, Process Transformation, Value case/ business case formulation, Enterprise Architecture and Application Portfolio Strategy Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends. Understand and deploy the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement Create expert content and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership. Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals
Qualification
Your experience counts!
MBA from a tier 1 institute
Your prior experience-
5-8 years of M&A Advisory, Strategy Consulting or Investment banking experience
Experience in the example offerings:M&A advisory (tech), Separation planning & execution, Integration Planning & Execution, IT Due Diligence,
Experience in at least 2 of the example offerings:Tech Strategy, Tech Operating Models, IT Shared Services Strategy, Cloud Transformation, Industry & New Technology, Technology ROI/Cost Take Out, Modern Architecture, Data-Driven Enterprise
3+ years of experience in financial modeling, valuation analysis, scenario testing and writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives, process improvement initiatives, or IT transformation
2+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations
Good knowledge of technology and enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Mobility, Cloud, Digital, Collaboration
A strong understanding in any of the following industries is preferred:Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources or equivalent domains
Exposure to industry frameworks e.g. TOGAF, DODAF desirable but not essential.

Senior Manager – Human Resources (Corporate and Plant)
Lead end-to-end human resources, industrial/employee relations, statutory compliance, talent acquisition, and administration across both corporate offices and manufacturing/plant locations.
Reporting To: VP / Head of HR and Corporate Leadership
Key Focus: Aligning plant workforce productivity, blue-collar/white-collar management, and statutory laws with broader corporate goals.
Key Responsibilities
1. Plant & Blue-Collar / Staff HR Operations
F Manage end-to-end workforce planning, budgeting, recruitment, selection, onboarding, and deployment for both permanent and contractual/blue-collar labor.
F Monitor key plant metrics including absenteeism, attrition, overtime, workforce costs, and productivity.
F Oversee plant administration, security agencies, canteens, transport, and facility vendors.
2. Industrial Relations (IR) & Employee Relations
F Handle labor and industrial relations, worker grievances, disciplinary proceedings, domestic enquiries, and dispute resolution.
F Foster harmonious workplace relations, manage union/workmen interactions (where applicable), and support long-term settlement or negotiations.
F Act as an escalation point for employee relations and grievance handling across corporate and plant tiers.
3. Statutory Compliance & Legal Risk Management
F Ensure strict adherence to labor laws and statutory regulations (e.g., Factories Act, PF, ESI, Contract Labour Act, Payment of Wages Act, etc.).
F Coordinate labour inspections, statutory audits, and liaise with government and local regulatory authorities.
4. Talent Acquisition & Management (Corporate & Plant)
F Drive recruitment funnels from sourcing to joining for corporate roles and plant staff/shop-floor positions.
F Implement performance management systems (PMS), training and competency development plans, and succession planning.
F Support Corporate HR and L&D teams in rolling out organizational development and employee engagement initiatives.
5. Payroll Inputs & MIS Reporting
F Oversee monthly attendance, time-office data, and payroll inputs in coordination with Finance and Corporate HR.
F Prepare and present monthly HR Management Information Systems (MIS) dashboards, tracking KPIs, headcount budgets, and cost-reduction targets.

Preferred candidate profile
1. MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations (specialization in Labour Welfare is a strong plus with 10–18 years of progressive HR experience, with a blend of corporate HR and manufacturing/plant HR exposure.
2. Strong mastery of local labor legislation and statutory compliance.
3. Proficiency in HRMS, payroll systems, and MS Excel/MIS reporting.
4. Knowledge of HR technology and systems
5. Hands-on experience with blue-collar/contractual workforce management and industrial dispute handling.
6. Negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership.
7. Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment
8. Superb verbal and written communication abilities
9. Display proficiency in juggling multiple tasks and meeting multiple deadlines.
10. History of success in recruitment, problem-solving, and employee development
11. Ability to build strong relationships with all levels of management
12. Strong strategic thinking skills and the ability to drive change
13. Commitment to fostering employee engagement and satisfaction.

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job Title: Manager Strategy Consulting (Corporate Deals Technology)
Department: PwC Acceleration Center – Strategy Consulting
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview:

Join PwC’s Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team to partner with global corporate clients and drive technology strategy that fuels business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our CDT practice leverages deep industry knowledge and thought leadership to deliver consulting services focused on the technology elements of the value chain, enabling scalable and profitable business transformations.
As part of the Strategy platform, CDT supports corporate clients across industries by:

Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures through collaboration with C-suite executives.
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and uncover value creation opportunities.
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategies with business and operational goals.
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures that support strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
As a Manager, you will lead a team of experienced consultants solving complex business challenges from strategy through execution. Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and supporting teams across the deal spectrum, including IT due diligence, integration, and separation activities.
Managing project delivery, guiding teams, and engaging in client and leadership communication.
Overseeing solution design and implementation, ensuring high quality deliverables within timeline and budget.
Planning and developing integration and separation plans covering Day One readiness, business process, and systems alignment.
Developing financial models related to IT synergies, one-time costs, standalone operations, and stranded costs.
Recommending enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems informed by industry best practices and past experience.
Advising on IT integration, separation, and carve-out strategies across various IT domains.
Mentoring and coaching senior associates and associates to consistently deliver impactful work.
Contributing to business development initiatives by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Building strong internal relationships and strengthening your personal brand within PwC.

Preferred Knowledge & Skills:

Must-Have:

Proven experience in IT M&A including IT due diligence, integration, separation planning, and execution.
Expertise in IT Strategy and Digital Transformation initiatives.
Technical proficiency in key IT pillars such as Application Rationalization, Infrastructure/Cloud Strategy, Cybersecurity, and ERP Transformation.
Demonstrated ability to lead large teams through end-to-end client engagements.
Strong project management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Solid data and cost modeling capabilities.
Proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for efficient research and analysis.
AboutCompany: Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Job Title: Python Network Automation Engineer (L2/L3, OSPF)
Experience-6-14 Years
Location-Chennai/Bangalore/Gurgaon
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Python Network Automation Engineer with strong expertise in L2/L3 networking, OSPF routing, and network test automation using PyTest or PyATS. The ideal candidate will be responsible for network automation, validation testing, troubleshooting routing and switching issues, and developing scalable automation frameworks for enterprise networks.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Python-based network automation solutions.
Troubleshoot and support complex L2/L3 network environments.
Configure, validate, and troubleshoot OSPF routing protocols.
Develop automated test cases using PyTest and/or PyATS.
Perform network validation, regression testing, and pre/post-deployment verification.
Automate configuration backups, audits, compliance checks, and reporting.
Analyze packet captures and troubleshoot routing convergence issues.
Integrate automation solutions with REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and network management tools.
Perform root cause analysis for network incidents and outages.
Collaborate with network operations, engineering, and DevOps teams.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.
