Description:
About the Job:


The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Technical Service Manager with expertise in hybrid cloud platforms, cloud-native development, and middleware offerings to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will support our sales efforts for the Indian market. You'll work as part of a team responsible for creating solutions and presenting compelling recommendations to Red Hat's customers. Youll help our customers invest wisely in solutions that will give them maximum flexibility in the future, allowing them to run faster and more efficiently. As a Technical Service Manager, you'll need to have extensive technical expertise, passion for open source, thorough understanding of business processes, and the ability to identify and create business solutions at the enterprise level. You'll also need to have excellent communication and people skills as you'll be a crucial part of the first major experience our customers have with Red Hat.


What will you do


Manage incoming sales inquiries, coordinate services team responses, and create proposals for customers
Work closely with the partners to maximize project value
Negotiate rates, project costs, terms, and statements of work (SoWs) in collaboration with the regional services manager
Provide booking forecasts
Ensure that appropriate delivery associates are involved in validating scope of
engagements with your local services delivery manager
Participate in account strategy sessions
Meet or exceed assigned sales targets


What will you bring


Background selling complex customer solutions in a rapidly evolving technology environment
8+ years of experience focused on modern application delivery frameworks and platforms like Kubernetes and Docker, Red Hat OpenShift, Knative, Serverless, Apache Kafka, Istio, Service Mesh, EKS, AKS, Mulesoft, Jenkins, Apache Spark, MongoDB, etc.
Extensive experience with Hyperscalers, and expertise in cloud consumption models
Agile development and DevOps foundation, with ability to lead transformation motions
Natural storytelling ability with an above-average written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
Advanced presentation skill set with ability to present to executives at large companies
Background in consultative customer engagement with a consulting or technology company or organization
High level technical experience with cloud native and container technologies
Understanding and experience with agile methodologies and organisational and IT transformation
Ability to sell solutions in a multiproduct environment
Proven ability to work with global cross-functional teams and achieve success for customers
Ability to maintain a balance of strategic and tactical skills

Description:
About the Job:

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers strategic technical and architectural guidance along with hands-on technical support to key customers, enabling them to optimize their Red Hat infrastructure. This role cultivates strong relationships, develops deep technical expertise of customer environments and exercises good judgment to make informed decisions that impact customer success. The TAM is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction to resolve moderately complex technical issues. This role proactively coaches customers on best practices for utilizing Red Hat solutions, anticipates and mitigates potential customer challenges, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for assigned accounts. The TAM demonstrates a solid understanding of customer business needs and technical environments, contributing significantly to customer success and retention.

Note: This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws.


What You Will Do:

Proactively identify and address potential technical risks within customer environments.
Develop and support the implementation of solutions for complex technical challenges.
Provide hands-on support to the assigned customer
Collaborate with engineering and product management teams on customer escalations.
Conduct regular technical reviews with customers to ensure optimal performance.
Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in assigned Red Hat products.
Serve as a technical mentor for junior team members.
Contribute to the development of best practices and internal training materials.
Conduct regular account reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

What You Will Bring:

6+ years of experience working in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization
Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Dockers cluster management
Understanding of RHOCP Architecture different types of RHOCP installations
Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely
Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
Comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business partners with healthcare professionals across India to expand access to therapies that help diagnose and treat cardiac rhythm disorders. This role is part of the downstream marketing function, responsible for developing and executing portfolio strategy, supporting product launches, driving therapy adoption, and enabling commercial success across a diverse healthcare landscape. The position works closely with regional sales teams and cross-functional partners to execute market development initiatives, strengthen customer engagement, and support business growth for the CRM portfolio.
This position can be based in Gurgaon or Mumbai and follows a Flex work model. Travel up to 10% is required to support customer engagement, field collaboration, industry events, and strategic business initiatives across India.
As a Senior Marketing Specialist, you will lead downstream marketing initiatives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio across India. The role combines strategic planning, commercial execution, market development, and stakeholder engagement to drive portfolio growth. General Manager (GM) Sales - Commodity Chemicals
Leads commercial growth, market expansion, and P&L (Profit & Loss) accountability for industrial and bulk chemical product lines.
Driving top-line revenue growth, margin optimization, key account management, and strategic distribution networks across domestic and international markets for commodity/industrial chemicals (such as polymers, solvents, and basic organic/inorganic chemicals).
Key Responsibilities
Sales Strategy & Business Development
F Design and execute 3-year strategic roadmaps and Annual Business Plans (ABPs) aligned with organizational revenue and profitability targets.
F Identify and scale new business opportunities across domestic and export markets, targeting manufacturers, traders, and industrial end-users.

Product and Market Leadership

Description:
As a GenAI Full Stack Senior Associate you will support the design and development of full stack GenAI solutions, turning business needs into practical data and technology deliverables within our Data & Analytics Engineering practice. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build client relationships, and guide junior team members while navigating changing priorities and using critical thinking to shape solution delivery. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will apply data science methods, use modern development tools and techniques, interpret data for insights, and contribute to AI-driven automation and cognitive solutions that support client needs.
Responsibilities
- Design and develop responsive, performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), implementing reusable component libraries and ensuring design consistency.
- Optimize frontend performance through techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, caching, and efficient rendering strategies for scalable web applications.
- Build, secure, and maintain scalable REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python, handling business logic, data validation, and error handling.
- Develop and manage microservices architectures and design relational and NoSQL database schemas with optimized queries and migrations for production environments.
- Deploy applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for continuous integration and delivery.
- Collaborate closely with product managers to translate UX designs and user stories into pixel-perfect, accessible, and consistent user interfaces across devices and browsers.
What You Must Have
- Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications.
- Strong backend development skills using Node.js, Nest.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python frameworks, with solid understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
- Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively.

Responsibilities:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and identify opportunities to apply Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions to solve complex enterprise problems.
Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI and Agentic AI systems, including ReAct agents (Reasoning + Acting frameworks), multi-agent architectures, and autonomous AI workflows.
Build and deploy intelligent AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents using LLMs, tool-calling frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory modules, and agent orchestration patterns.
Ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment in AI-generated outputs through prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring mechanisms.
Develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to support GenAI applications, including fine-tuning, embeddings, and hybrid AI architectures.
Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering to prepare structured and unstructured data for machine learning and GenAI pipelines.
Collaborate with data engineers to design efficient data pipelines and integrate ML/LLM systems into scalable production environments.
Validate and evaluate model and agent performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, latency, hallucination rate, consistency scoring, human evaluation frameworks).
Develop and deploy production-ready AI applications using object-oriented programming principles, ensuring modularity, scalability, maintainability, and robustness.
Implement containerized AI solutions using Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration, scaling, and cloud-native deployments.
Design and implement tool-augmented agents, API-integrated workflows, and autonomous decision-making systems using modern AI agent frameworks.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate AI insights and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously stay updated with advancements in GenAI, Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, and emerging AI frameworks, recommending innovative approaches to enhance enterprise AI capabilities.
Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Proficiency in machine learning libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and data wrangling techniques.
Solid understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C++, or C#.
Experience developing and deploying machine learning applications in production environments.
Understanding data privacy and compliance regulations.
Relevant certifications in data science or GenAI technologies.
Development experience in system designing, proven track record of software delivery through all phases of development, critical thinking, ability to clearly communicate, present and lead.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience with Azure AI Search, Azure Doc Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, AWS Textract, AWS Open Search, AWS Bedrock.
Familiarity with LLM backed agent frameworks such as Autogen, Langchain, Langgraph Semantic Kernel, etc.
Experience in chatbot design, frontend and development.
Certification of cloud or Genai
Designed and implemented enterprise-grade GenAI solutions using Databricks Mosaic AI, enabling scalable LLM deployment and governance.
Built Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Mosaic AI Vector Search and Foundation Models for domain-specific knowledge querying.
Fine-tuned and deployed LLMs using Mosaic AI Model Serving, optimizing inference latency and cost.
Implemented secure LLM workflows with Unity Catalog governance and model tracking via MLflow.
Strong background in the Healthcare domain, with deep understanding of Payer operations and working knowledge of Provider ecosystems.
Experience in consulting engagements, including direct interaction with client stakeholders and managing client relationships.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing and mentoring teams of 510 members.
If you are passionate about GenAI technologies and have a proven track record in data science, join PwC US - Acceleration Center and be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of GenAI solutions. We offer a collaborative and innovative work environment where you can make a significant impact.
Preferred Qualifications:
BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc / M.E / M.Tech /Master’s Degree /MBA from reputed institute

You will lead the national market strategy, business development, driving revenue, market expansion, and P&L (Profit & Loss) accountability and operations for a hot stamping and decorative foil manufacturer for specialized metallic, pigment, holographic, and security foils.

Strategic & P&L Management

F Formulate and execute long-term strategic plans to penetrate metallic, holographic, pigment, and security foil segments.

Market Intelligence

Sales, Business Development & Channel Management

F Build, manage, and expand distributor networks, agent channels, and direct enterprise accounts.

Operations, Supply Chain & Technical Alignment

Team Leadership & Governance
F Hire, mentor, and lead regional sales managers and technical service teams.

6. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation mastery, cross-cultural communication, and basic technical understanding of foil-stamping machinery and substrates.

Donor Cultivation & Stewardship: Developing and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with individual, corporate, and foundation donors to secure ongoing financial support.
Campaign & Event Management: Planning, organizing, and executing fundraising campaigns and events, including community-led initiatives and major donor cultivation events.
Prospect Research: Identifying and researching potential donors, sponsors, and grant-making foundations interested in supporting the organization's mission.
Proposal & Grant Writing: Researching opportunities and writing persuasive grant applications and fundraising proposals to secure financial contributions.
Database & Financial Management: Creating and maintaining accurate donor databases, tracking donations, preparing financial reports, and managing budgets to meet fundraising goals.
Communication & Marketing: Creating fundraising materials, such as presentations, brochures, and thank-you letters, to effectively communicate the organization's mission and needs.
Fund Raising
Identify and cultivate relationships with potential donors, sponsors, and investors.
Create and implement fundraising campaigns and initiatives.
Develop compelling fundraising proposals and presentations.
Manage and maintain donor databases and records.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align fundraising efforts with our mission
and objectives.
Monitor and report on fundraising progress and results.
Qualifications & Experience:

4. Organizational: Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple projects and events simultaneously.
5. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including writing, editing, and public speaking.
6. Strong abilities to build and nurture relationships with diverse groups of people, including donors,
Career Focus
1. Fundraising in philanthropy is a people-focused role that requires strong empathy and communication to understand what inspires potential donors and to articulate the benefits of their support.
2. The job involves a significant focus on people and community, requiring the ability to effectively engage and inspire supporters for the cause.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

About The Role



Job Title - S&C Global Network - AI - Healthcare Analytics - Consultant

Job

Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.

Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.

Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.



Who are we looking for?
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)

Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Aligned to the strategic priorities of our clients, we are committed to activating human potential to drive enterprise transformation across industries. Discovering stakeholders challenges and expectations and defining a Change Management strategy to support business transformational change programs

Strong project management skills to plan, execute, and deliver content initiatives successfully. This includes managing timelines, budgets, resources, and coordinating cross-functional teams. An analytical & data driven mindset to drive result-oriented decisions

Value realization Crafting a value tree and d eveloping business case s for implementation and scale up


Gen AI

Design and implement GenAI use cases

Own and drive RFP/RFI response coming in from Life Science customers

Description:
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading data migration projects using SAP BODS and SAP Data Services to support client objectives
- Analyzing legacy data and migration requirements in collaboration with SAP functional and technical consultants
- Designing and implementing data migration solutions, including transformation routines and data validation processes
- Managing the execution of data migrations, utilizing tools such as SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to enhance data quality and derive insights
- Creating technical specification documents to guide the development of data services jobs
- Supporting data cleansing activities using Information Steward, Excel, and SQL tools
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration to S/4 HANA as an added advantage
- Collaborating with clients to understand data needs and create visualizations and reports for data-driven decision-making
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Data and Analytics solutions, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW/4HANA), SAP Data Intelligence, or related data platform credentials
- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP BODS and Snaplogic
- Utilizing SAP Data Services for complex data migrations
- Excelling in data quality improvement and validation techniques
- Leading data migration projects with SAP Migration Cockpit
- Managing data integration using IDOCs and BAPIs
- Developing technical specifications for data services jobs

Description:
A career within SAP Consulting services, will provide you with the opportunity to help our clients maximize the value of their SAP investment with offerings that address sales, finance, supply chain, engineering, and human capital. We provide comprehensive consulting, system integration and implementation services across multiple SAP applications, products, and technologies.

As a Manager, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to it.

Years of Experience: Candidates with 9 plus years of hands on experience

Position Requirements:
* Thorough understanding of business process Make To Order (MTO), Make To Stock (MTS), Consignment, Third Party Sales, Intercompany Sales, Rebates, Credit Management, Billing Plans, Shipment etc.

* Hands-on experience in S/4HANA functionalities Business Partner, Advance ATP (AATP), Condition Contract and Settlement Management (CCM), BRF+ Output Management etc.

* Strong knowledge of Contract & Sales Order Processing, Delivery Execution, Invoicing, pricing procedures, taxes etc. Should be able to handle requirement gathering, blue printing, design, configuration, functional testing, data migration, test data setup for UAT etc.

* Able to analyze business requirements, provide conceptual and detail design to meet business requirements.

* Perform necessary SAP configurations, write detailed functional specifications (FSD) for development of ABAP custom programs, testing and implementing the solution.

* Integration experience with LE, EWM, PP, PS, HCM, MM & FICO

* Ability to read ABAP codes preferred

* Knowledge of S/4HANA is must.

Desired Skills:
Certification in S/4HANA is preferred.
Team lead experience.
Experience in SAP Transportation Management (TM), Hybris Billing (BRIM), C4C - Sales/Service/Marketing, Hybris Commerce
Experience in Activate Methodology.
Experience in JIRA, HP ALM and other PMO tools.

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Description:
Additional Job Description
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Senior Associate - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their operational efficiency by analyzing their needs and implementing tailored software solutions. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on Oracle's suite of applications, managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization. Your expertise will be crucial in configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and customer experience solutions to meet organizational needs.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to navigate complex situations and build meaningful client relationships. You will guide and mentor junior team members, maintaining professional standards while developing a deeper understanding of the business context. Your role will involve anticipating client needs and delivering quality solutions, even when the path forward is not clear.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, and develop scalable Billing Platform solutions. Your ability to lead discussions, frame problem statements, and deliver technical solutions will be key to driving client satisfaction and project success.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing business requirements and conducting fit-gap analysis to develop functional and technical designs for Billing Platform solutions
- Configuring and customizing Billing Platform features including subscription management, pricing, invoicing, and revenue processes
- Developing integrations, workflows, and data migration solutions using APIs and scripting capabilities
- Collaborating with business stakeholders, solution architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable and secure solutions
- Supporting unit, system, and user acceptance testing, and resolving defects to validate solution quality
- Preparing technical and functional documentation and conducting knowledge transfer and user training sessions
- Troubleshooting production issues and performing root cause analysis to maintain solution performance
- Designing and developing integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, and taxation processes
- Leading solution workshops and delivering technical solutions aligned with Quote-to-Cash business processes
- Utilizing SQL and reporting tools to support data analysis and reconciliation activities
- Engaging with client stakeholders to gather requirements and recommend solutions that align with industry best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Demonstrating proficiency in BillingPlatform scripting and configuration
- Utilizing experience with Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs
- Developing integrations with enterprise applications like Salesforce and Oracle ERP
- Excelling in stakeholder management and communication skills
- Possessing hands-on experience with Zuora Billing and SAP BRIM applications

Description:
As an EDMCS -- Techno / Functional - Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for enterprise performance management solutions using Oracle technologies. You will collaborate with clients to assess their performance management needs, design and implement Oracle-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will be part of a dynamic team that helps clients optimize operational efficiency. You will be expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scope, using these experiences as opportunities to learn and grow.
Responsibilities
- Collaborating with clients to assess and address their performance management needs using Oracle technologies
- Designing and implementing Oracle-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle enterprise performance management tools
- Analyzing client needs to optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting
- Developing and applying business process analysis and financial planning skills to enhance client outcomes
- Engaging in strategic data analysis to inform financial planning and performance management
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) for advanced data insights and reporting
- Conducting process root cause analysis to identify and resolve operational challenges
- Supporting the development of key performance indicators (KPIs) to track and improve client performance
- Participating in the creation and management of budgets to align with client strategic objectives
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Finance, Management Information Systems, Economics, Business Administration/Management
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Enterprise Performance Management or related Oracle EPM Cloud applications
- Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE)
- Utilizing strategic data analysis for informed decision-making
- Applying business process analysis to optimize operations
- Developing financial forecasting models to enhance profitability
- Excelling in communication and teamwork within diverse environments
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to design appropriate data migration solutions, manage data migrations, and provide advisory services to enhance data management strategies.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to assess data quality and compatibility with target systems
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with tools like SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing strategies
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs and supporting data validation exercises
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration to S/4 HANA and integrating SAP ETL solutions such as IDOCs and BAPIs
- Advising clients on data management strategies and techniques to optimize data quality and management processes
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Data and Analytics solutions, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW/4HANA), SAP Data Intelligence, or related data platform credentials
- Possessing experience with Snaplogic for data migration to S/4 HANA
- Utilizing SAP BODS and LTMC for data migration projects
- Implementing data quality improvement plans using Information Steward
- Excelling in complex data analysis and data-driven consulting
- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Data Integration and SAP Reporting and Analytics
- Developing technical specifications for SAP Data Services jobs
AboutCompany: Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

Role Overview
The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound calls and emails from shareholders, addressing their queries within agreed service standards.
Assist shareholders with share purchase and sale transactions over inbound calls.
Resolve basic customer queries and escalate complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Support the team in completing daily workloads and meeting operational targets.
Continuously develop operational knowledge and skills while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service quality.
Perform additional duties of a similar nature as required.
Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory obligations.
Carry out all responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of the companys regulators.
Adhere to established physical and information security procedures to protect company and customer information.
Ensure all activities comply with the applicable quality management system.
Follow scheduled break timings to maintain operational efficiency and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Work according to the designated US business holiday calendar.

Required Skills, Experience, and Competencies
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and telephone communication skills, with strong active listening abilities.

Shift Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work in US shifts.

Customer Support Experience: Previous experience in a customer service or customer support role

Target Achievement: Ability to meet targets related to accuracy, quality, productivity, and agreed service levels.

CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and practices.

Data Protection and AML: Basic understanding of data protection principles and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).

Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer needs and adapt communication styles to different personalities.

Time Management: Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.

Compliance and Process Adherence: Ability to follow established procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.

Teamwork: Willingness to support team members and contribute beyond assigned responsibilities.

Manager – Finance, Compliance & Accounts
You are responsible for supporting the company’s financial operations, accounting processes, statutory compliances, financial reporting and audit requirements. The role ensures timely and accurate financial information, effective monitoring of budgets and cash flows, adherence to applicable statutory and institutional requirements, and smooth coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
I. Accounts Closing:
F Personally execute monthly and annual closing: trial balance, P&L and Balance Sheet preparation.
F Perform ledger scrutiny to identify and correct mis-postings and period-end errors.
F Carry out reconciliations: bank, inter-company, GL-to-sub-ledger, vendor and customer balances.
F Book provisions, accruals and prepayments; reverse in subsequent periods.
F Coordinate with auditors; provide records for timely annual audit completion.
II. Statutory Compliance:
F Compute, deduct and remit TDS, GST, PF, Professional Tax and other statutory dues personally. Prepare and file returns: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, TDS/TCS, PT, PF challans, etc.
F Maintain records and documentation for statutory and audit requirements.
F Monitor regulatory changes; update internal processes and coordinate action.
III. Budget Preparation & Monitoring:
F Coordinate with academic and administrative departments; consolidate the annual operating and capital budget.
F Present consolidated budget to Management with analysis of key assumptions.
F Track actuals vs. budget; prepare variance reports with explanations.
IV. Cash Flow Management:
F Prepare weekly/monthly cash flow forecasts tracking fee collections and payment commitments.
F Monitor inflows and outflows; flag variances or shortfalls to the Management.
F Coordinate with banks to ensure sufficient funds for remittances, payments and payroll.
F Align collection schedules and payment timelines with available liquidity
V. Accounts Payable:
F Verify invoices personally: three-way matching (PO, GRN, invoice), GL coding and approvals.
F Compute and deduct TDS at applicable rates; remit within statutory timelines.
F Process domestic and foreign vendor payments per approved procedures.
F Perform vendor balance reconciliations; follow up on outstanding or aged items.
6. Import & Export Finance & Trade Operations
F Handle end-to-end accounting and documentation for cross-border transactions, including commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and bills of entry.
F Manage banking instruments including Letters of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantees (BG), foreign remittances, and export proceeds realization (EDPMS/IDPMS).
F Accurately account for and reconcile import duties, customs charges, freight, insurance, and other landed costs.
F Track foreign currency (forex) transactions, revaluations, and exchange rate fluctuations/adjustments.
F Coordinate with Custom House Agents (CHA), freight forwarders, and shipping lines.
7 Financial Systems, Projects & Stakeholder Coordination
F Post accounting entries and maintain financial records in SAP FI&MM and related systems.
F Support financial transition for New School Project; establish requisite processes and controls.
F Coordinate with the Trust, RIL systems, vendors, auditors and statutory authorities.
8 Human Resources (HR) & Payroll
F Oversee monthly salary computation, attendance/leave integration, and wage disbursements.
F Manage employee PF/ESI registrations, contractor/labor laws, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.
F Handle onboarding documentation, personal file maintenance, and grievance resolution support.
9. Other Responsibilities
F Any other duties as assigned by the Senior Management or Board.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field or relevant certifications (e.g., CA (Inter), CMA or MBA in Finance is preferred with experience 6-10 years of relevant experience in Finance, HR, Accounts and Compliance in an Manufacturing Industry is preferred.
2. Must have personally performed accounts closing, statutory filings, budgeting, cash flow preparation and AP processing – not just overseen these functions.
3. Prior team coordination experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite.
4. Strong working knowledge of accounting principles, Income Tax (TDS), GST, PF and PT provisions.
5. Hands-on experience with SAP FI&MM; proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
6. Meticulous attention to detail; ability to manage deadlines and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Aluminium Production Manager
You will be overseeing end-to-end manufacturing operations in an aluminium plant, foundry, extrusion unit, or fabrication facility. Manage daily production schedules, shop-floor teams, machinery efficiency, and quality control to meet safety and delivery targets.
Key Responsibilities
Production Planning & Scheduling
F Formulate daily, weekly, and monthly production plans based on customer orders, resource availability, and machine capacity.
Shop-Floor Management
F Direct manufacturing processes—such as aluminium extrusion, casting, Gravity Die Casting (GDC), anodizing, surface finishing, or window/door fabrication.
Equipment & OEE Optimization
F Oversee the operation and preventive maintenance of CNC machines, extrusion presses, anodizing tanks, or melting furnaces to minimize downtime and track Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
Quality & Scrap Control
F Enforce quality protocols, conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) for defects or customer complaints, and drive scrap and rework reduction.
Team Leadership & Safety
F Supervise operators and shift supervisors, enforce 5S housekeeping standards, and maintain strict workplace health, safety, and environmental (HSE) compliance.
Cross-Functional Coordination
F Collaborate with Quality Control, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Sales teams to align output with project timelines.

Preferred candidate profile
1. B.E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, Metallurgy, or Chemical Engineering with experience of 8 to 15 years of hands-on manufacturing leadership experience in the aluminium or metal-working industry (extrusions, casting, or fabrication).
2. Familiarity with aluminium alloys, thermal/surface treatments, or architectural profiles.
3. 3+ years managing supervisors and production teams in a high-volume manufacturing setting.
4. Demonstrated success improving quality performance, productivity, employee engagement, and operational efficiency.
5. Strong understanding of quality systems, process improvement, and manufacturing operations.
6. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
7. Strong leadership, coaching, employee development & conflict resolution skills.
8. Proven ability to build high-performing and engaged teams.
9. Experience with Lean Manufacturing/Continuous Improvement.
10. Proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Office, and manufacturing reporting tools.

Director Fund Raising And CSR (Philanthropy)
Responsible for cultivating relationships with donors, planning and executing fundraising campaigns and events, researching prospective donors, writing grant proposals, managing donor databases, and tracking financial goals to secure financial support for a non-profit's mission. Responsibilities include strategic planning, communication, donor stewardship, budget management, and reporting on fundraising progress to ensure organizational sustainability and growth.
Key Responsibilities>:
Donor Cultivation & Stewardship: Developing and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with individual, corporate, and foundation donors to secure ongoing financial support.
Campaign & Event Management: Planning, organizing, and executing fundraising campaigns and events, including community-led initiatives and major donor cultivation events.

and objectives.

3. Proven track record of successful fundraising efforts, with a focus on raising immediate funds.
4. Organizational: Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple projects and events simultaneously.
5. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including writing, editing, and public speaking.
6. Strong abilities to build and nurture relationships with diverse groups of people, including donors,
Career Focus

Hiring: Customer Support (CS) & Service Desk (SD) JL2 / JL3

Work Mode: Work from Office (Mandatory)
Shift: 247 rotational shifts with rotational weekly offs

Salary Budget

- JL2: Up to 3.5 LPA
- JL3: Up to 5.5 LPA

Job Description

We are looking for candidates for Customer Support (CS) and Service Desk (SD) roles who can provide excellent customer service, handle customer queries, and resolve technical and service-related issues. Candidates will act as the first point of contact for customers and service users, assisting them through voice calls, chat, email, and other support channels.

Key Responsibilities

- Handle customer queries and resolve issues through calls, chat, and email.
- Act as the first point of contact for customer and service-related requests.
- Understand customer concerns, analyse problems, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
- Provide technical support for laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation.
- Assist with Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory-related issues.
- Handle requests related to information, system access, and other services.
- Demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Resolve customer issues independently, efficiently, and professionally.
- Maintain good time management and ensure a positive customer experience.
- Be proactive and demonstrate respect for customers' time.

Eligibility Criteria

- Qualification: Any full-time graduate with 15 years of formal education.
- Experience: 15 years, depending on the job level and profile.
- Candidates with prior technical support experience must have at least 1 year of Service Desk Technical Support experience.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Experience in laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Willingness to work in a voice support process and 247 rotational shifts.
- Rotational weekly offs and work from office are mandatory.
- Candidates must have completed double vaccination, as specified in the JD.

Note: Candidates will be screened according to the relevant CS or SD profile, experience, technical skills, and applicable salary budget.

Description:
Position: Full Stack Engineer
Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 60 Days
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies, along with experience in cloud platforms, API development, and modern software development practices.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications.
Build scalable and responsive front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Develop robust back-end services using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices.
Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Required Skills:
6+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Strong experience in server-side development using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Good knowledge of database technologies including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools and automated testing frameworks.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Exposure to DevOps practices and monitoring tools.
Understanding of security best practices and performance optimization.

Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
Required Skills
API Testing
Strong hands-on experience in API Testing.
Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.
API validation using Postman, Swagger, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Basic Auth).
Experience with API automation using Java/Python frameworks.
Automation Testing
Experience in designing and developing automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar frameworks.
Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.
Selenium Automation
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.
Programming Skills
Java or Python programming experience.
Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Position: Network Engineer-Nsx T
YOE: 3-7yrs
Location: Remote
Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days
Job Role: Permanent role

Job Description:
Key Responsibilities
Owns NSX-T design validation and migration execution, including logical switching, distributed routing, and Tier-0/Tier-1 gateway cutover, for VCF9 migration waves.
Leads network cutover activities during migration waves typically the critical path sequencing cutover windows in coordination with the Senior Migration Engineer and Migration Architect.
Monitors tickets, responses, and resolutions for network events tied to migration waves; gathers and analyzes bandwidth and NSX flow data.
Documents scheduled maintenances, network topologies, NSX segment/gateway configurations, and connectivity mappings in the designated tool.
Opens service requests to vendors for hardware/software problems; works with Service Providers for proper handling of outages, maintenances, or other problems during cutover windows.
Communicates cutover status and network risk to customers and the Migration Coordinator/PMO via tickets, emails, and calls.
Ensures NSX and network alerts are detected, acknowledged, and resolved in a timely manner during and after cutover.
Documents planned and unplanned network events and changes; follows change and escalation processes for unique, complex, or critical network cutover changes and customer outages.
Validates rollback readiness for network cutover activities in partnership with the QA/Validation Engineer.

Description:
Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.
