Description:
Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Una/Hamirpur-Himachal
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Interested candidate share CV/Resume @ Akshat.Chauhan@brightlifecare.com or 9650023605

Description:
Job Summary
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Battery Component Design
Product Development - RD
Function: Research Development / Product Development
Experience: Minimum 8 years
Reporting To: Mandeep (AGM - NPD)
Location: Gagret
Company: Luminous


Key Responsibilities
Prepare battery layouts, assembly drawings, component drawings and detailed manufacturing drawings.
Support Design and develop flooded tubular lead-acid batteries for inverter, solar, industrial and other deep-cycle applications.
Design and optimize components such as containers, lids, terminal arrangements, handles, vent plugs, gauntlets, grids, spines, straps and associated parts.
Develop accurate 2D drawings and 3D models using AutoCAD and Creo.
Define critical dimensions, tolerances, materials and technical specifications.
Maintain drawing accuracy, revision control and standardization across product families.
Convert product requirement specifications into design concepts and engineering specifications.
Conduct design calculations covering battery capacity, plate configuration, acid volume, component fitment, terminal arrangement, weight and dimensional compliance.
Support prototype development, pilot builds and production trials.
Coordinate with testing teams to prepare DVPR and validation plans.
Support design verification, validation and release through the company stage-gate NPD process.
Ensure completion of design reviews, technical risk assessments and product-release documentation.
Perform tolerance stack-up, fitment and interface analysis for battery components.
Identify opportunities for weight reduction, material optimization, improved performance and cost reduction.
Conduct Design FMEA and participate in Process FMEA reviews.
Evaluate product failures and implement corrective design actions.
Apply design-for-manufacturing, design-for-assembly and mistake-proofing principles.
Support value-engineering and product-standardization initiatives.
Prepare technical inputs for moulds, dies, fixtures and inspection gauges.
Participate in mould trials, component trials and sample approval.
Work with suppliers to resolve dimensional, material, fitment and manufacturing concerns.
Support component qualification, pilot-lot evaluation and production approval.
Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Testing, Purchase, Marketing, Service and Supplier Development teams.
Provide technical support during product industrialization and production ramp-up.
Support investigation of field complaints and warranty failures related to product or component design.
Provide technical inputs for product specifications, catalogues, manuals and regulatory submissions.
Prepare and maintain drawings, specifications, bills of materials, engineering change notes and technical reports.
Ensure proper document control and traceability of design changes.
Support internal, customer and certification audits relating to product design and development.
Follow applicable safety, quality and environmental management systems.


Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
A diploma or advanced qualification in Tool and Die Making, CAD/CAM or Product Design will be an advantage.


Required Experience
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in product or component design.
Practical experience in the design and development of flooded tubular lead-acid batteries is strongly preferred.
Experience in plastic components, lead-alloy components, tooling, mould development and manufacturing drawings will be valuable.
Exposure to battery manufacturing processes and new-product industrialization is required.


Technical Skills
Creo
AutoCAD
DFMEA
DVPR
design-for-manufacturing
design-for-assembly
Microsoft Excel
PowerPoint
Word


Behavioural Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Attention to detail and commitment to drawing accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple development projects simultaneously.
Effective cross-functional and supplier coordination.
Good written and verbal communication skills.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Location: Shimla, Himachal Pardesh
Reporting To: National Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Based at: State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) State Programme Management Unit (SPMU) office
Project Duration: 3 Years (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
Background
HelpAge India, in partnership with DAY-NRLM and participating SRLMs, is implementing a multi-state pilot to integrate elderly care, active ageing, and community-based caregiving within the Food, Nutrition, Health, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (FNHW) framework. The initiative aims to build scalable, community-led elderly inclusion systems through SHG-VO-CLF platforms, strengthen government convergence, and develop caregiving cadres and care economy approaches. To support state-level implementation, a Project Manager- Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will be positioned within the respective SRLM SPMU.
Purpose
The State Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will provide state-level technical, operational, and coordination support for implementing the Operational Framework under the MoU between HelpAge India and the respective SRLM. The role includes integrating elderly-focused interventions within SRLM systems, strengthening implementation across pilot districts and blocks, facilitating government convergence, and supporting institutionalisation within DAY-NRLM, while guiding district/block teams, community institutions, and caregiving cadres to deliver agreed programme outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Programme Coordination and Implementation: Lead coordination and implementation of the Operational Framework across pilot districts and blocks, ensuring alignment with state plans and the HelpAge India-SRLM MoU.
Coordination Engagement: Act as the key liaison between HelpAge India and SRLM, coordinating across state, district, and block levels, and driving convergence with relevant departments.
Technical Support Capacity Building: Develop and deliver guidelines, tools, and trainings; strengthen elderly inclusion, caregiving systems, and integration of ESHGs within NRLM platforms.
Monitoring Reporting: Track progress, conduct field visits, and lead reporting, evaluations, and documentation of programme outcomes.
Community Systems Convergence: Strengthen Elders Self Help Groups (ESHGs), community caregiving systems and enable elderly access to entitlements, health, social protection, and livelihoods through stakeholder convergence.
Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies Experience
Masters degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Development Studies, Public Health or related disciplines.
Minimum 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in rural livelihoods, SHG promotion, social inclusion, public health or community development programmes.
Prior experience of working with SRLMs, NRLM institutional platforms or large-scale government programmes will be preferred.
Experience in programme coordination, capacity building and stakeholder engagement.
Understanding of elderly inclusion, social protection, community caregiving or FNHW-related programmes will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
Strong programme coordination and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with government systems and community institutions.
Good training and mentoring abilities.
Strong analytical, reporting and documentation skills.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multi-stakeholder implementation processes.

This is an excellent opportunity to build a long-term career at sea with structured onboard mentorship, sign-on support, and progression toward higher ranks

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondel z business and innovation processes in project management and Mondel z standards in execution are followed.
How you will contribute
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondel z standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Engineering or operations
Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
Analysis
Project management
More about this role
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion.

What you need to know about this position:
Experience
5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food beverage preferred).
PLC / SCADA
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards.
Electrical
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
Instrumentation
Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology.
Digital and Cybersecurity
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
Process and Equipment Safety.
Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
Leadership
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
Project Mgmt
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
Communication
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.

Education / Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Job specific requirements:
Electrical Systems
Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion Plant projects.
Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).
Automation for plant projects
Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.
Project Delivery
Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the EA scope.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning.
Safety Compliance
Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.


Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & dispensing Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs

Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions.
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation.
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up

Product recommendation

He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.
Use product knowledge and sales techniques to upsell and cross-sell products, maximizing sales opportunities.
Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently, including cash handling, credit card transactions, and billing inquiries.

Perform regular inventory checks, restock shelves, and assist with merchandise deliveries as needed.
Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner, escalating to management as necessary.

Collaborate with team members to achieve sales targets, meet customer service goals, and ensure the overall success of the store.

High school diploma or equivalent.
Previous retail or customer service experience is preferred but not required.
Friendly and outgoing personality with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to go above and beyond to meet customer needs.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and multitask with attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Description:
Utilities Engineer will take the ownership of operational management and delivery of all utility s services delivered within his location. This includes the management of customer interface within the designated area, ensuring efficient service delivery for day- to-day running of the sites, and provision of a consistent strong link with internal customers, guaranteeing appropriate and responsive reaction to address any and all internal stake-holders concerns. The Utilities Engineer is responsible for maintenance and engineering activities in the Utilities area which include Chillers, HVAC, Boilers, DG sets, Electrical Infra, Air compressors, Tank farm, WTP, ETP, STP, DM/RO/Softener Plant, fire detection and suppression systems etc. He/she is an active member of the local engineering team and support to achieve the site sustainability (Energy/Water) targets.
What are we looking for
Experience on utility equipment operation and maintenance from FMCG manufacturing is preferred
Thorough understanding of factory utilities and statutory requirements
Experience of dealing with Cross-functional teams, technicians, engineering vendors, equipment suppliers and facility management.
BE (Mechanical/Electrical) with 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in Utility maintenance and engineering
What will be your key responsibilities
Support a team of Utility technician to provide maximum availability and running at optimum efficiency within Utility system.
Ensure team is strictly following all Safety, Q&FS, Sustainability, HACCP, Local regulations and ISO requirements.
Accountable to organize and implement all planned and unplanned maintenance activities on time with required quality and ensure Utility Uptime >99%.
Periodically measure and analyze Utility KPIs, collaborate with the team to comeback with action plans/root cause analysis and improvements
Responsible for Utility Maintenance and Energy Budget where he / she needs to plan, prepare forecast for the total year budget, track and control the spend on periodic basis
Perform negotiations related to engineering procurement (Spares and Services), annual maintenance contracts/rate contracts in close cooperation with Commercial to agree on service, delivery timelines, price and performance requirements
Ensure projects are executed in line with Mars Global Standards and delivered according to the needs of the unit s business plans.
Understand and apply the Mars Global Best Practices and Standards relevant to utility maintenance and projects; connect with the regional engineering team to check compliance to the standards
What can you expect from Mars
Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
Join a purpose driven company, where we re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Description:
Job Description Senior Manager (Civil)

Business Unit: Auro Textiles Fabric Division
Grade: Senior Manager, M3
Reporting To: Unit Head
Place of Posting: Baddi, Himachal Pradesh

1. Primary Role

To oversee civil maintenance and infrastructure management across all Fabric Division units, including factory buildings, residential colonies, utilities, and other civil structures. The role also involves planning and execution of Greenfield and Brownfield projects, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality standards, structural integrity, and compliance with safety procedures.

2. Roles and Responsibilities

1. Oversee repair and maintenance of factory buildings, residential facilities, roads, drainage systems, water supply lines, sewerage systems, and other civil infrastructure.
2. Conduct periodic inspections of civil structures, roofs, flooring, plaster, ceilings, and other building components to ensure structural stability and timely maintenance.
3. Assess the feasibility of new buildings, machine foundations, and modifications to existing structures, including preparation of drawings, proposals, cost estimates, and BOQs.
4. Prepare annual revenue and capital budgets, monitor expenditure, control costs, and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
5. Review material requirements, verify quantities, and approve purchase indents as per organisational procedures.
6. Monitor construction projects for progress, budget, quality, and adherence to approved specifications and timelines.
7. Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, contractors, and internal departments to resolve technical and site-related issues.
8. Verify job approvals, contractor bills, work measurements, and supporting documents in accordance with organisational SOPs.
9. Ensure compliance with safety standards and prescribed procedures during civil maintenance and construction activities.
10. Maintain records of drawings, estimates, BOQs, approvals, completed jobs, and associated costs.
11. Lead and guide civil officers, supervisors, and supporting staff, while addressing team grievances and ensuring effective service delivery.
12. Provide land, building, and infrastructure-related information to internal departments, CPPD, and the Estate Office as required.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

- Relevant qualification in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
- Proven experience in industrial infrastructure, including Greenfield and Brownfield projects and civil maintenance.
- Hands-on experience in project execution, budgeting, BOQ preparation, cost estimation, and contractor management.
- Knowledge of construction quality standards, safety practices, and infrastructure maintenance.

Job Introduction:
Job Description of Lady Security Guard
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergency situations, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to Supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorized person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from employer and 12% from Employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 to 35 for fresher and upto 40 for experienced security guards
Physically and Medically fit and look like mature

JOB SUMMARY:
Responsible for achieving the targets for Annuity Business through NPS, Superannuation & open market (PSU clients) in the assigned region. Responsible for providing assistance in executing the business plan
Assist in launching Annuity Business in the Region
Presenting products to the targeted audience
Update the Sales process and maintain the database as suggested by Retirement Solutions (Government Annuity) department
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for implementing the sales plan of the assigned region
- Responsible for achieving sales targets from assigned Region/PSU-Clients
- Assist in launching & driving Government Annuity Business
- Assist PSU clients in evaluating their needs to help select the best solution
- Prepare periodic sales reports
Maintain database on Govt./ PSUs and competitor information
- Update the client s/ call reports accurately and efficiently and any competitor s information as suggested by Goverment Annuity team
Continuously evaluate potential of Annuity Business in the region
- Develop specific analysis parameters
- Conduct analysis on the potential groups/PSUs and prepare reports for the Business Head
- Collect competitor information on the Government Annuity Business
Adhere to all Organization s policies and procedures
Measures of Success:
- Actual sales achieved vs the plan
- Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports
- Actual activity vs targeted activity
- Accuracy of competitor information; up to date data
KEY RELATIONSHIPS:
Internal:
- Business Heads
- MLI HR & Sales Training Team
- MLI Operations Team
External:
- Top Clients
- All Stakeholders
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/Master of Business Administration preferably in Sales, Marketing or Finance
1-2 years of experience in Life Insurance

1. To implement quality policies and procedures and to ensure their
compliance in Food and Nutrition site/ Contract Manufacturing Site
2. To formulate Quality Management Systems to ensure cGMP / GLP / GDP
compliance at manufacturing, laboratory, warehouse and engineering to
meet current regulatory standards.
3. To Authorize/Approve the Standard Operating Procedures, Standard Test
Procedures, Specifications, Technical Documents (TDs), Protocols and
reports, APQRs etc.

formation of response to regulatory authorities and customers
5. To conduct internal quality audits to review the implementation of systems
as per the design to ensure cGMP compliance at site.

sites as per companys standard operating procedures including compliance
to quality system.
10. To ensure safety measures in the operation of plant.
11. To evaluate the performance of quality assurance department personnel.
12. Responsible for disposition and Authorization of Change Controls,
Incidents, Deviations, OOS, OOTs non- conformance report (NCRs) Yield
nonconformance report (YNCRs), market complaints and Corrective actions
Preventive Actions (CAPA).

Description:
Job Summary
Ortho Max Mfg Co. Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager Domestic to drive sales growth across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the medical devices or orthopaedic implant industry and will be responsible for developing business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving regional sales targets across the assigned territories.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve or exceed regional sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and expand existing customer relationships across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
Build strong relationships with key decision-makers in hospitals, clinics, trauma centres, and healthcare institutions.
Schedule product demonstrations, surgeon meetings, training sessions, and provide technical support as required.
Address customer complaints or issues promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.
Analyse market dynamics to identify potential growth opportunities within the assigned territories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Product Development, and Operations, to align sales strategies with company objectives.
Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets.
Track sales performance, prepare periodic reports, and identify areas for improvement.
Develop and implement strategies to increase market share throughout the assigned region.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory and company requirements related to sales activities.
Drive customer satisfaction and build long-term business relationships.
Manage distributor and dealer networks within the assigned territories, where applicable.
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor s Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
3 4 years of proven sales experience in the Medical Devices or Orthopaedic Implant industry (preferred).
Strong understanding of the healthcare industry, particularly Orthopaedics and Trauma Care.
Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Proficiency in Hindi is essential. Knowledge of Punjabi is preferred. Familiarity with regional languages is an added advantage.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Strong leadership, planning, and territory management capabilities.
Role Details

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.

What You Will Bring

Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.

Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,

Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.

Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards

Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix

Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

MRF Tyres (Madras Rubber Factory) is India’s largest tyre manufacturer, established in 1946 and headquartered in Chennai. From its humble beginnings as a small toy balloon unit, the company has grown into a global leader in the tyre industry, with products exported to over 90 countries worldwide. Over the decades, MRF has built a strong presence across India with multiple manufacturing facilities and an extensive dealer network, while steadily expanding its footprint in international markets. The company’s registered office is located at 114, Greams Road, Chennai – 600006, and it operates under the name MRF Limited. Innovation is central to MRF’s success, with a dedicated Research and Design division that serves as a pioneering technology hub, focusing on safety, performance, and advanced tyre design. This emphasis on R&D has enabled the company to consistently deliver high-quality products that meet the diverse demands of passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial trucks, farm machinery, and off-the-road applications. With a strong reputation for reliability, global reach, and technological leadership, MRF continues to stand as a symbol of Indian manufacturing excellence in the international tyre market.

Description:
What you ll do:
Lead and manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of both MV Switchgear portfolios.
"- - Define and execute R&D strategies for component development across MV Switchgear aligned with business objectives and product technology roadmaps.
- Manage resources, budgets, and timelines, ensuring effective prioritization and delivery of component projects across both product lines.
- Supervise VCB design activities for MV Switchgear, including interrupters, linkages, and insulation systems for AIS and GIS environments.
- Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components (mechanical endurance, TRV, dielectric, internal arc, environmental cycling, etc.).
- Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
- Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
- Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
- Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
- Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
- Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
- Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team, fostering expertise in both MV Switchgear component engineering and building succession pipelines.
- Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.
- Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results.
- Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
- Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
- Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
- Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.
- Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency.
- Develop, coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible."

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
AbouttheRole
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to beDriving Net
Promoter Score Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers Driving sales vs. Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership plan Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company development training modules
(Attrition Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department toControl) execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions management are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart CustomerEnsuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
Supervision are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
SOP adherence & implementation Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the storeMaintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
Store up keep & maintenance equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal at tributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Graduate
Ability to act as a link between strategy and execution
Ability to develop and inspire people to achieve their best
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand stated and unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr Supply Chain Executive to join our dynamic team at Unilever Plc. This role is crucial in optimizing our supply chain operations, ensuring efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery of products to our global customers.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and implement supply chain strategies to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels.
Manage end-to-end supply chain processes, including demand planning, procurement, logistics, warehousing, and inventory management.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e. g. , manufacturing, marketing, sales) to align supply chain activities with business objectives.
Lead and mentor a team of supply chain professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, including supplier disruptions, transportation issues, and inventory obsolescence.
Analyze supply chain data to identify trends, opportunities for optimization, and areas for improvement.
Negotiate contracts with suppliers and logistics partners to ensure favorable terms and conditions.
Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, quality standards, and company policies throughout the supply chain.
Drive the adoption of new technologies and best practices in supply chain management.
Prepare and present regular reports on supply chain performance to senior management.

Job Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. Masters degree preferred.
Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in supply chain management, preferably within the FMCG sector.
Proven track record of successfully managing complex supply chain operations and achieving measurable results.
Strong understanding of supply chain principles, methodologies, and best practices (e. g. , S&OP, Lean, Six Sigma).
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.
Proficiency in supply chain planning software (e. g. , SAP, Oracle, JDA) and advanced Excel skills.
Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with experience in mentoring and developing staff.
Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, capable of building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and innovation in supply chain processes.

Role & Responsibilities
Teach Physical Science as per the CBSE curriculum and prescribed syllabus.

Ability to use digital teaching tools and interactive learning methods.
Passion for teaching and commitment to students' academic development.

Career growth opportunities within the institution.

Other benefits as per institutional policy.

Position Title: Sales Manager

Organization: NBFC

Work Location: Chennai, Coimbatore, Pondicherry, Hyderabad

Reports to: Area Sales Manager

JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Purpose of the Job (Position Summary)
SM is expected to generate business through various products like Machinery Loan, equipment loan, Plastic and Printing machines loan etc.
He/she will use existing as well as new channels for sourcing new-to-company cases by understanding the credit profile of the prospect, the exact need and other credit and operational aspects. The SM will also manage the portfolio so generated in terms of installment recovery and collections for as well as will be responsible for the health of the portfolio.

Key Functions & Responsibilities
Responsible for setting up the distribution network for machinery loan/ finance.
Dealership management: Conducting a survey of dealers in the market for a given set of products. Liaison with the network for sourcing new business.
Achieve sales targets for given the basket of products through dealer network, manufacturers, OEM, Charted accountants and market combing.
Devise finance schemes to suit customers requirements.
Recommend manufacturers & dealers as a part of continuous business development.
Manage portfolio of existing customers and provide prompt service. Explore opportunities of cross selling other products.

Collections & Delinquency management.

Education: Any Graduate /Postgraduate

Experience: 1 to 8 years

Language Skills: English, Local Language

Technical / Managerial Competencies Required:

Relevant experience (1 -10 yrs) in sales of financial products (Selling Loan). Experience in Assets (SME loan, Business Loan, working capital, Overdraft, Cash credit, Term loan, equipment finance, commercial LAP / Mortgage Loan) preferred.

Dealer management & experience in equipment finance is a big plus
Sound knowledge of MS office, esp. Microsoft excel

Description:
To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are looking for a Workforce Management / Scheduling & Real-Time Analyst to support a high volume payment processing operation. The operation will process 1M+ transactions per month, with transaction volumes distributed across defined time intervals and governed by productivity, SLA/TAT and quality requirements. The role will be responsible for ensuring that the right capacity is available at the right time by combining forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, intraday management and performance analytics. The individual will act as a central point of contact between Operations, Workforce Management and Leadership, providing real-time visibility into volumes, productivity, staffing, backlog, capacity utilization and SLA/TAT risks. The ideal candidate should be highly analytical, comfortable working with large datasets, proficient in MS Excel and capable of making quick, data-driven decisions in a dynamic 24x7 environment.
Preferred candidate profile
1-5 years of experience in WFM, Workforce Planning, Scheduling, RTA, Capacity Planning or Operations Analytics.
• Experience supporting high-volume transaction-based or back-office operations is strongly preferred.
• Strong understanding of: o Forecasting o Capacity planning o FTE calculations o Productivity o Shrinkage o Scheduling o Intraday management o SLA/TAT management o Backlog management
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: o Pivot Tables o XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP o SUMIFS / COUNTIFS o IF/IFS o Data validation o Conditional formatting o Charts and dashboards o Basic data modelling • Ability to work with large transaction and operational datasets.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to identify trends, anomalies and capacity risks quickly.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to present data and recommendations to Operations and senior management.
• Ability to make data-driven decisions under pressure.
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
• Comfortable working in a 24x7 environment and rotational shifts
• Immediate joiners preferred

Description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager who can take full ownership of the warehouse: racking and storage, stock accuracy, dispatch, and the supervisors and workforce. The person who joins must be able to run the operation independently and report to the owner with clear, accurate information.

Key Responsibilities

Racking & Storage
Manage a G+5 pallet racking system with defined bin locations (row, column, level)
Ensure every pallet is put away in the correct bin and the location is recorded accurately
Plan space usage, put-away, and picking to keep the warehouse organized and avoid congestion
Enforce FIFO by batch, production date, and MRP
Ensure safe forklift / reach truck movement and racking load safety

Inventory & Stock Control
Maintain 100% stock accuracy between physical stock and records
Conduct regular cycle counts and month-end physical stock audits
Track good vs. damaged stock and handle damage segregation and reporting
Reconcile stock with client records and resolve differences quickly

Inward & Dispatch
Plan and supervise daily receipts from the factory and dispatches to depots
Coordinate vehicle placement, loading, and documentation without delays
Ensure dispatch accuracy (right SKU, batch, quantity)

People Management
Lead supervisors, forklift operators, and loading/unloading labour
Allocate shifts and daily work, and hold supervisors accountable for targets
Maintain discipline, attendance, and productivity on the floor
Resolve worker issues firmly and fairly, without escalating everything to the owner
Train new staff on racking, stock procedures, and safety

Compliance, Safety & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly MIS on stock, inward, dispatch, damages, and manpower
Ensure housekeeping, fire safety, and PPE compliance
Be ready for client audits and inspections at any time

Requirements
5+ years of warehouse experience, with at least 2 years as Warehouse Manager / In-charge
Mandatory: hands-on experience managing a pallet racking warehouse with bin locations
Experience in FMCG, 3PL, or manufacturing warehouses preferred
Proven experience leading a team of 20+ workers and supervisors
Strong knowledge of FIFO, batch tracking, stock audits, and damage handling
Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (WMS or SAP exposure is a plus)
Good communication in Tamil; English and Hindi preferred
Graduate in any discipline; diploma/degree in logistics or supply chain is a plus
