Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Automotive Quality Control Assistant to join our team at TTK Prestige Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in quality control and assurance, with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Roles and Responsibility


Assist in developing and implementing quality control processes to ensure high-quality products.

Conduct regular audits to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality-related issues and improve overall product quality.

Analyze data and trends to identify opportunities for quality improvement and develop/implement process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.


Job Requirements


Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as engineering or business administration.

Minimum 2 years of experience in quality control or a related field.

Strong knowledge of quality control principles and practices.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Familiarity with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Automotive CNC Machining Technician to join our team at KSPG AUTOMOTIVE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in automotive manufacturing and experience with CNC machining techniques.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain CNC machines for efficient production of automotive components.

Develop and implement machining processes to enhance productivity and quality.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and develop new products.

Troubleshoot machine malfunctions and perform routine maintenance tasks.

Implement safety protocols and ensure compliance with industry standards.

Analyze production data to identify areas for improvement.


Job Requirements


Minimum 2 years of experience in automotive manufacturing, preferably in a CNC machining role.

Strong knowledge of CNC machining principles and practices.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with attention to detail.

Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with others.

Familiarity with industry-standard software and tools used in automotive manufacturing.

1. Ensure 100% achievement of assigned business targets (volume and value).2. Assist in the collection and utilization of marketing data to support telecalling and self-sourcing efforts.11. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of MIS reports related to sourcing, disbursement, audits, and operational pendency.12. Follow proper procedures for handling and movement of property documents and customer files in coordination with the central operations team.

Description:
Job Description: Electrical Maintenance Technician
Department: Maintenance / Cinema / Entertainment

Location: Itanagar

Job Summary
Responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems and equipment to ensure safe, uninterrupted, and efficient operations of the cinema premises.
Key Responsibilities
Perform routine inspection and preventive maintenance of electrical systems, wiring, lighting, and electrical panels.
Troubleshoot electrical faults and carry out repairs as required.
Maintain and monitor DG sets, UPS, power backup systems, and related electrical equipment.
Ensure proper functioning of cinema screens, projection-related electrical systems, HVAC electrical components, and other operational equipment.
Monitor electricity consumption and identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and company maintenance procedures.
Maintain maintenance logs, breakdown reports, and records of repairs.
Coordinate with external vendors and contractors for major electrical repairs.
Respond promptly to electrical breakdowns and emergency maintenance requirements.
Qualifications and Experience
ITI or Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
25 years of experience in electrical maintenance, preferably in cinemas, hotels, malls, or commercial establishments.
Practical knowledge of electrical wiring, panels, fault diagnosis, and preventive maintenance.
Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and the use of maintenance tools.
Required Skills
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Basic documentation and reporting abilities.
Ability to work in shifts and handle operational emergencies.
Strong safety awareness and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and coordinate with the maintenance team.

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product
recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

Certification from accredited advanced food safety program. Extensive knowledge in VSP preferred.

Experience in high volume operation of at least 500 meals per service.
Extensive kitchen machinery and knife safety knowledge.
Experience working in all major culinary brigade stations with extensive knowledge in designated station.
Responsible producing in the preparation of all food in the assigned station in the kitchen in accordance with the established company menus and recipes.

Follows a daily work plan assigned to his station in accordance with the planned menu and recipes of the day.
Public Health:

Responsible to implement and execute proper maintenance and cleaning procedures in the station assigned to him in order to ensure good appearance and condition of these areas. Work should always be completed in a satisfactory manner in order to maintain and exceed the company s goal. Any decisions made to compromise the product will have a negative impact on the guest s experience.

Reporting relationships:
The Demi Chef de Partie reports directly to the Chef de Partie and is supported by the Sous Chef.

Description:
Forward Deployed Software Engineer
Experience : 10+ yrs
Location : Bangalore / Hyderabad

AI & Agent SystemsAgent Design & Workflows:
Multi-agent systems, tool-using/self-learning agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool publishing, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Graph-RAG,
prompt engineering, model selection, and accuracy-per-cost routing.Evaluation & Guardrails: LLM evaluation harnesses (labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, RAGAS), guardrails, prompt-injection defense, audit trails, and rollback mechanisms.

Orchestration & AutomationWorkflow
Orchestration: Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge for building durable, retryable, and idempotent AI pipelines.Task Management: Idempotent task design, retries, failure recovery, and backfills.

AI-Assisted Development
AI Coding Assistants: Claude, Cursor, Codex-style tools for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, and code review

Cloud & DeploymentCloud Platforms:
AWS (Bedrock, S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Athena, CloudFormation, EventBridge), Kubernetes, Docker.Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (reusable modules), GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CI/CD, GitOps-style declarative deployments.

Observability & LLMOps
Monitoring & Tracing: Datadog, Grafana, Amazon CloudWatch, LangSmith for distributed tracing, prompt versioning, token/cost and latency monitoring, alerting, and regression-eval gating.

Data Platforms & Streaming
Databases: Snowflake, PostgreSQL/pgvector, MongoDB, Amazon Redshift, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata.
Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Apache Flink.
Vector Search: Pinecone, embeddings, chunking, reranking.

Programming & Model Training
Languages & Frameworks: Python (pandas, PySpark, REST API), SQL, PL/SQL, Unix/Linux shell scripting, pytest.
Model Training/Serving: Fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT, SFT, DPO/RLHF), distillation, quantization (GGUF/AWQ/GPTQ), self-hosted inference (vLLM, TGI), Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Controls & Validation: Regulatory reporting datasets, audit trails, RBAC, PII masking, data quality controls (Great Expectations, dbt tests), governed schemas/catalogs (AWS Glue Catalog, Erwin), dimensional/semantic data modeling.
Project Experience
End-to-End AI System: Built and deployed a custom agentic GenAI system (AROS) using AWS Bedrock, Airflow, Pinecone, and Kubernetes, with CI/CD via GitHub Actions and Terraform, monitored by Datadog and Grafana, and governed by audit trails and RBAC.
Data Platform Modernization: Consolidated multiple databases (Redshift, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server) into a single governed source, orchestrated with Airflow and validated with Great Expectations

Description:
Job Summary
Change the world. Love your job.
Join the APP-LP (Analog Power Products - Linear Power) team, where we push the boundaries of power management silicon. Our group manages an extensive and highly diverse product portfolio that spans precision voltage references, LDOs, sophisticated protection circuitry like eFuses and high-side switch controllers. Working within APP-LP means tackling unique engineering challenges across a wide spectrum of technologies, including high-speed switching and ultra-low-dropout (LDO) regulation. We build the fundamental building blocks that enable safe and seamless power delivery in any system architecture.
The High Side Switche and Controller product line is looking for analog design engineers who are experienced, highly driven and fast-learners to join their development team based in Bangalore. We work on high voltage and high current ICs for Automotive and Industrial market. We develop cutting edge and highly differentiated products that push the boundaries of power density. This team has full product development responsibility from definition to productizing.
What will you be doing in this role (Responsibilities)
As a design engineer you will be expected to:
Collaborate with design lead and system engineer in defining cutting edge products
Develop circuit architectures for the IP blocks starting from datasheet / system specifications.
Derive block level specifications and circuit architectures. You will be responsible for circuit implementation which not only meet the specifications, but work reliably and robustly while meeting high yields in production.
Collaborate with chip-lead and layout engineers in developing floorplan and layout strategies for optimal implementaiton.
Own block / module level verification of the blocks and participate/contribute in full chip level verification planning and execution.
Develop design collaterals and deliver high quality design review documentation.
Support the bench validation, testand product engineering teams in planning of their activities as well as actively participate in silicon bring-up and debug..
Continuously challenge the status-quo and push the frontiers of technologies in collaboration with subject matter experts, while also driving new and improved circuit architectures/topologies and design flows and methodologies
Work along with partner organizations such as process technology teams, packaging teams, EDA etc.
What can you expect to learn in this role (Opportunity)
Work on high growth, high impact domain of power-delivery systems.
Push the limits of technology, be it process or packaging. Get to work with leading experts in the domain of process technology and packaging solutions, while working with circuit experts in developing full product solutions.
Get exposure to full product life-cycle by co-location and collaboration with teams working on product definition to cross functional development and customer support, enabling development of broad-spectrum skills.
Example products developed by this team for reference
TPS1HC100
TPS2HCS08
TPS1HTC100
TPS1211
Minimum Qualification
Bachelors degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
2-5 years experience in analog circuit design preferably in high voltage and power domain.
Strong fundamentals in electrical engineering and basic analog and digital building blocks.
Ability to develop and read simple digital logic circuits.
Preferred qualifications
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes

Good to have skills: Tech M&A Advisory, IT Shared Services, Agile Operating Model, Workforce Transformation, AI in SDLC, Data Visualization Tools, Enterprise Architecture

Job Summary:
Manage defined workstreams within GCC strategy and digital transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines along with budgeting and forecasting activities
Own and lead projects - guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and support models for GCC setup and digital strategy assignments
Apply a technology and business perspective across GCC processes, IT governance design, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as AI-enabled transformation
Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development and managing BD cycles
Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends.
Roles & Responsibilities:
GCC Strategy and Setup: lead analysis of BOT/ABO setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GCC tooling landscape assessment, capability maturity evaluation, and process taxonomy design for new GCC entities
Cost Analysis and Value Realization: develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GCC and technology transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
KPI Design and Performance Frameworks: design KPI frameworks for GCC performance management, covering operational, delivery, financial, and strategic metrics; develop KPI dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
Capability Maturity Assessment: conduct structured maturity assessments across GCC functions, IT processes, and technology capabilities; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
GCC Processes and Tooling: Design GCC-specific operating processes including demand management, project intake, service catalogues, and performance reporting; assess and recommend tooling platforms (ITSM, PPM, reporting) suited to GCC operating contexts
IT Governance Design: Design IT governance frameworks for GCC and enterprise technology contexts, including governance councils, decision rights, escalation structures, and policy frameworks aligned to organizational objectives
RACI and Interaction Model Design: Develop RACI matrices and IT interaction models defining roles, responsibilities, and collaboration patterns between the GCC, parent organization, business units, and third-party vendors
Operating Model Design: Design integrated IT operating models for GCC setups including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition planning considerations
AI in SDLC: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on AI integration into software development lifecycles within GCC contexts - covering AI-assisted coding, automated testing, and intelligent release management
Professional & Technical Skills:
7-10 years of total experience in strategy consulting, technology advisory, or in-house corporate strategy; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
Experience leading workstreams in GCC strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating model engagements
Working knowledge of at least 2-3 of the following: GCC/Captive Center setup, Digital & Technology Strategy, IT Governance, Operating Model Design, IT Shared Services, Sourcing Strategy, Agile Transformation
Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks for technology and GCC transformation contexts
Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches - capability, process, or technology maturity - and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems - ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills
What's in it for you?
Opportunity to work on GCC and digital strategy programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

We are looking for an experienced UX Architect to lead the definition and execution of user experience strategies for enterprise and customer-facing digital products. Ensure compliance with accessibility standards (WCAG).
Collaboration & Leadership

Mentor UX/UI Designers and provide architectural guidance.

Advocate for user-centric design across the organization.

Title: Head Formwork For Project Site Operations
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Formwork, ScaffoldingMivanShuttering, About company, L&T-Sargent & Lundy Limited (L&T-S&L), established in 1995, is a premier Engineering & Consultancy firm in the Power Sector.
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION HEAD, FORMWORK
1. Position Details
ParticularsDetailsPosition TitleHead – FormworkDepartment / FunctionFormworkCadreTier 3Reporting ToSegment Head / BU Head / SBG HeadLocationProject Site, as per business requirementExperience Required20–25 years
2. Role Purpose
To lead and manage end-to-end formwork planning and execution for high-rise and large-scale building construction projects, ensuring adherence to approved formwork schemes, construction methodology, project schedules, quality standards, safety requirements and productivity targets.
The role is responsible for effective deployment and management of manpower, formwork systems and materials, coordination with project stakeholders and subcontractors, optimisation of formwork cycles, and continuous improvement in productivity, quality and cost efficiency.
The position requires strong hands-on experience in modern formwork systems such as Doka, PERI, Mivan or equivalent systems, along with the ability to lead large execution teams and deliver formwork activities in line with project requirements.
3. Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities
A. Formwork Planning and Execution
Lead and monitor end-to-end formwork activities across multiple work fronts and structural elements.
Study and interpret approved formwork scheme drawings, structural drawings and construction methodology, ensuring implementation as per approved requirements.
Plan formwork activities in line with the overall project schedule, construction sequence and structural cycle requirements.
Coordinate with the Site Formwork In-charge and project execution team for work-front readiness and deployment of manpower.
Ensure timely execution of formwork for foundations, columns, beams, slabs, shear walls, core walls and other structural elements, as applicable.
Monitor progress against planned targets and take corrective action to address delays and execution constraints.
Identify practical challenges in implementing formwork schemes and coordinate with engineering and project teams for timely resolution.
Ensure appropriate planning and execution of formwork cycles to achieve the required construction pace.
B. Modern Formwork Systems and Technical Expertise
Demonstrate hands-on experience in modern formwork systems, including Doka, PERI, Mivan or equivalent formwork systems.
Lead the selection, planning, deployment and effective utilisation of appropriate formwork systems based on project design, structural requirements and construction methodology.
Ensure proper implementation of formwork layouts, assembly procedures, erection sequences, alignment, stability and dismantling procedures.
Coordinate with engineering teams, formwork system suppliers and specialist subcontractors for technical requirements and execution planning.
Optimise formwork cycle time, reuse, material handling and system utilisation across repetitive structural elements.
Ensure that formwork systems are erected, inspected, modified and dismantled in accordance with approved designs, supplier instructions and applicable safety requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve formwork productivity, reduce turnaround time and minimise material damage and wastage.
Support the adoption of innovative formwork technologies and standardised execution practices across project work fronts.
C. Manpower Planning and Productivity Management
Plan and deploy workmen gangs, carpenters, shuttering teams, supervisors and other resources based on project requirements.
Determine appropriate gang sizes and manpower deployment to meet planned productivity norms and construction cycles.
Monitor gang-wise and work-front-wise productivity and take corrective measures wherever performance falls short of targets.
Ensure effective coordination between gangs and supervisors to avoid idle time, bottlenecks and resource conflicts.
Train and guide supervisors and workmen on formwork techniques, work sequencing, workmanship and productivity improvement.
Maintain daily records of manpower deployment, quantities executed and work fronts completed.
Drive accountability among subcontractors and supervisors for planned output, quality and safe execution.
D. Safety Management
Ensure toolbox talks and safety briefings are conducted before commencement of formwork activities.
Enforce compliance with project HSE requirements, approved method statements and safe work procedures.
Ensure appropriate inspection of formwork assemblies, staging, scaffolding, working platforms, access arrangements and temporary supports.
Ensure that erection, alteration, loading and dismantling of formwork are undertaken only in accordance with approved procedures and under competent supervision.
Identify unsafe conditions and practices, stop unsafe work where necessary, and coordinate immediate corrective action with the site safety team.
Ensure proper material stacking, safe movement of materials and housekeeping across work fronts and yards.
Promote a strong safety culture among workmen, supervisors and subcontractors.
E. Quality Assurance and Workmanship
Ensure formwork execution complies with approved drawings, formwork schemes, technical specifications and project quality standards.
Monitor line, level, alignment, dimensions, rigidity, stability and surface finish requirements.
Coordinate with QA/QC and engineering teams for inspections and clearance before concrete pouring.
Ensure formwork joints, supports, ties and other components are properly installed to minimise leakage, deformation and rework.
Identify quality deviations and ensure timely rectification before subsequent construction activities.
Monitor the condition and quality of plywood, shuttering panels and reusable formwork components.
Implement quality improvement measures to enhance concrete finish, reduce defects and improve the service life of formwork materials.
F. Material Planning, Utilisation and Cost Control
Coordinate preparation and monitoring of area-wise bills of quantities (BOQs) and material requirements with the Site Formwork In-charge.
Ensure the timely availability of formwork materials at the required work fronts in line with the execution plan.
Coordinate with carpentry workshops for fabrication and preparation of shuttering arrangements.
Ensure systematic storage, stacking, handling, movement and preservation of materials at site and in storage yards.
Monitor material consumption, reuse, damage, wastage and losses.
Ensure periodic material reconciliation and maintain accountability for formwork assets.
Drive cost optimisation through improved material utilisation, extended plywood life, reduced wastage and efficient manpower deployment.
Coordinate with stores, procurement and subcontractors to address material shortages and prevent avoidable work stoppages.
G. Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management
Coordinate with project management, planning, engineering, QA/QC, safety, stores, procurement and other relevant departments.
Work closely with subcontractors, specialist formwork agencies, suppliers, supervisors and workmen gangs to ensure smooth execution.
Align formwork deployment and execution sequences with reinforcement, MEP coordination, concrete pouring and other interfacing activities.
Participate in planning meetings and provide inputs on manpower, material requirements, work-front readiness and expected productivity.
Escalate critical constraints and propose practical solutions to ensure timely completion of planned activities.
Ensure effective communication of work instructions, priorities and progress expectations across all execution teams.
H. Process Improvement and Standardisation
Implement new formwork practices, technologies and improvement initiatives introduced by HQ, Cluster or Business leadership.
Identify opportunities to improve plywood quality and life, formwork productivity, construction cycle time and overall cost efficiency.
Introduce standardised work practices, productivity benchmarks and effective monitoring mechanisms.
Evaluate the suitability of alternative formwork systems and methods based on technical requirements, safety, productivity and cost.
Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned, best practices and feedback from project execution teams.
Monitor the effectiveness of improvement initiatives and report measurable benefits wherever applicable.
I. Progress Monitoring and Reporting
Maintain daily records of formwork activities, workmen gangs deployed, work fronts covered and quantities executed.
Prepare daily and periodic progress reports covering planned versus actual performance.
Monitor manpower productivity, formwork cycle time, material availability and execution constraints.
Provide timely updates to the Site Formwork In-charge and project leadership.
Identify delays and productivity gaps and recommend corrective measures.
Support weekly and monthly planning, resource forecasting and progress review meetings.
J. Housekeeping and Site Discipline
Ensure housekeeping is maintained across formwork work fronts, fabrication areas and storage yards.
Ensure reusable materials, scrap and damaged components are segregated and stored appropriately.
Coordinate with subcontractors to resolve housekeeping issues on priority.
Ensure proper stacking and identification of materials for safe handling and future reconciliation.
Promote compliance with site procedures, work instructions and expected standards of discipline.
4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be assessed against the following parameters:
Execution and Schedule: Achievement of planned formwork quantities, milestones and structural cycle times.
Productivity: Actual versus target productivity by work front, gang and structural element.
Formwork System Efficiency: Effective utilisation, reuse and turnaround of formwork systems.
Safety: Compliance with approved formwork procedures, inspection requirements and HSE standards.
Quality: Compliance with approved drawings and specifications, with minimum defects and rework.
Material Management: Material availability, reconciliation, reuse and control of wastage and damage.
Cost Optimisation: Reduction in formwork cost through improved productivity and resource utilisation.
Manpower Management: Effective deployment, supervision, training and productivity of workmen gangs.
Progress Reporting: Accuracy and timeliness of daily progress reports and corrective action plans.
Continuous Improvement: Implementation and measurable impact of formwork improvement initiatives.
Housekeeping: Compliance with site housekeeping and material storage standards.
5. Qualifications
Full-time Diploma or Graduate Engineering qualification in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Civil Engineering qualification will be preferred due to the construction-intensive nature of the role.
6. Experience Requirements
20–25 years of overall construction experience, with substantial experience in formwork and shuttering execution and management.
Mandatory experience in high-rise buildings and/or large-scale building construction projects.
Mandatory hands-on exposure to Doka, PERI, Mivan or equivalent modern formwork systems.
Proven experience in managing large formwork operations, multiple work fronts, manpower gangs and subcontractors.
Strong exposure to formwork planning, execution sequencing, structural cycle-time optimisation and productivity improvement.
Experience in large residential towers, commercial buildings, mixed-use developments or other large-scale building projects.
Demonstrated ability to manage formwork resources, material utilisation, quality, safety and project delivery requirements.
7. Functional and Technical Competencies
Formwork planning, scheme interpretation and execution.
Hands-on knowledge of Doka, PERI, Mivan or equivalent formwork systems.
High-rise and large-scale building construction practices.
Construction methodology and structural sequencing.
Formwork cycle-time and productivity optimisation.
Manpower and subcontractor management.

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Strong team leadership, local workforce management, and field problem-solving skills.
Physical fitness to manage active field operations under remote or outdoor site conditions.

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Description:
Tele Calling Executive
Responsibilities :
Provide academic counseling to students, assisting them in selecting courses, setting educational goals, and developing academic plans.
Conduct one-on-one counseling sessions to address student concerns, academic challenges, and personal development.
Assist students in understanding academic requirements, curriculum options, and graduation pathways.
Collaborate with faculty members and administrators to identify and support students who may require additional academic assistance.
Organize workshops and seminars on study skills, time management, stress management, and other relevant topics.
Stay updated with educational trends, resources, and programs to provide accurate and up-to-date information to students.
Requirements:
Any degree, or a related field.
Previous experience in academic counseling or related roles is preferred.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with students and effectively address their concerns.
Knowledge of academic requirements, educational pathways, and career options.
Ability to provide guidance and support to students from diverse backgrounds and with varying academic needs.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
Join us at IREZ Academy and make a difference in the lives of our students by helping them achieve academic success and personal growth.
Job Type: Full-time
Pay: 15,000.00 per month
Benefits:
Cell phone reimbursement
Work Location: In person

Job Type: Full Time
Job Location: Kerala kochi

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Recognize opportunities to up-sell the customer and sell enhancements to create a better Marriott experience or event. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours. Explain details and requirements related to attending a sales presentation to potential owners. Verify that individuals meet eligibility requirements for preview package sales/tours prior to scheduling a tour for a Marriott vacation club property. Determine and give complimentaries to guests as gifts for their patronage (e.g., rewards points, show tickets). Answer guest questions about property facilities/services. Receive, record, and relay messages accurately, completely, and legibly.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance; stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or GED equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Academic Sales Executive
Kochi,India
Full Time
Bachelors
About RedTeam Hacker Academy
RedTeam Hacker Academy is a globally recognized cybersecurity training provider committed to bridging the industry skill gap through hands-on, implementation-focused learning programs. Designed and delivered by certified security experts, our courses empower professionals with practical expertise across diverse cyber and information security domains.
Role Overview
The Academic Sales Executive will be responsible for driving course enrollments by engaging with prospective learners, understanding their training needs, and providing tailored course recommendations. This role involves proactive lead generation, follow-up, and relationship management to ensure high conversion rates and customer satisfaction .
Key Responsibilities
Conduct outbound calls to potential learners and follow up on inquiries.
Assess customer requirements and recommend suitable cybersecurity training programs.
Maintain a structured database of leads and ensure timely follow-ups.
Develop and nurture relationships with prospective students to enhance conversions.
Achieve and exceed sales targets through strategic prospect engagement.
Collaborate with the marketing team to optimize lead generation efforts.
Provide accurate and comprehensive course details, including curriculum, pricing, and schedules.
Stay updated on industry trends to enhance consultative selling approaches.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Education : Bachelor s degree or higher in any discipline.
Communication : Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Language Proficiency : Fluency in [Specify Languages].
Sales Acumen : Prior experience in academic sales, business development, or customer engagement is preferred.
Interpersonal Skills : Ability to build rapport and effectively engage with potential students.
Self-Motivation : Goal-oriented with a proactive and results-driven approach.
Technical Awareness: Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts (preferred but not mandatory)..
Why Join Us
Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
Opportunity for career growth in the rapidly expanding cybersecurity education sector.
Professional training and continuous development opportunities.
Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
Application Process:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their Resume to [email protected] with the subject line Application for Academic Sales Executive .

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support
About EY
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement - Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility - the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
Support preparation of leadership - ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.
Operational Excellence
Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
Assist the triage of requests for ad - hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self - service where possible.
Stakeholder Engagement
Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow - through on actions and high - quality execution.
Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Good analytical and problem - solving skills, with attention to detail.
Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high - quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client - focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables
What we offer you
At EY, we ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
130 years of trust. One team shaping what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,500+ people. Twelve countries. Four continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.

Designation: Associate/Senior Associate Customer Service
Experience: 0 - 6 years
Location: Trivandrum
Skill Required: Excellent communication skill, Word, Excel and Outlook
Education: GCSE Level or equivalent

The Associate Customer Service representative is responsible for delivering exceptional customer support through inbound calls and web-chat channels. The role involves assisting new and existing customers with insurance products, handling policy-related queries, supporting sales activities, and providing efficient after-sales service while ensuring a positive customer experience.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound customer calls and web-chat interactions professionally and efficiently.
Assist prospective customers by providing product information, quotations, and support for motor and home insurance products.
Support sales activities by guiding customers through the policy purchase process using internal systems and underwriting guidelines.
Identify customer needs and provide appropriate solutions while maintaining service quality standards.
Deliver a positive and professional customer experience across all touchpoints.
Resolve customer queries efficiently while adhering to company policies and procedures.
Escalate complex issues to appropriate teams when necessary.
Meet established service, quality, and productivity targets.
Work collaboratively with team members to achieve departmental goals.
Participate in training programs and continuously update product and process knowledge.
Support a culture of continuous improvement and customer-centric service delivery.

Required Skills & Competencies
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Ability to learn and use internal customer service and insurance systems effectively.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with customers.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to work.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

Disclaimer: At Allianz Services, we believe in fostering an inclusive workplace and in giving fair and equitable opportunities to all our employees, so everyone can succeed. We, the Allianz Services India community, welcome applications from all regardless of gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, age, nationality, religion, disability, or philosophy of life.
AboutCompany:
Allianz Services mission is to be the global services platform for Allianz Group, to improve & run operations, drive productivity, create a superior customer experience and to contribute to the transformation of Allianz. Allianz Services Pvt Ltd in India is the largest centre of competence for Allianz Services, which also operates in Romania, Mauritius, Italy, France, Singapore, Germany and the United States. Allianz Consulting, the internal consulting division delivering management consulting services across the full value chain and to all Allianz entities worldwide, is also a part of Allianz Services.
Allianz, the number one insurance brand in the world (1), is one of the leading integrated financial services providers worldwide and is headquartered in Munich, Germany. Its core businesses are insurance and asset management. Allianz Services is a company of the Allianz Technology group which provides IT and business services to Allianz across the globe.
In India, Allianz Services Private Limited operates from Trivandrum and Pune and is an ISO: 27001, ISO: 9001, CMMI Level 3 and an e-SCM Level 5 Certified organisation. Allianz Services India is a center of competence for Insurance Operations, Business Consulting, Business Analytics and Financial Business Services. The organisation is Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM by the Great Place to Work® Institute, India (2). We were featured among India’s Top 75 Best Workplaces in IT & IT-BPM (Business Process Management), 2020(3). We were also enlisted in the Best Companies for Women in India (BCWI) in the 2020 Working Mother & Avtar(4) studies, which recognizes and honours companies that are frontrunners in attracting, retaining and developing women talent.
In 2019 Allianz Services Private Limited was recognised among the top 20 Most Admired Shared Services globally by a bench marking study of SSON Analytics(5). At national level in 2019 the company bagged top 2 honours in the NASSCOM GCC Conclave under the categories ‘Transformation Catalyst’ & ‘Learning and Skill Development’. Yet another international recognition which came their way in 2019 was the GOLD prize at the 13th International Stevie Awards (6).
The company has the strength of over 2900 staff, and is growing rapidly with a strong focus and belief in delivering exceptional service and partnership to the customers, and moving people up in their life and career.

Job Title - Pricing & CPQ - Analyst - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 11 - Analyst
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad
Must have skills:PROS Smart Price Optimization

Good to have skills:Pricing Tools
Experience:2-3 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote-to-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams-sales, finance, product, and IT-to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client-s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis & Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best-in-class KPIs
Work as an integral part of the client-s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing & CPQ area.
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
2-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications & High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization & Management (POM) & Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Knowledge of other Pricing & CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

Additional Information
Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management
PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

Description:
Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary:
Talent Services is a core service function within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues in Europe West and participates in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. It is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes through the existing workflow for execution by the CAT and DAT teams.
The person selected for this role will be at the rank of Senior Associate and will be responsible for the deployment of multiple courses within one or more curricula for Europe West, working alongside the Senior Deployment Specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. The Senior Associate will oversee learning administration activities and report on course feedback. (50%)
The Senior Associate will support the end-to-end program lifecycle, including program planning, stakeholder coordination, participant and facilitator management, communications, learning logistics, program documentation, delivery readiness, evaluation, and continuous improvement. (50%)
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), ServiceNow
Essential Functions of the Job (Responsibilities)
Deployment (0.5 FTE)
Ensure end-to-end coordination of learning deployment activities, including validating training request forms, submitting item and class requests, and ensuring that CE credits are awarded.
Submit requests for online, virtual, and physical classroom sessions, as well as program requests in SuccessFactors for learner consumption.
Address learner queries related to credits, class requests, and compliance.
Monitor participant nominations and manage cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions.
Monitor and analyse reports, including credit reports, NASBA reports and evaluation feedback.
Ensure CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Build and maintain close working relationships with the EW Learning team.
Program Management (0.5 FTE)
Support EW Tax Learning Leads in executing regional learning priorities and learning initiatives.
Coordinate the planning and delivery of Europe West Tax learning programs, including timelines, action trackers, governance activities and key deliverables.
Manage participant, facilitator and stakeholder engagement activities, including nominations, communications, briefing activities and delivery readiness.
Support stakeholder meetings and governance forums, including agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking and follow-up.
Maintain program documentation, status reports, trackers and learning resources.
Support virtual and face-to-face learning events, including learner experience, logistics coordination and delivery support.
Monitor risks, dependencies and program actions, escalating issues where appropriate.
Analyse participant and stakeholder feedback, evaluate program outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with business stakeholders, facilitators and learning teams across Europe West.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Deployment
Understanding of EY and EY Talent.
Stakeholder management.
Strong IT skills in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and SharePoint.
Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to coordinate and work as one team’.
Drive the delivery of quality services and products to Talent.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly.
Proactive problem solver with a solution-oriented mindset.
Flexible and dependable; willing to adjust the work schedule as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Program Management:
Strong program coordination and organizational skills.
Strong program coordination, organizational and prioritization skills.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior business stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands simultaneously.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
Ability to interpret learning metrics, feedback and program data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
Ability to think creatively and identify opportunities to enhance the learner experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills are desirable.
Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures and time zones.
Learner and client-service focused, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
Job Requirements:
Education:

Description:
Learning Deployment Specialist Senior Associate
The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities
Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1–L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To qualify for the role you must have:
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as “one team”.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.
Experience in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including external vendors and key internal stakeholders.
Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as “one team”.
AI Skills
Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and effective prompting.
Ability to leverage AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and learner experience.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in business administration, Human Resources or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.
Additional Requirements
Training or certification in producing Microsoft Teams, Zoom or Webex sessions is highly desirable/essential.
Flexibility to work European Time Zone business hours; adjust schedules for peak demand and virtual learning support when required.
What we offer
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development and you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
