Description:
Senior Document Specialist
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and onbrand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate — Senior Document Specialist, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications). You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and produce collaterals such as placemats, infographics, presentations, proposals, newsletters, posters, banners, and other marketing collaterals using MS-based applications
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique, innovative, and effective solutions/design concepts to customers
Meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Adhere to EY brand standards and remain cognizant of visual as well as verbal guidelines
Mentor junior team members on best practices around applying creativity in production environment
Stay up-to-date with latest design trends, socialize, and advocate the same to teams/customers
Seamlessly manage multiple creative projects simultaneously
Work with minimal supervision and guidance
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree/College diploma (preferably in Graphic Design and/or related discipline)*
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
5+ years of relevant experience
Ideally, you’ll also have
Intermediate/basic knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Interactive PDF, Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics
Team management experience

Description:
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented AutoCAD Draughtsman to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming initial architectural concepts into precise technical drawings.

Role & responsibilities
Preparing detailed, accurate architectural working drawings using AutoCAD software.
Developing comprehensive interior design drawings, layouts, elevations, and sections.
Coordinating closely with architects and interior designers to understand and execute project requirements.
Revising and modifying structural and design drawings based on engineering changes and client feedback.
Ensuring all drawings adhere strictly to project specifications, industry standards, and timelines.
Maintaining, organizing, and updating digital drawing files and project documentation.

Preferred candidate profile
Qualification: Diploma or Degree in Engineering, Architecture, or a relevant technical discipline.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
As a content management specialist supporting the global content team, the candidate will be required to perform production activities in Adobe Experience Manager. This includes uploading content, choosing the correct modules to achieve marketing purpose, publishing content, and assuring the quality control and visual aesthetics of content, images, videos and other files. The candidate will also be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, and upgrading all pages while ensuring its optimal performance.
Your key responsibilities
Create a webpage based on all information provided/ add proper components/modules - as speci ed in the word document received from stakeholder/editor
Upload and publish content on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) for ey.com and related sites
Comfortable in using Content Management System (CMS) - managing, creating, and publishing the pages
Collaborate with stakeholders, designers and approvers to ensure content is published on time
Possess an eye for design and basic knowledge in design software such as Photoshop, Adobe Premiere and MS O ce software
Understand the offerings of AEM CMS to suggest the right templates and modules to the stakeholders for achievement of their marketing purpose
Good with image selection with respective to the content
Must have experience and be comfortable working closely with global teams
Be professional, con dent and enthusiastic; adapt to exible work timings; demonstrate exceptional work ethics and customer focus
Familiar with different content management systems
Possess a basic understanding of HTML
Demonstrate exceptional project coordination skills
Skills and attributes for success
Experience working within a complex web environment with global and local branches
Understands website best practices (image sizing, link placements, responsive design)
Familiar working in content management and digital asset management systems, ideally Adobe Experience Manager
Good with Photoshop and image manipulation
An eye for presentation and attention to detail
Possess a mindset to learn things and undertake add-on responsibilities
To qualify for the role, you must have
Understanding of AEM tool and complete understanding of diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, and upgrading all pages while ensuring its optimal performance
Ideally, you ll also have
Understanding of HTML
Experience with visual asset management
Technologies and Tools
AEM tool
Basic understanding of Sprinklr
Brightcove
Crownpeak
Basic understanding of Analytics
Basic understanding of Flourish
What we look for
Bachelor s or master s degree
Minimum 5 years of work experience in using AEM
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Oracle Fusion - Finance Functional - Senior Consultant
Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Senior Consultant with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and strong finance-domain and accounting knowledge. The role requires substantial hands-on implementation and support experience across Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), General Ledger (GL), Oracle Fusion Tax and Subledger Accounting (SLA). The successful candidate will contribute to functional delivery, solution design and client workshops while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Support end-to-end Oracle Fusion Finance implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Provide hands-on functional expertise across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA, including configuration, solution validation and issue resolution.
Analyse client finance and accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials processes and controls.
Configure enterprise structures, chart of accounts, ledgers, accounting calendars, business units, tax structures, subledger accounting rules and financial transaction flows.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and stakeholder reviews.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
Support finance integrations with Procurement, SCM, Projects, HCM, banking, tax, reporting and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including reconciliation and defect resolution.
Apply strong accounting knowledge to validate journals, period close, reconciliations, statutory and management reporting, taxation and audit requirements.
Track assigned scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies and quality, and provide clear status updates to project leadership.
Guide junior consultants and collaborate effectively with technical, integration, data and reporting teams.
Support solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, demonstrations and internal capability-building initiatives as required.
Experience:
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Financials, with strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
Strong implementation and support experience across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA, with the ability to configure and troubleshoot assigned modules independently.
Good understanding of finance and accounting concepts, including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, asset accounting, bank reconciliation, taxation, period close and financial reporting.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Financials implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation.
Experience in client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
Strong client-facing, documentation, estimation, coordination and stakeholder communication skills.
Experience across major sectors such as government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, and power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills:
Strong leadership, customer handling skills and ability to lead and mentor team members.
Ability to drive projects and teams independently, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Excellent organizational, time management, analytical and critical thinking skills.
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly.
Ability to follow well-defined release management processes and stay focused on release priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business traveling, which involves work at client sites. Willing to work in MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Understanding of AI applications in project portfolio management, including predictive analytics, automation tools, and AI-driven insights.
Education:
Mandatory qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance, ACCA or CMA from a recognised institution.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification is preferred.

Oracle Fusion - Finance Functional - Manager
Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Manager with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and strong finance-domain and accounting knowledge. The role requires substantial hands-on implementation and support experience across Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), General Ledger (GL), Oracle Fusion Tax and Subledger Accounting (SLA). The successful candidate will lead functional delivery, solution design, client workshops and project teams while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Finance implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Provide hands-on functional leadership across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA, including configuration, solution validation and issue resolution.
Analyse client finance and accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials processes and controls.
Design enterprise structures, chart of accounts, ledgers, accounting calendars, business units, tax structures, subledger accounting rules and financial transaction flows.
Lead fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and stakeholder sign-offs.
Prepare and review functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
Manage finance integrations with Procurement, SCM, Projects, HCM, banking, tax, reporting and external applications.
Drive CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including reconciliation and defect resolution.
Apply strong accounting knowledge to validate journals, period close, reconciliations, statutory and management reporting, taxation and audit requirements.
Manage scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, governance and stakeholder communication.
Lead, mentor and review the work of functional consultants while collaborating effectively with technical, integration, data and reporting teams.
Support pre-sales, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, demonstrations and internal capability-building initiatives as required.
Experience:
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Oracle Financials, with substantial hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
Strong real-world implementation and support experience across AP, AR, FA, CM, GL, Fusion Tax and SLA; candidates must be able to configure and troubleshoot these modules independently.
Deep understanding of finance and accounting concepts, including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, asset accounting, bank reconciliation, taxation, period close and financial reporting.
Experience in at least three full lifecycle Oracle Financials implementations, including at least two Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementations.
Proven experience leading finance workstreams, client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
Experience in client-facing delivery, project planning, effort estimation, team management and senior stakeholder communication.
Experience across major sectors such as government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, and power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills:
Strong leadership, customer handling skills and ability to lead and mentor team members.
Ability to drive projects and teams independently, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Excellent organizational, time management, analytical and critical thinking skills.
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly.
Ability to follow well-defined release management processes and stay focused on release priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business traveling, which involves work at client sites. Willing to work in MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Understanding of AI applications in project portfolio management, including predictive analytics, automation tools, and AI-driven insights.
Education:
Mandatory qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance, ACCA or CMA from a recognised institution.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification is preferred.

Role title
Job Description
Supervising Associate - Service Excellence
Job Summary
Talent Services act as operational business partners to regional talent teams and global functions, offering dedicated support to candidates and employees. Team provides expert advise and facilitate scalable, high-quality services at an economical cost model. We are a crucial part of the EY global talent operating model, supporting its All In strategy.
Support the analysis, mapping, and re imagining of Talent processes as part of EY GDS Service Excellence and Enablement transformation initiatives, with strong ownership of process artefacts, governance, and documentation quality across the deployment lifecycle.
.
Key Role and Responsibilities
The role supports EY GDS Enablement Services by executing high quality process analysis and documentation for Talent transformation programmes. The Supervising Associate will work closely with Config, Product, Business Analysis, Data, and Change & Integration teams to ensure that current state and future state Talent processes are accurately mapped, validated, governed, and ready for deployment, while embedding Service Excellence, continuous improvement, and change readiness principles.
Process Analysis, Mapping & Documentation Excellence
Document current state (L4) and future state (L5) Talent processes using standard programme templates and EY methodologies.
Develop and maintain L5 blueprints, user journeys (UJs), swimlane diagrams, and process variants, ensuring traceability to design decisions and business outcomes.
Perform structured analysis of process variants, edge cases, handoffs, and dependencies across Talent sub processes.
Update UJs, L4s, and L5s in line with configuration, design, data, and integration decisions.
Support creation of methods documents and process playbooks where required.
Delivery Support, Governance & Execution Discipline
Participate in design workshops, playback sessions, focus groups, and usability testing; take structured, decision oriented notes and translate them into validated artefacts.
Maintain the Process & Enablement (P&E) repository, documentation tracker, and version control logs to ensure audit ready governance.
Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables with disciplined execution, accuracy, and attention to detail.
Act as a Business Analyst for Talent technology initiatives where process design is tightly coupled with system implementation.
Change, Adoption & Capability Enablement
Provide structured inputs into Change Impact Assessments (CIA) by identifying role level, activity level, and behavioural changes.
Support development of training materials, job aids, and playback decks aligned to future state processes.
Consolidate and synthesize insights from focus groups and usability tests to improve design and adoption readiness.
Support broader continuous improvement and transformation initiatives within Talent and Enablement Services.
Service Excellence & Continuous Improvement Alignment
Contribute to process maturity assessments, KPI definition, and benefits tracking for Talent processes.
Support RCA workshops, issue analysis, and closure tracking where process gaps are identified.
Share best practices, standardization opportunities, and re useable assets across Service Excellence programmes.
Align process deliverables to EY s Service Excellence, Quality, Agile, and Business Excellence frameworks.
Skills & Experience Required
Experience
3-5 years of experience in business analysis, HR operations, Talent processes, or process documentation roles.
Hands on experience supporting process transformation, technology enablement, or large scale deployments.
Prior exposure to global delivery / shared services / consulting environments preferred.
Core Skills
Strong attention to detail, logical structuring, and process thinking.
Proficiency with Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, and structured documentation templates.
Ability to collaborate with Config, Product, BA, Data, and Change & Integration stakeholders to refine artefacts.
Strong written and visual communication skills suitable for senior stakeholder playback.
Foundational understanding of process re engineering, metrics, and quality concepts (Lean / Six Sigma exposure is an advantage).
Comfort working in fast paced transformation programmes with evolving requirements.
We invite you to take on this crucial role to facilitate transformative change and enhance excellence within our Talent service delivery operations. Your leadership and expertise will be essential in achieving our objectives and upholding EY s standard of excellence.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong technical foundation
Process Reengineering and Technology mindset
Disciplined Execution of the tasks.
Global Mindset
Influencing and Negotiation skills
Change Management, Adaptability and Agility
Innovative mindset and ability to relevant models suiting the context
What we look for
A person who has the energy and enthusiasm to initiate change with appropriate intentions. Demonstrates a commitment to positively impacting the overall situation. Focus on finding solutions and is willing to ask questions to develop creative resolutions. Genuine, approachable, and capable of uniting a team to work collaboratively towards a shared vision.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Job Title : Sr AI / Gen AI Engineer
Summary :
We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer / Lead to design, build, and scale next-generation AI systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and multi-agent architectures. The role will focus on developing intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool usage, workflow orchestration, and autonomous execution across enterprise business processes.
As a technical lead, you will drive the architecture and delivery of production-grade Agentic AI platforms, integrating LLMs with enterprise systems, knowledge sources, APIs, and decision frameworks. You will mentor engineering teams, establish AI engineering best practices, and collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities for AI-driven automation and augmentation.
Responsibilities :
Design and implement enterprise-scale Agentic AI solutions leveraging LLMs, tools, memory, reasoning frameworks, and autonomous workflows.
Architect Generative AI systems where to solve complex business problems.
Work with other team members to implement and deploy AI Agents into production.
Monitor and manage AI systems in production to ensure that they are meeting performance and reliability requirements.
Develop and implement best practices for building, deploying, and managing AI systems.
Stay up to date on the latest research and developments in AI and apply new knowledge to our work.
Collaborate with other engineers, scientists, and product managers to develop and deliver innovative AI solutions.
Mentor and guide junior engineers
Qualifications :
Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Machine Learning and generative AI.
6+ years of experience in software development
Preferred Skills and Experience:
Deep understanding of Agentic AI patterns including reasoning, planning, reflection, memory, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration.
Experience building autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as:
Microsoft Agentic Framework
AutoGen
LangGraph
Semantic Kernel
CrewAI
OpenAI Agents SDK
Microsoft Copilot Studio
Strong experience with modern LLM ecosystems including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
Experience with advanced RAG, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, and semantic search.
Experience with Prompt Engineering and Machine Learning optimization
Experience with deep learning models such as GANs, diffusion models, and transformers.
Experience with Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing.
Experience with Reinforcement Learning.
Experience with distributed computing and scalable systems.
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD.
Experience with Machine Learning ethics
Experience with AI applications in specific domains such as talent management, finance, or manufacturing
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
EY | Building a better working world

Continuously improve testing processes and methodologies.

Proven experience in software testing (manual and/or automated).
Familiarity with testing tools such as Selenium, JIRA, TestRail, or similar.
Strong understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) and testing methodologies.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work on innovative and cutting-edge projects.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Professional growth and development opportunities.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Work-life balance with flexible working hours.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Manages the daily kitchen utility operations. Areas of responsibilities include dish room operations, night cleaning, back dock cleaning and maintenance, banquet plating and food running. Supervises kitchen associates not actively engaged in cooking (e.g., dishwashers, kitchen helpers, etc.). Strives to continually improve guest and associate satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the procurement, food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the procurement, food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Orders and manages necessary supplies. Ensuring workers have supplies, equipment, tools, and uniforms necessary to do their jobs.
- Schedules events, programs, and activities, as well as the work of others.
- Monitors the inflow of ordered materials and the maintenance of current materials.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Assists with an effective dish room equipment repair and maintenance program.
- Conducts china, glass and silver inventories.
- Control inventories of food, equipment, smallware, and liquor, and report shortages to designated personnel.
- Coordinates banquet plating and food running with Banquet Chef and Banquet Maitred.
- Enforces proper breakdown procedures for banquets, restaurants, room service and associate cafeteria.
- Ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Inspect supplies, equipment, and work areas in order to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.
- Inspects food holding and transport equipment and maintains in working order.
- Manages all equipment, china, glass and silver and ensures adequate clean supplies of each.
- Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
- Performs all duties of utility associates as necessary.
- Purchases appropriate supplies and manage inventories according to budget.
- Supervises dish room shift operations.
- Knows and implements brand s Safety Standards.
Providing and Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Attends meetings and communicates with executives and peers as an effort to improve quality of service.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers associates to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Recruits, interviews, selects, hires, and promotes associates in the organization.
- Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Trains associates in safety procedures and supervises their ability to follow loss prevention policies to prevent accidents and control costs.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for associates to receive the appropriate new hiring training to successfully perform their job.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Job Summary
Service line -People Consulting Position Title: HR Transformation Technology - Senior Consultant
The Opportunity
Lead global requirements sessions, HR process design, operating model transformation, security efficiencies and value realization initiatives across technical implementations, post-go-live assessments and optimization solution design and implementations. Drive strategic alignment between HR, IT and other key leaders to maximize technology ROI and adoption.
Your Key Responsibilities
Configuration & Functional Support
Configure and maintain Business Process Frameworks and experience in at least 1-2 HCM Workday modules [Core HCM, Job & Position Management, Compensation, Advanced Compensation, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Talent Management, Performance Management, Recruiting, Learning, Benefits Administration, Payroll, Workday Help, Journeys, People Experience (PEX), Employee Voice (Surveys), People Analytics, Succession Planning, Career Hub, Skills Cloud, Benefits & Open Enrolment, Global Modern Slavery (Compliance)]
Manage security roles and domain policies
Create and maintain calculated fields
Develop and enhance advanced reports
Gather and document integration requirements
Define data mapping and transformation logic
Coordinate with Studio/EIB technical teams
Support integration testing and defect resolution
Assist with data migration and validation
Participate in full lifecycle implementations
Support SIT/UAT cycles
Conduct system health checks
Identify automation and optimization opportunities
Skills and attributes for success
5-8 years overall experience
3+ years in Workday HCM programs
Experience in at least 1 full Workday lifecycle implementations
Strong HR domain and process re-engineering expertise
Exposure to global HR operating models
Excellent stakeholder and executive communication skills
Ideally, you ll also
3-5 years of Workday HCM experience
Strong hands-on experience in configuration (BPs, security, reporting)
Exposure to integrations (EIB, APIs, Core Connectors)
Good understanding of HCM processes (Hire-to-Retire lifecycle)
Analytical and documentation skills
Supporting RFP pursuits and contribute to practice building
What we look for
Workday Managing Consultant with exposure across Core HCM, Absence, Compensation, Security, and Integrations.
Skilled in end-to-end configuration, business process design, functional analysis, and data migration using EIBs and advanced reporting.

Description:
Position Summary
The Academic Counselor serves as the key liaison between prospective learners and CADD Centres technical training divisions. This role is responsible for guiding students, engineering graduates, and working professionals toward suitable certification programs, managing end-to-end admission lifecycles, and driving enrollment targets through consultative advisory.

Key Responsibilities

Student Consultation & Advisory
Conduct one-on-one counseling sessions (in-person, telephonic, and virtual) to understand students' career goals and academic backgrounds.
Recommend targeted courses across engineering, design, IT, and project management disciplines (e.g., CADD Centre, LiveWire, DreamZone, Synergy).
Clarify curriculum scope, software tooling, certification benefits, and prospective career pathways.
Lead Management & Conversion
Follow up promptly on walk-ins, inbound inquiries, website leads, and campaign leads.
Maintain complete lead records, interaction notes, and pipeline statuses within the internal CRM system.
Conduct structured follow-ups to transition prospective inquiries into confirmed admissions.
Center Operations & Business Development
Meet weekly, monthly, and quarterly student enrollment and revenue targets.
Facilitate walk-in registrations, fee collection, batch scheduling coordination, and onboarding documentation.
Participate in student engagement activities, career conclaves, college seminars, workshops, and promotional events.
AboutCompany:
CADD Centre has long been at the forefront of design engineering, transforming lives through future-ready learning. From being a trusted technical training institute to becoming a hub for next-generation skill development, CADD Centre has continuously evolved to meet the demands of a dynamic world.

In our commitment to staying ahead of the curve, weve introduced AI-powered smart courses in Product Design and Building Design, built around the capabilities of generative AI. These courses equip learners with the skills and confidence to thrive in the world of generative AI careers.

We are not just another institute; we are career architects. Our job-oriented courses are designed to align with real-world roles, empowering learners to confidently transition into professional careers. At CADD Centre, we inspire students to think beyond conventional boundaries and become champions of sustainable development in their respective fields.

Description:
Job Summary
As a Senior within HR Managed Services, you will help organizations transform and optimize HR service delivery through process redesign, HR Shared Services, HR Service Centre set-up and operating model design.


The Opportunity
You will work closely with HR and business stakeholders to assess current-state operations, design future-state service delivery models, and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, governance, employee experience and service quality.
In addition to client delivery, you will play an active role in practice development and business growth by supporting solution development, proposals, market initiatives and reusable assets.


Your Key Responsibilities

Advisory HR Transformation
Assess current-state HR processes, service delivery structures, organization capabilities and pain points.
Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.
Design future-state HR processes, service delivery models, organization structures and governance frameworks.
Develop pragmatic recommendations and implementation roadmaps aligned to client priorities.


HR Shared Services Service Centre Set-up
Support end-to-end design and set-up of HR Shared Services or HR Service Centres, including scope, location considerations, service catalogue, roles, spans and layers, governance and interaction models.
Develop process maps, SOPs, playbooks, work instructions, service level definitions and RACI frameworks.
Support transition, knowledge transfer, training, testing, operational readiness and stabilization activities.
Define KPIs, reporting requirements and continuous improvement mechanisms for service operations.


Client Delivery Team Leadership
Own defined workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed scope, timeline and quality standards.
Build effective working relationships with client stakeholders, EY member firms and cross-functional teams.
Guide junior team members, review deliverables and support their day-to-day development.
Identify risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and communicate them proactively.


Practice Development Business Growth
Contribute to proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution design, effort estimates and client presentations.
Develop thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, case studies and reusable assets.
Support market research, account initiatives and internal knowledge-sharing activities.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes, HR service delivery and HR operating models.
Experience in HR transformation, process redesign, HR Shared Services or HR Service Centre set-up.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into practical process, organization and governance solutions.
Excellent communication, presentation and client-ready documentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across global and cross-cultural teams.
Open to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects in line with EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines.


Ideally, You'll Also Have
6-9 years of experience in HR Transformation, HR operations, HR Shared Services or consulting.
Master's degree in HR or a similar full-time MBA/EMBA.
Hands-on experience in HR operating model design, process mapping, service catalogue design, RACI development and SOP creation.
Experience supporting Shared Services transitions, knowledge transfer, training, operational readiness or stabilization.
Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting proposals, business pursuits and practice development initiatives.

Description:
Job Summary
Senior Document Specialist
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate - Senior Document Specialist, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications). You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.


Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and produce collaterals such as placemats, infographics, presentations, proposals, newsletters, posters, banners, and other marketing collaterals using MS-based applications
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique, innovative, and effective solutions/design concepts to customers
Meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Adhere to EY brand standards and remain cognizant of visual as well as verbal guidelines
Mentor junior team members on best practices around applying creativity in production environment
Stay up-to-date with latest design trends, socialize, and advocate the same to teams/customers
Seamlessly manage multiple creative projects simultaneously
Work with minimal supervision and guidance


Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree/College diploma (preferably in Graphic Design and/or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
5+ years of relevant experience


Ideally, you ll also have
Intermediate/basic knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Interactive PDF, Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics
Team management experience


Technologies and Tools
Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop


What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others

Description:
" >
As a Senior Technical Superintendent at BSM, you will be responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and cost-effective technical operation of assigned vessels. This role is pivotal in maintaining operational excellence and environmental compliance while fostering strong collaboration between ship and shore. You will play a key part in supporting strategic goals, delivering high-quality ship management services, and upholding safety and regulatory standards.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and control the technical performance of assigned vessels to ensure safety, efficiency, and compliance with contractual obligations.
Maintain close communication with clients and build strong working relationships to support operational needs.
Provide technical and operational support to vessels, including troubleshooting and implementing solutions for performance improvement.
Develop and oversee maintenance and repair plans, including drydock activities, ensuring timely and accurate execution.
Prepare, monitor, and report vessel budgets, ensuring cost efficiency and commercial viability.
Ensure compliance with maritime legislation, safety regulations, and certification requirements.
Plan and execute vessel inspections, audits, and follow-up actions to enhance operational standards.
Promote and implement health, safety, environmental, and quality policies onboard vessels.
Support and mentor sea staff, identify training needs, and provide onboard training during visits.
Manage purchasing activities and ensure timely handling of ship requisitions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the Company Management System.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or equivalent, OR Chief Engineer s qualification.
Minimum 3 years of sailing experience as Senior Officer OR 3 years of shore experience as Technical Superintendent in a ship management or owning company.
Experience with Container vessels is essential.
Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of vessel technical requirements and voyage regulations.
Excellent project management and organizational skills.
Effective negotiation and people management abilities.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Ability to communicate effectively in English with diverse stakeholders.
Proficiency in PC applications and digital tools.
Why You Should Join Us!
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
On-the-job training.
First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
Diverse workforce.
Technology-driven company.
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family!

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary :
Talent Services is a core service line within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) and acts as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues, participating in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team and is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes via existing workflow (SNOW intake forms) for execution by CAT and DAT teams.
This role is responsible for the deployment of multiple courses and learning events within one or more curriculum for EY Germany working alongside the Senior Deployment specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. Supports learning administration activities and monitors course feedback and evaluation results.
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), Service-Now
Essential Functions of the Job :
Responsibilities:
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to Schedule Offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the operational execution of learning deployment plans, including budget tracking, cost administration and coordination of event-related activities.
Monitor participant nominations in collaboration with DAT teams.
Manage learner cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions, including the coordination of alternative training dates and nominations.
Prepare facilitators for delivery of learning courses (logistics) and coordinate facilitator logistics and communications
Support event administration within learning systems by creating event codes, uploading participant data, agendas, and cost documentation, monitoring administrative completion, and facilitating event closure activities.
Coordinate operational event requirements, including badge production, print requests, participant materials, and other logistical activities required for successful event delivery, where responsibility has been assigned to the Deployment team
Manage and maintain learning-related SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Build and maintain close working relationships with EY Germany learning team
Contribute to other activities or projects across the wider Talent Development function
Ensure appropriate CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements :
Understanding of EY and EY Talent
Experience with learning management systems (preferably SuccessFactors Learning).
Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented working style and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to collaborate effectively as part of one team.
Ability to build effective working relationships across global and regional teams.
Drive and deliver quality services and products to Talent
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly
Knowledge of existing AI tools and capabilities, with the ability to identify, evaluate, and leverage AI-driven solutions to improve processes, efficiency, and user experience
Strong IT skills - Microsoft Office 365 suite - Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, etc
Proactive problem solver with solutions mindset
Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to delivering an excellent learner and stakeholder experience.
Flexibility to support business-critical activities during peak periods in alignment with local labor regulations and business needs.
Professional working proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.
Job Requirements :
Education :
Bachelors degree in Business, Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience or specialization in Human Resources is considered an advantage.
Experience :
3+ years of relevant experience in Learning Operations
Significant experience of working in HR in professional services or corporate environment
Working in international and diverse environments
Experience with SuccessFactors Learning is considered an asset. A strong willingness to learn and build expertise in learning administration systems and processes is essential.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Explore the Odoo Techno-Functional Consultant opportunity at Technaureus, Kozhikode. Apply with 3 years of experience in Odoo ERP implementation, configuration, and customization.
About the Role
Technaureus Info Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced Odoo Techno-Functional Consultant with strong functional consulting skills and a solid understanding of Odoo technical development. The candidate will work with clients to understand business requirements, configure Odoo solutions, coordinate customizations, and support successful ERP implementations.
Key Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document client business requirements.
Understand business workflows and map them to appropriate Odoo modules and functionalities.

Support API integrations and third-party system connectivity.

Prepare functional documentation and assist with user training.
Communicate with clients and internal teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Requirements
3 years of experience in Odoo ERP implementation and consulting.
Strong knowledge of Odoo modules, business workflows, and functional configuration.
Understanding of Python, PostgreSQL, XML, and the Odoo framework.
Experience in Odoo customization, module development, and third-party integrations.
Ability to gather business requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver effective ERP solutions.
What We re Looking For
A professional who can bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation, communicate effectively with clients, and contribute to reliable Odoo ERP solutions.
Work Location
Cyberpark, Kozhikode, Kerala, India.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As an Associate - Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Stay up to date with latest design trends, socialize the same to peers
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
Strong visual design capability
1-4 years of relevant experience
Ideally, you ll also have
Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
What we offer
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.
AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce Revenue Cloud- Sr. Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver innovative Salesforce solutions that drive business transformation. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex business challenges and develop tailored solutions that meet client needs. This role offers the chance to work directly with clients, building meaningful relationships and gaining insights into their business operations.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on relationship building and managing others. You will navigate complex situations, anticipate client needs, and deliver quality solutions. Your role will involve mentoring junior team members, guiding them through project tasks, and fostering a collaborative environment. You will also have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills, all while contributing to the firm's strategic goals.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be at the forefront of delivering Salesforce consulting services, helping clients optimize their business processes and achieve their objectives. Your contributions will be integral to the success of client engagements and the overall growth of the practice.

Description:
Experience Management Supervising Associate
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Job Description Role Title:

Consultant Department: Financial Modelling Location: Gurgaon and Mumbai

Roles and Responsibilities:

We are recruiting for an Consultant in the team. Your responsibilities will include:

Support the specification / design of models and analysis tools.
Develop models (incl. integrated P&L, Cash flow and Balance sheet models) from scratch.
Amend models developed by KPMG staff or by third parties.
Carry out financial analysis of the outputs of models.
Ensure the consistency in client models and create / maintain project documentation and data books.
Carry out testing of models as per KPMG quality control procedures.
Review models and feedback findings to clients using KPMG proprietary software.
Review and comment on revised models received from clients to verify whether review comments have been acted upon.
Document the operation of models and the findings from our work.
Document issues in a business model for inclusion in review reports and liaise with the project manager to fully explain the points raised.
Design and execute commercial analysis e.g. market sizing, market driver analysis, competitive benchmarking etc.
Develop business cases and business plans underpinned by robust financial analysis in support of strategic initiatives.

3-6 years working experience of Financial Analysis, Business Modelling or Financial Modelling;
A good working knowledge of accounting, financial statements, and financial analysis;
Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
A commercial outlook and a good understanding of the general business and economic environment.
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to build effective networks internally and externally

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role: SQL Developer
Experience: 3+ Years
Primary Skills: SQL Server, T-SQL, Complex SQL Queries, Python
Job Description
We are looking for a strong SQL Developer with hands-on experience in developing, troubleshooting, and optimizing complex SQL queries. The candidate should be comfortable working with large, messy, unclean, or inconsistent datasets and should have good problem-solving skills.
Key Responsibilities
Write and optimize complex SQL/T-SQL queries.
Develop and maintain stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers.
Strong hands-on experience with joins, subqueries, CTEs, temp tables, and window functions.
Perform query optimization and performance tuning.
Work with indexes and execution plans to troubleshoot performance issues.
Handle large datasets and identify data quality or data consistency issues.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, cleansing, and transformation.
Use Python for scripting, automation, and data processing activities.
Troubleshoot SQL/database issues and provide effective solutions.
Collaborate with business and technical teams to understand data requirements.
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on SQL
SQL Server / T-SQL
Complex SQL query writing
Stored Procedures
CTEs and Window Functions
Joins and Subqueries
Query Optimization / Performance Tuning
Indexing and Execution Plans
Handling messy / inconsistent data

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

About the Role
We are looking for a highly analytical and business-driven SeniorData Scientist to lead data science initiatives in credit risk andcollections strategy for our home loan portfolio. The role involvesbuilding predictive models, optimizing credit decisions, and enhancingcollections efficiency through data-driven insights.
Key Responsibilities
1. Credit Risk Modeling
Develop and deploy predictive models for:
Credit scoring (application behavioral)
Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD)
Analyze borrower behavior and creditworthiness using structured and alternative data
Monitor model performance and ensure stability over time
2. Collections Strategy Optimization
Design data-driven collection strategies across delinquency buckets
Build models for:
Roll rate prediction
Recovery optimization
Customer segmentation for collections prioritization
Recommend treatment strategies (call, legal, settlement, restructuring)
3. Data Analysis Insights
Perform deep-dive analysis on portfolio performance, delinquencies, and losses
Identify early warning signals and risk triggers
Translate complex findings into actionable business recommendations
