Oxyzo Financial Services

About OXYZO:
OXYZO Financial Services Ltd is a leading Fintech NBFC headquartered in Gurugram.
We are into B2B lending and cover both SME and emerging corporate customers in Pan-India, having our offices spread across 20+ cities in India, including NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.
OXYZO is part of the OfBusiness Group and was incorporated in 2016 having already built an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 11,100 Cr+ with a PAT of 375 Cr last year and is growing year on year with well-established processes and a governance framework with Marque investors including Creation Investments, Matrix Partners, Norwest, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave.

Responsibilities:
Actively sourcing and acquiring SME and mid-corporate clients across a spectrum of industries, including manufacturing, engineering, chemicals, pharma, textiles, and logistics.

Description:
We're Hiring: Cloud Engineers AWS | Azure | GCP

(Multiple Openings | 4 - 10 Years Experience | Multiple Levels)
Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Gurugram / Chandigarh / Chennai
Specific location and work model may vary by position and role.
Industry: Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra)
Employment Type: Permanent | Contract

About the Role
We are looking for experienced Cloud Engineers specializing in AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to design, implement, manage, and optimize scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.

The ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure provisioning, networking, security, automation, monitoring, and cloud operations. Candidates should be capable of managing cloud environments, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, optimizing performance and costs, and supporting enterprise-scale cloud transformation initiatives.

Open Positions & Designations
AWS Cloud Engineering
AWS Cloud Engineer (4 - 6 Years)
Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 8 Years)
Lead AWS Cloud Engineer (8 10 Years)
AWS Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

Microsoft Azure Cloud Engineering
Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Lead Azure Cloud Engineer (8 – 10 Years)
Azure Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineering
GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Lead GCP Cloud Engineer (8 – 10 Years)
GCP Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

1. AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)

Key Responsibilities
AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.
Work with EC2, S3, EBS, VPC, IAM, RDS, ELB, and Auto Scaling.
Configure cloud networking, subnets, route tables, security groups, and network access controls.
Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.
Monitor cloud resources using Amazon CloudWatch and configure alerts.
Manage backups, snapshots, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Implement IAM roles, policies, encryption, and security best practices.
Support application deployment, cloud migration, and operational activities.

Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design and implement scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS environments.
Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules using Terraform or CloudFormation.
Configure advanced networking, including Transit Gateway, VPC peering, VPN, and Direct Connect.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment.
Optimize cloud performance, availability, resource utilization, and costs.
Implement disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.
Work with ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud-native services as required.
Establish monitoring, logging, security controls, and operational best practices.
Mentor junior engineers and conduct technical reviews.

Lead AWS Cloud Engineer / Architect ( 8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-scale AWS cloud environments and landing zones.
Define cloud architecture standards, governance policies, and deployment patterns.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
Design multi-account strategies, hybrid cloud connectivity, and disaster recovery solutions.
Drive security, compliance, resilience, and FinOps initiatives.
Establish automation frameworks and standardized IaC practices.
Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and cloud engineering teams.
Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams.

AWS Skills & Tools
Core Services: EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda
Networking: VPC, Route 53, ELB/ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect
Security: IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Security Groups, AWS Organizations
Containers: Docker, ECS, EKS, ECR
IaC & Automation: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, Bash
Monitoring: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config
DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline
Additional Services: SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Systems Manager, AWS Backup

2. Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)
Key Responsibilities
Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
Work with Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, and Virtual Networks.
Configure subnets, NSGs, route tables, VPN Gateway, and network connectivity.
Manage Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and access policies.
Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
Monitor resources using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerts.
Support backup, recovery, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Assist with application deployment, cloud migration, and operational support.

Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design scalable, resilient, and secure Azure cloud environments.
Implement enterprise networking using VNet peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Azure Firewall.
Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform or Bicep.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
Configure Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, Functions, and container services.
Implement monitoring, logging, security policies, and compliance controls.
Optimize resource utilization, performance, availability, and cloud expenditure.
Design backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to cloud architecture decisions.

Lead Azure Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-grade Azure environments, landing zones, and subscription structures.
Define cloud governance, security baselines, resource organization, and policy standards.
Lead Azure migration, modernization, and hybrid cloud initiatives.
Design identity, network, security, and connectivity architectures.
Establish automation frameworks, reusable IaC modules, and deployment standards.
Drive cost optimization, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence.
Lead architecture reviews, technical planning, and engineering teams.
Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, DevOps, and application teams.

Azure Skills & Tools
Core Services: Azure VMs, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, Azure Files
Networking: VNet, NSG, Azure Firewall, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute
Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud
Containers: AKS, Azure Container Registry, Docker
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure CLI
Monitoring: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
Additional Services: Azure Functions, App Service, Azure Backup, Site Recovery

3. GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)
Key Responsibilities
GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.
Work with Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Configure VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules, routes, and Cloud NAT.
Manage IAM roles, service accounts, and access permissions.
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Google Cloud deployment tools.
Monitor cloud resources using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Support backups, recovery, patching, and cloud infrastructure troubleshooting.
Assist with application deployment, migration, and cloud operations.

Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design scalable, highly available, and secure GCP environments.
Implement advanced networking, including Shared VPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.
Build reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform.
Deploy and manage workloads using GKE, Cloud Run, and Compute Engine.
Implement CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
Configure centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards.
Optimize cloud performance, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs.
Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Support security, compliance, and cloud governance initiatives.
Mentor junior engineers and review technical implementations.

Lead GCP Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-scale GCP infrastructure and cloud landing zones.
Define organization structures, folder hierarchies, project strategies, and governance controls.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and hybrid connectivity initiatives.
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures.
Establish reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
Drive cost optimization, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Lead technical architecture reviews and provide guidance to cloud engineering teams.
Collaborate with data engineering, application development, security, and DevOps teams.

GCP Skills & Tools
Core Services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore
Networking: VPC, Shared VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud DNS
Identity & Security: Cloud IAM, Service Accounts, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, Organization Policy
Containers: GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Docker
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Google Cloud CLI, Ansible, Python, Bash
Monitoring: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Cloud Audit Logs
DevOps: Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Jenkins, GitHub Actions
Additional Services: Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Backup and DR services

Common Skills Across All Cloud Platforms
Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server
Cloud Fundamentals: Virtualization, networking, compute, storage, identity, and access management
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform and platform-native provisioning tools
Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell
Networking: DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancing
DevOps: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring & Operations: Logging, alerting, incident management, root cause analysis
Security: Least-privilege access, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance
ITSM: Incident, change, problem, and service request management
Documentation: Architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and technical documentation

Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
4 – 10 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, or cloud architecture.
Strong hands-on expertise in at least one primary cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP.
Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining secure and scalable cloud environments.
Proficiency in cloud networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or platform-native tools.
Understanding of CI/CD, automation, containerization, and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud security, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Relevant cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience with enterprise environments, cloud migration, hybrid cloud, and distributed systems is an advantage.

Preferred Certifications
AWS: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
Azure: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert
GCP: Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect

Cars24 Ludhiana Hub, Khasra Nos. 94 & 109, Khata Nos. 249/463 & 250/464, Village Jugiana, near MG Motor Showroom, G.T. Road, Ludhiana, Punjab 141003

Builder- Hub Ops

A Builder- Hub Ops (Floor In- charge) at Cars24 is responsible for day-to-day hub operations, including vehicle placement and movement, inventory tracking, vehicle inspections, and maintaining cleanliness, safety, and operational standards.

What will you drive?

Efficient yard operations through proper coordination and vehicle placement.
High standards of cleanliness and safety by performing housekeeping and cleaning tasks diligently.
Smooth vehicle movement and tracking by maintaining organized logs and ensuring timely inflow/outflow.
Rapid response to operational needs through on-demand task execution with minimal turnaround time.
Consistent quality through frequent inspections of yard and vehicle conditions.
Accurate car inventory management using basic Excel skills to support tracking and reporting.

Who are we looking for?

Reliable and detail-oriented individual with a strong sense of responsibility.
Ability to maintain clean and safe working conditions through hands-on housekeeping and vehicle care.
Good understanding of yard and vehicle management procedures.
Flexibility to handle on-demand tasks efficiently.
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for maintaining car inventory records.
Commitment to maintaining operational standards through regular inspections and task follow-through.

Why Join Us?
Drive key business initiatives and growth.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
Competitive compensation and career.

How to apply?

Fast-track your career to the next level by sending your resume to: deepanshi.1@cars24.com

We are driven by technology, operational excellence, and a strong commitment to delivering quality and value to our customers. As we continue to grow, we seek dedicated professionals who share our vision of transforming mobility across the country.

Job Title: Interior Designer Livspace
Locations: Chandigarh | Indore | Bhopal
About Livspace
Livspace is a leading home interiors and renovation platform that simplifies the home interiors journey for homeowners. We combine design, technology, and execution excellence to create beautiful, functional spaces.
Role Overview
As an Interior Designer at Livspace, you will own projects end-to-end, from the first client interaction to final closure. You will combine design expertise, customer empathy, and business ownership to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.
Key Responsibilities
Translate customer requirements into functional and aesthetically appealing space plans.
Own and deliver complete interior design deliverables.
Provide an exceptional, trust-led customer experience.
Manage the project pipeline and achieve monthly revenue targets.
Ensure a smooth and seamless handover of projects to execution teams.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of experience in residential interiors, including modular interiors and space planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, B.Arch, or equivalent qualification; alternatively, a 2–3 year diploma with 2+ years of residential interiors experience.
Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar design tools.
Experience in client-facing roles or design-and-build environments.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
High ownership mindset and comfort working in a target-driven environment.
Interested candidates can share their profiles at:
saurabh.jain02@livspace.com

Oxyzo Financial Services

About OXYZO:
OXYZO Financial Services Ltd is a leading Fintech NBFC headquartered in Gurugram.
We are into B2B lending and cover both SME and emerging corporate customers in Pan-India, having our offices spread across 20+ cities in India, including NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.
OXYZO is part of the OfBusiness Group and was incorporated in 2016 having already built an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 11,100 Cr+ with a PAT of 375 Cr last year and is growing year on year with well-established processes and a governance framework with Marque investors including Creation Investments, Matrix Partners, Norwest, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave.

Responsibilities:
Actively sourcing and acquiring SME and mid-corporate clients across a spectrum of industries, including manufacturing, engineering, chemicals, pharma, textiles, and logistics.
Conducting thorough credit and risk analyses to inform sound decision-making, while adeptly preparing credit notes to facilitate smooth deal structuring.
Ensuring seamless document fulfilment and timely disbursement of credit facilities Working alongside the leadership and risk team to structure competitive deals and onboard clients effectively.
Collaborating with the leadership to identify and capitalise on new growth clusters and industries Building and leveraging a strong network within industry circles to expand the business portfolio and capitalise on emerging prospects.
AboutCompany:
OXYZO Financial Services Ltd is a leading RBI-registered NBFC headquartered in Gurugram. We are into SME & enterprise lending with 5k+ customers spread across Pan-India. We have our offices spread across 20+ cities in India, including NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.

Incorporated in 2016, OXYZO has built an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 10,000 Cr+ since its inception in Nov 2017, and it is growing at a CAGR of 35-40% and a 4%+ RoA. We are backed by a marque set of PE/VC investors, including Creation Investments, Matrix Partners, Norwest, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave. We were valued as a unicorn in a Series A round in March 2022. OXYZO has 40+ lenders on its balance sheet, which includes SBI, SIDBI, Federal Bank, IDFC First Bank, Axis Bank, IndusInd Bank, Bandhan Bank, Bank of Baroda, Union Bank, Indian Bank, IOB, etc.

OXYZO also has a SEBI-registered Alternate Investment Fund (AIF) focused on emerging enterprises with commitments of INR 750Crs and a Debt Capital Market (DCM) advisory vertical which has structured/syndicated transactions of INR 4000Crs+ in the last 3 years.

Description:
ABOUT SAPCON STEELS PRIVATE LIMITED
At Sapcon, we don't just trade steel - we power the backbone of India's industrial growth. As one of the country's leading names in steel and industrial commodities, we've built our reputation on a simple promise: the right material, to the right customer, at the right time, every time.
With 35+ strategically located supply hubs across India and trusted partnerships with industry titans like JSPL, AMNS, SAIL and JSW, we sit at the intersection of scale and agility. From automotive plants and shipyards to solar farms, HVAC manufacturers, and the infrastructure shaping India's skylines, our steel moves industries forward.
Join us, and your work will directly fuel the projects transforming a nation.
Key responsibilities
Administer and configure the CRM: users, roles, permissions, profiles, fields, page layouts, and picklists
Build and maintain automations, including workflows, approval processes, assignment rules, and email templates
Own data quality: run regular de-duplication, imports and exports, validation rules, and data cleanup
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for sales pipeline, lead conversion, forecasting, and team performance
Reconcile CRM data with ERP and finance systems (orders, invoices, collections)
Research and build targeted lead lists by industry, region, company size, and product fit
Enrich leads with company data such as turnover, capacity, products, GST/registration details, and location
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
2–4 years of hands-on experience administering a CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Frappe CRM
Strong grasp of sales processes: lead to order cycle
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 especially Excel, including lookups, pivots, and data cleaning
Experience building reports and dashboards
Nice to have
CRM certification (e.g. Salesforce Certified Administrator, Zoho CRM Certified)
Basic knowledge of AI, SQL, APIs, or low-code automation tools (Zapier, Power Automate)
Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing multiple requests

Job Title

Executive

Position Reports To

Store Manager
Job Location- Chandigarh Delhi

Retail Store

Brief Summary
The Executive at ORRA Fine Jewellery is responsible for providing exceptional customer service, driving sales conversion, and building long-term customer relationships. They inform customers about new designs, schemes, and offers, support local area activities, and assist with the try-at-home scheme. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.

Brief Job Description (just an indicative list and not limited to the following)
1. Attend to customer requirements with a focus on driving sales conversion and delivering excellent customer experiences.
2. Inform customers about new designs, schemes, and offers to promote sales and customer engagement.
3. Support local area activities in collaboration with the Relationship Executive.
4. Assist with the try-at-home scheme based on instructions from the Store Manager.
5. Follow up with potential customers and visit them to close sales.
6. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
Desired Skills
1. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.
2. Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
3. Proven track record of meeting sales targets.
4. Detail-oriented and organized.
5. Ability to work well in a team.
6. Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays.

Role and Responsibility:
Note: Two wheeler and DL is Mandatory for this role.


To monitor closely the HL data and cross sell insurance (HDFC Life and Non
Life), fixed deposits and other products as introduced by the company to
home loan customers of HDFC Sales
To source open market business too and achieve the targets assigned
To be completely aware of the products being offered by the company and
understand competition offering and handle customer objections
To ensure proper customer profiling on each call / customer visit, to identify
and understand his/her needs and accordingly recommend investment and
Insurance options
Relationship building with the Home Loan Executives to which he is mapped
and to ensure joint calls with the HLE to ensure maximum attachments of the
files being disbursed
To build a relationship with the customer so that he/ she is able to cross sell
other product offering basis the need of the customer, thereby managing the
entire account of customer. FSA to ensure to source customers family details,
other general insurance details, other loan details etc
To be in sync and work together with the partner representatives
Understanding the joint ownership of the customer at the time of servicing
etc
To ensure timely renewal of the business sourced
To ensure appropriate processes defined are being followed and undergo the
training and certification for being compliant towards selling of various
products (insurance, mutual funds etc)
To always be well groomed and his sales kit should be organized and
complete
To maintain company first attitude and be respectful in attitude towards
other fellow colleagues, seniors , partners etc

Perform general office duties to support Sales & Marketing (eg, filing, sending emails, typing, faxing, copying).

Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Assisting with Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Perform general office duties to support Sales & Marketing (eg, filing, sending emails, typing, faxing, copying).
Prepare sales-related documents throughout the sales process (eg, proposals, contracts, or banquet event orders).
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally.
Gather materials and assemble information packages (eg, brochures, promotional materials).
Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott.
Enter, retrieve, reconcile, and verify information (eg, commissions, leads, third parties) in software involved in the sales process.
Answer guest questions about property facilities/services (eg, hours of operation, rates and room types, packages, promotions, entertainment, restaurants, special events).
Serve as the point of contact for clients and communicate with them by phone and email to respond to questions and requests.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Assisting with Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Title: Senior Sales Manager Steel Industry
Location: Bhubaneswar, Jamshedpur, Mumbai, Bangalore
Industry: Steel
Experience: 7+ Years
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Sales Manager with strong experience in the steel industry to drive business growth, develop new markets, manage key accounts, and lead the sales team. The ideal candidate should have in-depth knowledge of steel products, excellent negotiation skills, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify new business opportunities, develop new customers, and expand market presence.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, dealers, and industrial clients.
Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and organizational targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements.
Manage key accounts and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and business development plans.
Identify opportunities to improve sales performance, profitability, and customer retention.



Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably in the steel industry.
At least 5 years of experience in a sales leadership or managerial role.
Strong understanding of steel products, the supply chain, and the Indian steel market.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.


Required Skills
Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations .
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page (RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc., amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.

Description:
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
Position Overview
The Government of Jharkhand, in partnership with Room to Read and Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), is establishing a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to enhance the quality of education in the state, with a specific focus on Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN). As part of this initiative, Balvatika will focus on early childhood learning interventions for children in the 3-6 age group. The Associate will report directly to Officer, Literacy at State and will support the planning, implementation, and monitoring of Balvatika-related interventions across the state.
Responsibilities
Support the design and rollout of Balvatika interventions aligned with NCERT guidelines and NIPUN Bharat mission.
Contribute to creating developmentally appropriate, contextualized curriculum and other instructional material with the adaptation of the National Early Childhood Education Curriculum, Adhaarshila , to the Jharkhand context.
Coordinate with JEPC, SCERT, and DIETs to align early learning goals with the state s academic calendar and training plans.
Assist in developing the Training content, including framework, training modules.
Organize and support training programs for teachers, Anganwadi workers, and master trainers at state, district, and block levels.
Participate in classroom observations and learning assessments at selected sites.
Provide feedback to improve ECE delivery and the learning environment based on the observation findings.
Monitor implementation progress of Balvatika components in identified schools and Anganwadi-linked Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) centers.
Conduct field visits and collect qualitative and quantitative data on early learning indicators.
Prepare documentation, progress reports, and case studies highlighting best practices and challenges.
Provide administrative and technical support to the SPMU team related to early childhood education.
Liaise with stakeholders including government bodies, partners, and academic institutions.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Education, Child Development, Social Work, or relevant field. Master s degree preferred.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in early childhood education, FLN projects, or related development sector roles.
Strong understanding of pedagogy in Early childhood years. Effective learning ways for children, the role of the classroom environment in learning.
Understanding of ECCE curriculum and NIPUN Bharat guidelines.
Proficient in data collection, analysis, and report writing.
Experience working with government systems, particularly in Jharkhand or similar contexts.
Strong communication skills in Hindi and English.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Evaluation Engineer to inspect and evaluate used vehicles. Engine performance
Transmission
Suspension
Electrical systems
Body & paint condition
Interior quality

Use diagnostic tools and standard checklists for technical assessment.
Identify accidental history, repainting, or mechanical defects.
Prepare accurate vehicle evaluation reports and upload findings into the system.
Coordinate with procurement and operations teams for smooth vehicle acquisition.
Ensure adherence to company SOPs and quality standards.
Maintain transparency and professionalism during customer interactions.

Technical Skills

Good understanding of:
Automobile systems and components
Engine diagnostics
Vehicle body structure
OBD/diagnostic tools
Knowledge of accidental and flood damage identification preferred.
Basic computer and reporting skills.
Candidate should know two and four wheeler driving.
Candidate should have valid two and four wheeler driving license

Preferred Candidate Profile

Passionate about automobiles and vehicle technology
Ability to work in field operations
Comfortable with rotational shifts and travel within city locations
Valid Driving License preferred

Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Ludhiana, Kolkata, Ranchi
Experience: 0-2 years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Position Overview:
Radiowalla Network Limited is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Field Quality Control Executive to oversee the quality of our audio and visual content delivery across various platforms. The ideal candidate will ensure that the services provided meet the highest standards of quality, working closely with the operations, technical, and content teams. This role involves conducting field visits, troubleshooting, and implementing quality checks to ensure seamless service delivery to clients.
Key Responsibilities:
- Preferred: Male candidates only
- Conduct regular field visits to client sites to monitor and evaluate the performance of audio-visual installations and services.
- Perform quality assurance tests on equipment, software, and content delivery systems to ensure adherence to company standards.
- Identify and troubleshoot technical issues that may affect service quality and provide immediate solutions.
- Collaborate with the technical team to maintain and upgrade audio-visual systems as required.- Maintain accurate documentation of quality assessments, findings, and corrective actions
.- Provide regular feedback and reports to senior management regarding field performance, issues, and improvements.- Ensure compliance with health and safety standards during field operations.
- Build strong relationships with clients, providing excellent service and addressing any concerns related to service quality.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
- Freshers in any field, +2 or 10th who can join immediately
- Being multilingual would be an added advantage
- Willingness to travel extensively and work flexible hours as needed
- Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot under pressure.
- Strong communication skills to work effectively with both internal teams and clients
- Attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintaining quality standards.

Interested candidates can share their updated CVs at careers@radiowalla.in.

Track CC & PUP-level error trends and highlight deviations for corrective action.

Handle onboarding of personnel at CC & PUP.
Manage PA complaints in coordination with regional teams.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. \- Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
\- Support retail partners with business development strategies and on\-ground execution
\- Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
\- Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass\-out)
\- Freshers are encouraged to apply
\- Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
\- Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
\- Personal two\-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
\- Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty\/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
\- Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
\- Work Schedule: 6 days a week

Benefits

Driving Innovation: Join Us as a Retail Associate (Field Role) at Cars24!
Apply Now
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24
Phone: 9311243497
Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com
Locations: Vadodara, Surat, Faridabad, Noida ,Ranchi, Mumbai
What will you drive?
As a Retail Associate, your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with New Car Dealerships (NCDs)and generate high-quality leads for customers looking to sell or exchange their cars.
Your day will revolve around visiting 3-5 NCD outlets daily, engaging with dealer partners, and identifying customers interested in selling their old vehicles or opting for exchange deals. You will act as the face of CARS24 on the ground ensuring that every potential lead is captured, nurtured, and converted through our platform.
This role is not just about visits its about consistent follow-ups, relationship management, and closing deals. Strong coordination with dealers and timely follow-ups on leads will be critical to your success.
You will work towards monthly targets, where your performance will be measured based on lead generation, conversions, and dealer engagement quality. Your persuasion and negotiation skills will play a key role in turning opportunities into successful transactions.
To set you up for success, you will go through 715 days of structured training(classroom + on-field), equipping you with the right product knowledge, sales techniques, and tools.
Expect a high-performance environment with attractive incentives tied to your achievements because at CARS24, we celebrate results and reward top performers.

Key Responsibilities
Visit4-6 Dealerships daily to generate leads
Identify customers interested in selling or exchanging their cars
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealer partners
Ensure consistent follow-ups with NCDs for lead flow
Convert leads into successful transactions via CARS24
Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions
Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Working Days
6 days a week
Week off during weekdays

Who are we looking for?
Strong field sales mindset with willingness to travel daily
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Ability to follow up persistently and close deals
Self-driven, target-oriented, and highly energetic
Prior experience in automobile, dealership, or field sales is a plus

Description:
Company: Cars24 Services Pvt. Ltd.
Position: Technical Retail Associate (TRA)
POC: Anubhavi Singh
Contact no: 8448285788
Location: Ranchi
Salary Budget: Up to 4 LPA
Work Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Retail Associate (TRA) who will be responsible for handling walk-in customers at the Cars24 yard, understanding their requirements, conducting basic vehicle inspections, and assisting customers in selling their cars through Cars24.

The ideal candidate should have good technical knowledge of cars, strong customer-handling and negotiation skills, and a valid driving license.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle and assist walk-in customers at the Cars24 yard.
* Conduct basic inspection and evaluation of customer vehicles.
* Explain the vehicle inspection process and provide relevant information to customers.
* Pitch and convince customers to sell their cars through Cars24.
* Explain and sell the Car Health Report to customers.
* Build strong relationships with customers and ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Handle customer queries, objections, and concerns professionally.
* Negotiate with customers and work towards successful deal closure.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of vehicle sales.
* Maintain accurate customer and vehicle-related information in the system.
* Achieve assigned sales, conversion, and business targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Good technical knowledge of cars and basic automobile understanding.
* Strong communication and customer-handling skills.
* Good negotiation and convincing skills.
* Ability to pitch products/services and convert leads into successful transactions.
* Valid Driving License is mandatory.
* Comfortable working in a yard-based and customer-facing environment.
* Willingness to handle calling and follow-ups with customers.
* Prior experience in automobile sales, car inspection, vehicle evaluation, retail sales, or customer-facing roles will be preferred.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Customer-focused and confident.
* Good at communication and negotiation.
* Comfortable with calling and face-to-face customer interaction.
* Passionate about automobiles and knowledgeable about cars.
* Target-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Note: Saturday and Sunday will be working days. Your weekly off will be provided on any one day between Monday and Friday, based on the business requirements and roster.Role & responsibilities

From empowering customers to driving industry-wide change, we are building the future of mobility—today.

Job Description Job Title Center Manager Location Branch Name (as per requirement) Department Bancassurance Function Bancassurance YBL - Sales Reporting to Regional Manager Band 4
Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.

Customer Relationship Management
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
Job Summary
The role involves recruiting, training, and supervising executives to achieve business targets and insurance sales across a defined cluster of branches, while fostering a progressive partnership with the bank. The candidate will manage discrepancies at the cluster level, provide support for ongoing issue resolution, and oversee initiatives. They will also provide on-the-job training for operational processes and workflows to ensure operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
Recruit, train and Supervise executives to achieve the agreed business targets and insurance sales in the defined cluster and building a progressive partnership with the bank.
Manage the discrepancies at the cluster level, provide support for ongoing issue resolution, manage initiatives deployed, providing induction and on-the-job training for Ops processes and workflows to team in order to achieve operations excellence derive customer satisfaction.
Participate in the hiring process, Counsel and Mentor performance, Conduct Fortnightly PRPs, co-create and implement recognition platforms in order to build a capable and motivated team in the Yes Bank Relationship.
Anticipate training requirements for the partner and lead the development and deployment of partner training programs in order to increase the selling effectiveness of owned as well partner teams.
To ensure that the system requirements are met in order to the relationship is productive and mutually beneficial and compliant with all regulatory requirements.
Deploy and monitor implementation specifically Bank staff contests/RR in order to accelerate revenue generation with the Channel.
Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity.

Description:
Sales Associate - Health Insurance
Position: Sales Associate
Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry: Health Insurance / Insurance Distribution
Location: Meghalaya
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: State Head
1. About the Role
Smart IT Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for energetic, customer-focused, and target-oriented candidates for the position of Sales Associate - Health Insurance. The selected candidates will be responsible for promoting health insurance products, generating business leads, assisting customers in selecting suitable insurance plans, and achieving assigned sales targets.
The role requires excellent communication, customer relationship management, and sales skills, along with a willingness to work in a target-driven environment.
2. Key Responsibilities
Identify and generate new business leads through field visits, customer referrals, tele calling, and other sales activities.
Promote and sell health insurance policies to individuals, families, and prospective customers.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable health insurance plans.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
Maintain accurate sales records, customer databases, and daily activity reports.

3. Eligibility Criteria
Minimum: 10+2 / Higher Secondary.
Graduate in any discipline preferred.

Experience:
Freshers with good communication and sales aptitude may apply.
Experience in health insurance, life insurance, banking, financial services, or field sales will be an added advantage.

4. Required Skills
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic understanding of health insurance products or willingness to learn.
Willingness to travel locally for field sales.

5. Compensation and Benefits
Salary: As per company norms and candidate experience.
Attractive sales incentives based on performance, as applicable.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and retention.
Policy renewal and referral generation.

7. Candidate Requirements
Strong knowledge of the Meghalaya market and local business environment will be preferred.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of district-level business targets.
Good communication skills in English; knowledge of local/regional languages are Mandatory.

Interested candidates may share their updated CV: hr.executive@smartitservices.in

We Smart IT Services Pvt Ltd company executing the e governance projects of Central & State govt. Working with many State sponsored Health Insurance schemes.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.

Description:
Support the development and implementation of Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) plans for Sub-Recipients (SRs) and Sub-Sub Recipients (SSRs).
Collect, compile, analyze, and review program data from SSRs to ensure data quality, accuracy, and timely feedback.
Coordinate with State AIDS Control Societies, DAPCU, and other stakeholders to facilitate data sharing and program monitoring.
Ensure timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and other periodic reports.
Develop and strengthen monitoring tools, reporting formats, and data management systems for SRs and state-level partners.
Maintain and manage MIS data and program indicators, conduct periodic data analysis, and generate reports to support evidence-based program planning and decision-making.
Support the implementation and effective utilization of the online SOCH application and other digital reporting platforms.
Assist SSRs in establishing and strengthening systems to ensure donor compliance and reporting requirements.
Conduct regular field monitoring visits to validate reported data, improve data quality, and provide on-site technical support to CSC staff.
Build the capacity of community staff on data collection tools, reporting procedures, and M&E methodologies through training and supportive supervision.
Develop and implement capacity-building plans for CSC 2.0 staff and Community Champions.
Plan, coordinate, monitor, and evaluate training programs using pre/post assessments, feedback mechanisms, and training evaluation tools.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to organize and facilitate training programs and workshops.
Support cascade training initiatives by effectively utilizing the project resource pool and master trainers.
Maintain comprehensive training records, documentation, and reports, and share them with the Programme Manager.
Perform any other programmatic, M&E, or capacity-building responsibilities assigned by the Reporting Manager.
Degree in Social Science, Economics, Statistics, Population Studies (Demography), public health or development field (or equivalent).
At least 2 to 5 years of relevant monitoring and evaluation experience in the development sector.
Experience in the public health sector especially HIV/AIDS/ Tuberculosis will be an added advantage for selection besides qualification.

Strong knowledge of Monitoring, Evaluation, and Management Information Systems (MIS).
Proficiency in data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting.
Experience with SOCH Application
Good understanding of HIV/AIDS programs and National AIDS Control Programme (NACP).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and data management tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to conduct field monitoring, data quality assessments, and supportive supervision.
Experience in planning and delivering training and capacity-building programs.
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under deadlines.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Provide massage services to guests using props and/or products.
Provide body treatments to guests using body scrubs, wraps, and/or hydrotherapy.
Assess guest needs and inquire about contraindications (eg, allergies, high blood pressure, and pregcy) before beginning service.
Keep up to date with current techniques and modalities related to their field of work.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Position: Operations Manager
Location: The Vanda Hotel
Reporting To: General Manager
Experience Required: 7-10 Years in the Hospitality Industry
Salary Package: 50,000 - 60,000 per month
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
The Vanda Hotel is seeking a dynamic and experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day hotel operations, ensure exceptional guest experiences, optimize operational efficiency, and support business growth. The incumbent will work closely with the General Manager and lead all operational departments to maintain high standards of service, profitability, and compliance.
______________
Key Responsibilities
Hotel Operations Management
Oversee daily operations of all hotel departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, and Guest Relations.
Ensure smooth functioning of hotel operations while maintaining service excellence.
Monitor occupancy levels, guest satisfaction scores, and operational performance.
Guest Experience & Service Quality
Ensure superior guest service standards and prompt resolution of guest complaints.
Develop and implement service improvement initiatives.
Maintain high hospitality standards aligned with the hotel's brand image.
Team Leadership & People Management
Supervise, mentor, and motivate department heads and operational staff.
Conduct regular staff meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Ensure adequate staffing and efficient workforce utilization.
Financial & Business Performance
Assist the General Manager in achieving revenue and profitability targets.
Monitor departmental budgets, operational costs, and inventory controls.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.


Compliance & Safety
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, statutory regulations, health & safety standards, and hospitality industry guidelines.
Conduct regular inspections and audits of hotel facilities and operations.
Maintain proper documentation and operational records.
Vendor & Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Ensure proper maintenance of hotel infrastructure and equipment.
Monitor procurement activities and stock management.
______________
Required Qualifications & Skills
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional hospitality certifications will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 7-10 years of experience in the hospitality industry.
At least 3-5 years in a managerial or operational leadership role within hotels, resorts, or hospitality establishments.
Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Sound knowledge of hotel operations and hospitality standards.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Financial acumen and budget management expertise.
Proficiency in hotel management systems and MS Office.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
______________
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Guest Satisfaction Scores
Occupancy and Revenue Performance
Service Quality Standards
Cost Control and Budget Adherence
Employee Productivity and Retention
Compliance and Safety Standards
______________
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly Salary: 50,000 - 60,000
Performance-based incentives (as per company policy)
Paid leave and statutory benefits
Career growth opportunities within The Vanda Hotel
How to Apply
Interested candidates with relevant hospitality experience and strong operational leadership capabilities may apply by submitting their updated resume along with current and expected salary details to Vandahotelbalpang@gmail.com
