Description:
bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. In this role, you will lead high-impact hiring initiatives, optimize sourcing channels, build grassroots partnerships, and ensure a seamless pipeline from candidate selection to onboarding and training.
If you excel at execution, community outreach, and balancing quality with speed, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Direct Recruitment Planning (20%)
Review rolling 3-month hiring targets (location, quantity, skill requirements) and develop actionable recruitment plans.
Optimize sourcing channels, combining walk-ins, mass drives, digital recruitment, and specialized outreach programs (e.g., homecoming drives).
Identify resource requirements for hiring events and gain alignment/sign-off with leadership.
Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)
Mobilize recruitment teams and lead execution of scheduled hiring drives and events.
Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.

Company: Secure Meters Limited
Location: Sanand, Gujarat
Position: Plumber - ETP/STP Maintenance
Experience: 1-3 Years

About the Role
Secure Meters Limited is looking for a skilled and dedicated Plumber to support the maintenance and smooth operation of the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) at our Sanand facility. The candidate will be responsible for plumbing maintenance, troubleshooting, and ensuring uninterrupted plant operations.

Key Responsibilities
Carry out preventive and breakdown maintenance of ETP/STP pipelines, valves, pumps, and plumbing systems.
Diagnose and repair leakages, blockages, and plumbing-related issues.
Install, replace, and maintain water supply and drainage pipelines.
Monitor and maintain pumps, valves, fittings, and associated equipment.
Support ETP/STP operational teams during maintenance activities.
Ensure proper functioning of water distribution and wastewater systems.
Maintain records of maintenance activities and report abnormalities.
Adhere to all safety, environmental, and company guidelines.
Assist in plant utility maintenance as required.

Qualifications
ITI in Plumbing or equivalent technical qualification preferred.
Basic knowledge of ETP/STP systems and utility maintenance.
Ability to use plumbing tools and maintenance equipment safely.

Experience
1 to 3 years of experience in plumbing maintenance, preferably in industrial plants, ETPs, STPs, or utility operations.

Skills Required
Plumbing installation and maintenance
Pipe fitting and repair
Knowledge of pumps, valves, and water treatment systems
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Basic understanding of safety practices in industrial environments

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Willingness to work in shifts if required.
Team player with a proactive approach toward maintenance activities.

Description:
Field Account Manager BioA

For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Job Summary
For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Main Responsibilities Tasks:
Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).
Maintain the CRM with relevant and up-to-date customer and sales opportunity information in SFDC.
Develop and achieve account targets understanding customer needs and future plans.
Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.
Expand networks and sellupsell additional products and services.
Provide trainings, technical and commercial support to Sales Reps and customers in relevant products and processes.
Actively contribute to sales growth by identifying new opportunities at customer site.
KOL Management and development.
Identify and implement appropriate action plans to track key accounts consumption patterns.
This is an Individual contributor role.
Qualification Skills:
Master in life sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology or Biochemistry), With a PhD preferred. Experience in the industry from Bioasay group or Biosimilar groups preferred.
Minimum 5 years of field sales experience in the west region. Candidates with international experience are an addition.
Experience in handling Live Cell imagers, Confocal microscopes, Flow Cytometry, SPR or from the Cell Biology field will be preferred.
Relevant technical knowledge and extensive industry knowledge (eg. Biotech, Pharma, etc.)
Experience in selling capital instrumentation is an addon.
Result-oriented and highly motivated.
Capable of providing outstanding customer service.
Ability to manage complex issues using innovation and processes.
A track record of strong compliance and customer reference is required.
Ability to manage and work in Matrix organization.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Multi-Modality Reporting: Perform, interpret, and generate highly accurate clinical reports for a comprehensive range of diagnostic modalities, including MRI, CT, Ultrasound, X-ray, and Mammography.
Complex Trauma Imaging: Provide rapid and precise interpretations for high-energy emergency cases, including complex maxillofacial injuries (such as Le Fort fractures), polytrauma, and acute neurovascular events.
Cross-Specialty Collaboration: Partner closely with referring physicians, surgeons, and oncologists to discuss complex cases, offer diagnostic clarity, and guide patient treatment plans.
Quality & Protocol Management: Oversee and optimize imaging protocols across different modalities to ensure maximum diagnostic yield, patient safety, and minimal radiation exposure.
Interventional Procedures: Perform basic non-vascular interventional procedures (e.g., USG/CT-guided biopsies, FNACs, and fluid aspirations) as required.
Workflow Efficiency: Utilize advanced PACS, RIS, and 3D reconstruction tools to maintain a streamlined reporting workflow while meeting established turnaround time (TAT) targets.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MD / DNB / DMRD in Radio-diagnosis from a recognized institution. Fellowship training in a sub-specialty (e.g., Body Imaging, Neuroradiology, or Musculoskeletal Imaging) is highly desirable.
Experience:1-5+ years of post-qualification experience working in a high-volume, multi-modality hospital or diagnostic center.
Technical Expertise: Demonstrated competence in independently managing a mixed daily workload of advanced MRI, multi-slice CT, and high-resolution ultrasound/Doppler scans.
Analytical Skills: Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to synthesize complex imaging findings into clear, actionable, and structured reports.
Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to effectively consult with clinical teams and explain procedures empathetically to patients when necessary.
Perks and Benefits
Financial Package: Highly competitive tax-free salary or lucrative revenue-sharing models, supplemented by annual performance-linked bonuses.
Work-Life Balance: Structured, predictable shift timings with minimal on-call rotations and comprehensive paid time off (PTO).
Professional Development: Generous annual CME allowances, sponsorship for international medical conferences, and access to advanced sub-specialty training.
Relocation Support: Comprehensive relocation allowance, housing assistance, and family healthcare coverage.
Technology & Environment: Opportunity to work in a state-of-the-art facility equipped with the latest high-field MRI scanners, ultra-high-speed CT systems, and advanced AI-assisted reporting tools.

About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Job Summary
As an App Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing mobile app marketing campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram). You will work closely with the design, development, and product teams to increase app installs, improve user acquisition, and maximize return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Key Responsibilities
Paid Advertising Display, Video, and Performance Max.
CPI, CPA, and ROAS.
User Acquisition & Growth Analytics & Performance Tracking Manager, Firebase, Google Analytics, and other attribution tools.
Retention Rate.
Creative Collaboration creatives.
Market Research practices.
Requirements
Good understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms.
Knowledge of mobile app marketing and user acquisition strategies.
Experience with Google App Campaigns is preferred.
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager, and Google Analytics.
Basic understanding of Firebase Analytics and app attribution tools is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to interpret campaign data and optimize performance.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for campaign reporting.
Google Ads and Meta Blueprint Certifications are an added advantage.
Freshers with hands-on experience through internships, certifications, or personal projects are encouraged to apply.
Experience promoting Android or iOS mobile applications is preferred.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred).

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Agency SalesSales Life Insurance, Field SalesInsurance SalesBfsi SalesAgency ChannelInsurance Marketing, About company, Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Description:
Role :
To drive new business growth and revenue for the life insurance company by recruiting, training, managing, and retaining a dedicated network of tied insurance advisors/agents

Key Responsibilities
Advisor Recruitment: Prospect, interview, select, and appoint new life insurance advisors/agents to build a strong, active agency force.
Sales Target Achievement: Drive and monitor monthly, quarterly, and annual premium collection and policy issuance targets through the assigned advisor team.
Training & Enablement: Train, coach, and develop advisors on life insurance products, pitching, objection handling, and digital sales tools/CRM portals.
Advisor Activation & Retention: Ensure active participation (activation) of recruited agents, conduct regular huddles/meetings, and drive retention to lower agent attrition.
Compliance & Quality: Maintain high standards of business ethics, ensure proper customer documentation, prevent policy lapses/fraud, and adhere to IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India) guidelines.
Customer Servicing: Assist agents and policyholders with post-sales service, renewals, claims support, and grievance handling.
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
jaro education
Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

The B2B College Connect Sales role is responsible for driving institutional sales across engineering colleges and universities. The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
Achieve assigned revenue, acquisition, and growth targets consistently.
Ensure repeat business and account expansion within existing partner institutions.
Coordinate with internal teams (content, delivery, operations, finance) to ensure smooth program onboarding and execution.
Track and maintain sales pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and NEP-driven changes to refine sales pitches and proposals.
Participate in academic events, conferences, and institutional meetings to strengthen brand presence.

Reporting: Head College Connect Sales

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Preferred)
MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management (Preferred)

Domain & Functional Expertise
Strong experience in B2B institutional sales, preferably in EdTech or higher education solutions. Good understanding of engineering education ecosystem and campus buying processes.

Behavioral & Professional Skills:
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Relationship-driven approach with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
Result-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution focus.
Professional demeanor with high ethical standards.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Territorial Scope: Regional / Location (as assigned)

Description:
Role and Responsibilities

1. Business Analysis & Consulting
Conduct discovery sessions to understand client business processes, challenges, and goals
Analyse workflows and identify opportunities for optimisation and automation
Document business requirements, process maps, and user journeys
Support consulting workshops focused on transformation and solutioning

2. AI-Driven Solutioning
Identify opportunities to integrate AI (Generative AI, automation, analytics) into business processes
Assist in designing AI-enabled solutions aligned with business objectives
Contribute to solution frameworks including AI use cases, automation strategies, and integrations

3. Pre-Sales & Solution Support
Collaborate with sales and consulting teams to prepare demos and proposals
Translate business needs into scalable and commercially viable solutions
Support client presentations and solution walkthroughs

4. Implementation & Delivery
Assist in configuring and optimising SaaS platforms (CRM, ERP, HRMS, etc.)
Work with development teams on customisations and integrations
Prepare Functional Solution Documents (FSDs)
Support testing, UAT, and deployment activities
Ensure successful solution adoption by end users

5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation
Stay updated with AI trends, SaaS innovations, and emerging technologies
Identify opportunities for process improvement and AI adoption
Contribute to internal knowledge building and reusable solution assets

Skills & Experience
13 years in Business Analysis, Consulting, or SaaS implementation
Exposure to business applications (CRM, ERP, HRMS, etc.)
Basic understanding or strong interest in AI and automation technologies
Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to think consultatively and solution-oriented
Understanding of process mapping and requirement documentation

What Sets This Role Apart
Exposure to end-to-end solution lifecycle (pre-sales to delivery)
Opportunity to work on AI-first consulting engagements
Real-world experience in digital transformation projects
Multi-disciplinary growth across AI, consulting, and technology

Benefits & Perks
Competitive salary with performance-based growth
High ownership and direct client impact
Fast-track career progression into consulting roles
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and digital transformation projects

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in developing AI solutions using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, RAG architectures, vector databases, and modern cloud platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop GenAI applications using GPT-4, Claude, Llama, Gemini, or similar LLMs.
Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Develop Agentic AI and Multi-Agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
Implement prompt engineering techniques to improve model performance and response quality.
Integrate vector databases for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Build scalable APIs and backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and monitor AI model performance.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and cloud services.
Implement AI guardrails, security controls, content filtering, and responsible AI practices.
Collaborate with product, data engineering, and cloud teams to deploy production-ready solutions.

Generative AI / Agentic Ai

Preferred Experience
Experience building enterprise chatbots, copilots, or knowledge assistants.
Hands-on implementation of multi-agent workflows.
Experience with semantic search, embeddings, reranking, and hybrid search.
Exposure to monitoring tools such as LangSmith, Azure Application Insights, or Prompt Flow.
Experience with AI governance, evaluation frameworks, and model observability.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
2-6 years of software development experience.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in Generative AI/LLM projects.
Nice to Have
Azure AI Engineer (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams integrations, or enterprise workflow automation.
Exposure to fine-tuning, LoRA, PEFT, and open-source LLM deployment.

Description:
CustomerCare Executive IIFL Gold Loan (Detailed JD)

RoleOverview
A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Description:
. Clinical Assistance & Interventional Radiology Support
Procedure Assistance: Scrubbing and assisting the Interventional Radiologist during advanced sterile procedures (e.g., biopsies, FNACs, drainage procedures, angioplasties, catheter insertions).
Patient Preparation: Preparing the patient for procedures, securing IV access, administering local anesthesia/sedation as directed, and monitoring vital signs (BP, heart rate, SPO2) throughout the scan or procedure.
Emergency Management: Swiftly managing contrast reactions, allergic responses, or vasovagal attacks under the radiologists supervision.
2. Documentation & Reporting
Consent Verification: Ensuring all high-risk consent forms (for contrast administration or invasive procedures) are properly signed, verified, and filed.
Patient Records: Accurately maintaining patient history logs, screening questionnaires (e.g., MRI safety checklists, kidney function/creatinine reports before CT scans), and pre-procedure charts.
Billing & Reporting Coordination: Coordinating between the radiologist, technicians, and front desk to ensure timely entry of consumable bills and dispatch of diagnostic reports.
3. Inventory Control & Stock Management
Stock Auditing: Monitoring and managing the daily stock of medicines, contrast agents (e.g., Omnipaque, Visipaque), emergency drugs, syringes, and sterile packs.
Expiry & Breakdown Tracking: Keeping an updated log of drug expiry dates and ensuring the crash cart is 100% prepared and checked every shift.
Indenting: Raising timely indents/requests to the central pharmacy or purchase department to ensure zero shortage of critical materials.
4. Patient Care & Safety
Radiation Safety: Ensuring strict adherence to radiation protection protocols (providing lead aprons to patients/helpers when necessary).
Infection Control: Maintaining a highly sterile environment in the ultrasound/CT biopsy rooms and interventional suites according to NABH guidelines.
Post-Procedure Care: Monitoring patients in the recovery bay post-biopsy or post-sedation before formal discharge.
Perks & Benefits
Fixed/Structured Hours: Unlike general ward nurses, radiology nurses typically enjoy structured shift hours, fewer night shifts, and more predictable schedules.
Technical Upskilling: Specialized hands-on training in Interventional Radiology (IR), handling advanced medical devices, and working directly alongside expert Radiologists.
Radiation Allowance / Protection Perks: Provision of specialized protective gear (custom lead aprons, thyroid shields) and mandatory TLD Badges for continuous radiation dose monitoring.
Career Growth & Certifications: Opportunities to lead a nursing team within a growing diagnostic chain, with sponsored certifications in basic life support (BLS/ACLS) and radiology nursing.
Standard Healthcare Benefits: Competitive salary package with EPF, ESIC eligibility, paid annual leaves, and medical insurance coverage. Call us on 90993 33333

Job Description
Job description Sales (LAP) Area Sales Manager
Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. We are expanding our footprint and are excited to offer opportunities in the LAP (Loan Against Property) segment in the LAP region.
Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our LAP team at IIFL Finance. This role involves promoting our Loan Against Property products, building relationships with clients, and achieving sales targets in the LAP region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.
Key Responsibilities:
DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
5+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

Description:
Functions as the property s strategic ficial business leader.
The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees.
The position provides the ficial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment.
In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand s business strategy and focuses on the execution of ficial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable ficial results.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 4-year bachelors degree in Fice and Accounting or related major; 2 years experience in the fice and accounting or related professional area. OR
- Masters degree in Fice and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making
- Analyzes ficial data and market trends.
- Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
- Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
- Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc
- Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans
- Protects and strengthens our competitive advantage by advocating and supporting sound business and ficial decision making.
- Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.
- Implements a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
Leading Accounting Teams
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
- Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
- Holds staff accountable for successful performance.
Developing and Maintaining Fice and Accounting Goals
- Supports property strategy from a fice and accounting perspective
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Ensures appropriate corrections are made to audit results if necessary.
- Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
- Generates and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).
- Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
- Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Ensures that the P&L is accurate (eg, costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders
- Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc).
- Understands the owners perspective and ROI expectations.
- Anticipates and addresses owner needs and involves ownership in key decisions.
- Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the propertys strategies and to lead own team.
- Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/ficial issues.
- Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.
- Attends owners meetings in order to provide context and explanation for ficial results.
- Attends meetings and communicates with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
- Demonstrates a commitment to meeting the needs of all key stakeholders.
- Communicates ficial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Ensures new hires participate in the department s orientation program.
- Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Location GIFT City, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Role Purpose
Responsible for managing day-to-day accounting, financial records, MIS and GIFT City related statutory compliances for the company, ensuring accuracy of books and timely reporting.

Key Accountabilities
Accounting & Book Closure
Manage day-to-day accounting including vendor invoices, payments, receipts and journal entries.
Maintain proper books of accounts, ledgers and supporting documentation.
Carry out bank, vendor and other account reconciliations.
Support monthly and annual book closure and ensure necessary provisions/accruals are recorded.
Maintain schedules for fixed assets, advances, deposits, payables and receivables.
MIS & Reporting
Prepare monthly MIS on expenses, cash position and key financial transactions.
Track actual expenses against budgets and highlight major variances.
Provide basic financial information and reports required by management.
Maintain proper records and trackers to ensure visibility of payments and outstanding liabilities.
Tax & Statutory Compliance
Timely submission of all GIFT City related statutory and regulatory reports and ensure full compliance with the same.
Support routine GST and TDS compliance, including maintaining records and coordinating timely filings.
Ensure timely payment of applicable statutory dues.
Maintain proper documentation required for statutory and tax compliance.
Coordinate with external CA/tax consultants for filings and other compliance requirements.
Audit & Controls
Provide required information and schedules for statutory/internal audits.
Ensure invoices and payments have appropriate approvals and supporting documents.
Maintain proper financial records and documentation for audit trail purposes.
Follow applicable accounting policies and internal financial controls.
Vendor & Administrative Finance
Coordinate with vendors for invoices, account confirmations and payment-related matters.
Process employee reimbursements and other office expenses as applicable.
Support finance-related requirements arising from the setting up and running of the GIFT City office.

Preferred Profile
B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter or similar finance qualification.
Around 36 years of hands-on accounting and compliance experience would be suitable for this scope.
Working knowledge of GST, TDS, reconciliations, book closure and MIS.
Exposure to GIFT City related compliance with be an advantage.
Good working knowledge of Excel and an accounting/ERP system.
Comfortable working independently in a small set-up where the role will be hands-on.Role & responsibilities

Description:
Corporate Sales Manager (New Client Acquisition)
Company: Delhivery
Mode: On-site, 6 Days/week
Location: Ahmedabad

What Youll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhiverys hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers

Who We’re Looking For
4–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities.

Description:
Reliability Engineer
Location: Chennai / Vadodara
Experience: 5-12 Years
Qualification: Diploma / BE / B.Tech
We are hiring experienced Reliability Engineers with strong expertise in Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), FMEA, RCA, and Reliability Analytics.
Key Skills (Mandatory):
Reliability Engineer
Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM)
FMEA (Failure Mode & Effects Analysis)
RCA (Root Cause Analysis)
Reliability Analytics
MTBF & MTTR Analysis
Equipment Criticality Assessment
Maintenance Optimization
CMMS
Job Responsibilities:
Develop, review, and optimize maintenance strategies using RCM, FMEA, and Preventive Maintenance methodologies.
Conduct equipment criticality assessments and reliability studies.
Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring equipment failures and implement corrective actions.
Analyze reliability KPIs such as MTBF, MTTR, Availability, and OEE.
Develop reliability models and leverage CMMS data for performance analysis.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance asset reliability and reduce downtime.
Improve labor and material utilization through maintenance optimization.
Preferred Industry Experience:
Oil & Gas
Petrochemical
Refinery
Chemical
Power Generation

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities.
Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and automation-related machine issues.
Monitor machine performance and minimize equipment downtime.
Conduct regular inspections of machinery and identify potential failures.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
As one of the world s leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world.
As a provider of multi-disciplined technical services to the built environment, Atkins India is committed to design excellence in the delivery of first class solutions which combine innovation, imagination and best practice.
Due to our continuing expansion we currently have an opportunity for a Senior Highways Engineer on multi-disciplinary offshore executed projects from Bangalore office.
Working in a multidisciplinary team of designers and engineers providing a professional design service to our clients, this is an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to develop their international experience with a world renowned consultant.

Your Role

Qualified Degree in Civil Engineering from a reputed College.
Have relevant experience in the region of around 8 to 12 years in consultancy business working on highways and related features.
Experienced user of Civil3D/ Open Roads, MX design, AutoCAD.
Knowledge in highways design codes and standards. (KSA/Qatar/UAE/DMRB/AASHTHO).
Experience implementing quality standards and procedures.
A very good knowledge of working in all applications of MS Office.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Evidence of having successfully delivered highway projects.

About You
Qualifications & Skills

Holds a Masters Degree in a relevant discipline.
Expert in the use of Civil3D ,Open Roads road design software and AutoCAD.
Experience of using AutoDesk Civils 3D for the design of highway schemes.
Experience of the design of grade separated junctions.
Experience of the design of pipe drainage networks.
Working knowledge of KSA/Qatar/UAE/DMRB/AASHTHO.
project based supervision of designers and drafting staff.
maintaining technical quality standards and mentoring junior designers.
delivering projects to time and budget.
liaising with UK based customers in a responsive and client focused manner.
Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
Have a track record of technical achievement and client satisfaction within the highways and bridges industry.
Be able to work with minimal supervision.
Have the ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
Have the experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
The position is to be based in Bangalore .
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

About AtkinsR alis

Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.
Worker Type Employee
Job Type Regular
At AtkinsR alis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Job Description



Platform Automation Developer - Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell Shell
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Platform Automation Developer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell, and Shell scripting. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building platform-level automation solutions that enable deployment, configuration, packaging, orchestration, and lifecycle management of applications across Linux, Windows, VM, and containerized environments.


Your Role
As a Platform Automation Developer, you will design and develop automation frameworks, orchestration services, deployment tooling, and platform utilities that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with DevOps, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to deliver robust automation solutions.


Key Responsibilities
Develop platform-level automation and orchestration components for deployment, configuration, packaging, and management of application workloads.
Build automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash/Shell, and related technologies.
Automate application installation, configuration, service management, environment setup, and health validation processes.
Develop and maintain container images, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and deployment packages.
Create build, release, and packaging automation for Linux and Windows-based applications.
Develop PowerShell automation for Windows workloads and Python/Shell automation for Linux environments.
Integrate automation components with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) frameworks.
Implement logging, monitoring, validation, exception handling, rollback, and retry mechanisms within automation workflows.
Develop APIs, CLI tools, and platform services to support automated provisioning and environment management.
Implement secure handling of credentials, certificates, secrets, and configuration parameters.


Required Skills Experience
6+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Automation Development, DevOps, or Infrastructure Automation.
Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on expertise in PowerShell and Bash/Shell scripting.
Strong experience with Kubernetes administration, deployment, and troubleshooting.
Experience creating and maintaining Helm Charts, Kubernetes manifests, and containerized deployments.
Knowledge of Docker containerization and image management.
Experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code concepts and automation frameworks.
Experience developing APIs, command-line tools, or automation services.


Mandatory Skills
Kubernetes
Python Development
PowerShell Scripting
Bash/Shell Scripting
Docker
Helm Charts
CI/CD Pipelines
Infrastructure Automation
Linux Administration
Windows Automation

Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Quality Assurance Engineer (QAE 2) with strong expertise in Java, Selenium, Appium, and Rest Assured to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing robust automated test solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of web and mobile applications.
Position: Quality Assurance Engineer 2 (QAE 2); Experience: 5 to 8 Years; Location: Bangalore / Mumbai; Employment Type: Full-Time (Hybrid)
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web and mobile applications.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Java, Selenium WebDriver, Appium, and Rest Assured.
Perform functional, integration, regression, API, and end-to-end testing.
Validate REST APIs and microservices using automation frameworks and API testing tools.
Collaborate closely with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases.
Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
Identify, log, track, and verify defects through their lifecycle.
Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration for automated test execution.
Prepare test plans, test cases, test reports, and quality metrics.
Continuously improve test coverage, framework stability, and test execution efficiency.
Required Skills
Must-Have Skills
5-8 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Test Automation.
Strong programming expertise in Java.
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver for web automation.
Strong experience with Appium for mobile Automation testing (Android/iOS).
Extensive experience in REST API Automation using Rest Assured.
Experience with TestNG/JUnit frameworks.
Good understanding of API testing, JSON, XML, and Microservices architecture.
Experience in defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Strong knowledge of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Experience with Git version control.
Preferred Skills
CI/CD experience using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
Exposure to Docker and cloud environments.
Experience working with SQL databases and backend validation.
Knowledge of performance testing tools is an added advantage.
Exposure to Banking or Financial Services domain is preferred.
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Key Technologies
Java | Selenium | Appium | Rest Assured | TestNG | JUnit | API Testing | Microservices | Jenkins | Git | Agile | JIRA | SQL

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Supervision of Accenture Senior and Junior analysts and client personnel to drive delivery outcomes.

Should know how to deliver Workday engagements across different implementation approaches including excellent understanding of client business processes, pain points, solution options and organization structure.
Should know how to support BDs and Proposals

Deep knowledge and experience in Finance and Controlling Org structure and design, Workday Implementation and rollout point of views, approach and design principles, roadmap and business case definition.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and lead global distributed teams across Platforms.
6+ years' experience involving Workday Financial Management and other Workday applications, design to implementation projects.
At least 3+ years of consulting experience in a big4 or similar firms
Experience in writing proposals.

Business process knowledge related to Workday Financials including Accounting & Finance, Audit & Internal Controls, Close Consolidation, Revenue Management, Expense etc. along with Reporting and Dashboards capabilities.

Role Overview
As an Enterprise Architect, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the organization s technology landscape by designing and implementing scalable, efficient, and future-ready software solutions. This role requires a balance of technical expertise, strategic vision, and leadership skills to ensure that enterprise systems align seamlessly with evolving business objectives. You will operate in dynamic environments, applying modern frameworks, AI-native stacks, and agile methodologies to deliver solutions that are robust, reliable, and adaptable to organizational goals.

Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Enterprise Architecture with deep domain knowledge.
Provide strategic advisory and influencing support to leadership and cross-functional teams.

Collaborate with multiple teams to contribute to enterprise-wide architectural strategies.
Deliver scalable solutions to complex problems that span across multiple teams and systems.

Strong capability in designing scalable, business-aligned software architectures.
Hands-on experience with modern development frameworks and agile methodologies.
Ability to analyze complex systems and deliver strategic architectural solutions.
Skilled in cross-team collaboration to ensure seamless software integration.

Required experience in AI-native development using one or more Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-native stacks.
Exposure to knowledge base systems and their integration into enterprise solutions.
Experience in AI-led SDLC and solutioning using AI to drive innovation and efficiency.
Cloud platform expertise across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with proven ability to architect, integrate, and optimize enterprise solutions in multi-cloud environments.

Description:
Job Description for Associate Agency Development Manager at Axis Max Life Insurance:

The Associate Agency Development Manager will be responsible for recruiting, training, and managing a team of insurance advisors. You will be tasked with developing agency channels, ensuring the successful implementation of sales strategies, and meeting performance targets. Your primary goal will be to drive business growth by building strong relationships with your team and customers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new insurance advisors to build a motivated team.
- Provide training, coaching, and support to ensure advisors achieve their targets.
- Develop and implement strategies to enhance agency performance and productivity.
- Monitor and evaluate advisors results regularly, providing feedback and mentorship.
- Foster a positive team culture and encourage collaboration among advisors.
- Conduct market analysis to identify new business opportunities and ensure competitive positioning.
- Prepare and present reports on team performance to senior management.
- Ensure adherence to compliance and regulatory requirements in all operations.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to inspire and motivate a team.
- Customer-focused with a keen understanding of sales processes.

Tools Required:
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Familiarity with CRM software for managing client relationships.
- Experience with data analysis tools to track performance metrics.
- Knowledge of insurance industry software and compliance standards is a plus.

Qualifications:
- Bachelors degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field.
- Prior experience in sales, insurance, or team management is preferred.
- Relevant certifications in insurance or finance will be an advantage.

At Axis Max Life Insurance, you will have the opportunity to grow your career in a dynamic and supportive environment while making a significant impact in the insurance industry.
